jobs.description:
**Lead / Manager Digital Hardware Design Engineer (10+ Years)**

**Location:** Electronic City, Bangalore  
 **Company:** Sanlayan Technologies  
 **Work Mode:** 5 Days Work from Office (WFO)

  

**Job Summary**

Sanlayan Technologies is looking for a highly experienced **Lead Digital Hardware Design Engineer** with 10+ years of experience in designing and developing complex high-speed digital and mixed-signal hardware systems for advanced embedded platforms used in Aerospace, Defence, Radar, Communication, and High-Performance Computing applications.

The ideal candidate will lead hardware architecture, design, validation, and integration activities involving FPGA, SoC, Processor, and mixed-signal-based platforms. The role requires strong expertise in high-speed interfaces, signal integrity, power integrity, hardware reliability, and product lifecycle management.

As a technical leader, the candidate will drive design reviews, mentor engineering teams, collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, and ensure successful execution of hardware programs from concept to production.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Leadership**

* Lead the architecture, design, and development of high-performance digital and mixed-signal hardware platforms.
* Own complete hardware development lifecycle from requirements capture through production release.
* Define hardware architecture, technology roadmap, design methodology, and engineering best practices.
* Lead technical reviews, design audits, root-cause investigations, and risk assessments.
* Mentor and guide hardware engineers to improve technical competency and engineering quality.

  

**Hardware Design & Development**

* Design FPGA, Processor, SoC, and Microcontroller-based embedded hardware platforms.
* Lead component selection, feasibility studies, architecture trade-offs, and BOM optimization.
* Develop complex schematics using Cadence OrCAD / Allegro tools.
* Drive PCB stack-up definition, high-speed routing strategy, and layout reviews.
* Ensure compliance with DFM, DFT, EMI/EMC, reliability, and environmental requirements.

  

**High-Speed Digital Design**

* Architect and implement high-speed interfaces including:

+ DDR3/DDR4/DDR5
+ PCIe Gen3/Gen4
+ Ethernet (1G/10G/25G)
+ JESD204B/C
+ USB 3.x
+ SPI, I2C, UART
+ LVDS and SerDes interfaces

* Design clock distribution architectures, reset management, and synchronization schemes.

  

**Power & Mixed Signal Design**

* Define power architecture including:

+ Multi-rail power systems
+ DC-DC Converters
+ LDO Regulators
+ Power Sequencing
+ Power Monitoring and Protection Circuits

* Interface high-resolution ADCs, DACs, RF transceivers, and mixed-signal subsystems.

  

**Validation & Product Realization**

* Lead board bring-up, debugging, characterization, and system validation activities.
* Perform Signal Integrity (SI), Power Integrity (PI), and Thermal analysis.
* Drive reliability analysis including Derating, MTBF, FMEA, and Environmental Qualification.
* Support manufacturing transfer, production ramp-up, and field issue investigations.

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate closely with FPGA, Firmware, Embedded Software, RF, Mechanical, Systems, and Program teams.
* Interact with customers, suppliers, and technology partners for technical discussions and solution development.
* Participate in proposal activities, technical estimations, and project planning.

  

**Required Qualifications**

Education

* B.E/B.Tech or M.E/M.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or related disciplines.

  

**Experience**

* Minimum 10+ years of experience in Digital Hardware Design and Development.
* Strong experience in high-speed digital and mixed-signal embedded hardware design.
* Experience working on Aerospace, Defence, Radar, Wireless Communication, Industrial, or High-Performance Computing products is highly preferred.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
**Job Description Performance Marketing Lead**  
   
**Company:** Boopin  
**Position:** Performance Marketing Lead  
**Experience:** 8-10 Years  
**Location:** Bengaluru  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Reporting To:** Digital Head  
   
**Role Overview**  
Boopin is looking for a highly experienced, commercially driven **Performance Marketing Lead** to own and scale paid media operations across Meta, Google, YouTube, ChatGPT Ads, and emerging AI-powered advertising platforms.  
The ideal candidate is a performance marketing specialist who combines deep platform expertise, analytical thinking, campaign execution, team leadership, and strong business acumen.  
This is a hands-on leadership role requiring ownership of campaign strategy, media budgets, client performance, team productivity, revenue growth, and profitability.  
The candidate must be capable of managing large advertising budgets, driving measurable business outcomes, and building a high-performing paid media practice within the agency.  
   
**Key Responsibilities**  
**1. Performance Marketing Strategy & Execution**

* Lead end-to-end performance marketing strategy across Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube Ads, and emerging AI advertising ecosystems, including ChatGPT Ads where available.
* Develop full-funnel advertising strategies covering awareness, consideration, lead generation, customer acquisition, and retention.
* Manage campaigns across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Display, Demand Gen, Video, and Paid Social.
* Build audience segmentation, retargeting, remarketing, and lookalike strategies.
* Drive campaign experimentation through creative testing, landing page optimization, audience testing, and bidding strategies.
* Develop scalable acquisition frameworks for B2B, B2C, D2C, e-commerce, real estate, and enterprise clients.

**2. Platform Expertise & Emerging Advertising Channels**  
**Meta Ads**

* Advanced expertise in Facebook and Instagram advertising, Advantage+ campaigns, Conversions API, catalog ads, and automated campaign optimization.
* Strong understanding of creative fatigue, audience saturation, attribution, and scaling strategies.

**Google Ads**

* Expert-level knowledge of Search, Performance Max, Shopping, Display, and Demand Gen.
* Strong understanding of bidding algorithms, Quality Score, conversion tracking, and Google Merchant Center.

**YouTube Ads**

* Develop YouTube performance strategies covering video action campaigns, demand generation, audience targeting, and video-led conversions.
* Optimize video advertising for view-through conversions, qualified traffic, and acquisition efficiency.

**3. Business Performance & Revenue Accountability**

* Own campaign performance against client-defined business objectives.
* Drive improvements in ROAS, ROI, CAC, CPL, CPA, conversion rates, and lead quality.
* Establish forecasting models for advertising spends, conversions, and acquisition costs.
* Work closely with client sales teams to connect marketing performance with actual revenue outcomes.
* Develop budget allocation strategies across channels based on incremental business contribution.
* Identify opportunities for account expansion, upselling, and performance marketing retainers.

**4. Team Leadership & Agency Operations**

* Ensure campaigns are executed accurately, with strong budget controls and platform compliance.
* Build internal capabilities through training, certifications, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

**5. Analytics, Attribution & Marketing Technology**

* Demonstrate advanced working knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and conversion tracking.
* Implement robust campaign measurement frameworks across platforms.
* Understand CRM integrations, offline conversion tracking, enhanced conversions, and server-side tracking.
* Build dashboards that connect advertising expenditure to qualified leads, pipeline, and revenue.
* Use attribution models and incrementality testing to evaluate channel contribution.
* Identify tracking discrepancies and resolve measurement issues proactively.

**6. Client Leadership & Strategic Consulting**

* Act as a senior performance marketing advisor to CMOs, marketing heads, founders, and business leaders.
* Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews with clear insights, recommendations, and growth opportunities.
* Translate campaign data into actionable commercial decisions.
* Participate in new business pitches, account audits, and performance marketing proposals.
* Collaborate with creative, content, SEO, technology, and strategy teams to deliver integrated marketing outcomes.
* Take ownership of client satisfaction, account retention, and performance delivery.

* 8-10 years of experience in performance marketing, preferably with significant experience in a digital marketing agency.
* Minimum 2-4 years of experience leading teams and managing multiple client accounts.
* Demonstrated experience managing substantial monthly advertising budgets across multiple industries.
* Expert-level knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, YouTube advertising, and Google Analytics.
* Strong understanding of paid media attribution, conversion optimization, and marketing automation.
* Experience with AI-enabled campaign management and emerging advertising technologies.
* Proven ability to scale campaigns while maintaining acquisition efficiency.
* Strong financial understanding of media budgets, campaign profitability, and agency commercials.
* Excellent presentation, analytical, stakeholder management, and client communication skills.

jobs.title: Siemens Tecnomatix Plant Simulation Architect
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**   
Lead end-to-end simulation engagements across manufacturing plants, warehouses, intralogistics, and logistics networks.

Define simulation architecture, system boundaries, modelling approach, level of detail, assumptions, data requirements, and experiment strategy.  
Develop scalable and reusable models using Siemens Tecnomatix Plant Simulation and related DES platforms.  
Model complex manufacturing processes including BIW, paint, trim & final assembly, EV/battery manufacturing, buffers, sequencing, downtime, rework, and quality constraints.  
Design and simulate AGV/AMR, conveyors, forklifts, tugger trains, ASRS, warehouse automation, and material-flow systems.  
Perform capacity planning, bottleneck analysis, line balancing, throughput optimization, WIP analysis, OEE improvement, and resource utilization studies.  
Lead Verification & Validation (V&V) through face-validity workshops, historical data comparison, acceptance criteria, and formal validation.  
Define and execute scenario analysis, sensitivity studies, statistical experiments, and simulation optimization.  
Integrate simulation solutions with MES, WMS, ERP, IoT and Digital Twin environments for data-driven decision support.  
Lead technical reviews, establish coding/model quality standards, and govern documentation, version control, and model lifecycle management.  
Translate simulation outputs into quantified operational recommendations, capacity roadmaps, automation business cases, and investment decisions.  
Manage technical risks, dependencies, delivery milestones, stakeholder expectations, and escalation activities.  
Mentor engineers and team leads conduct technical reviews, coaching, knowledge sharing, and capability development.  
Contribute to proposals, solution design, estimation, reusable model libraries, accelerators, playbooks, and CoE initiatives.  
Engage with senior client stakeholders and present simulation findings, recommendations, and transformation roadmaps.

**Technical Skills & Professional Skills**  
Siemens Tecnomatix Plant Simulation / SimTalk strong hands-on expertise.  
Strong knowledge of Discrete Event Simulation, manufacturing simulation, logistics simulation, and digital manufacturing.  
Experience with other DES platforms such as AnyLogic, FlexSim, Simio, Arena, WITNESS, DELMIA Quest, or equivalent.  
Strong scripting/programming skills using SimTalk, Python, Java, C#, or equivalent.  
Expertise in automotive manufacturing processes including BIW, paint, trim & final, powertrain, EV and battery manufacturing.  
Strong knowledge of intralogistics and warehouse automation including AGV/AMR, ASRS, conveyors, sortation, picking, kitting, and replenishment.  
Experience with MES/WMS/ERP integration, including platforms such as Siemens Opcenter, SAP ME/EWM, Manhattan, or Blue Yonder.  
Knowledge of Digital Twin, OPC-UA, MQTT, IoT, real-time data integration, and Industry 4.0 architectures.  
Strong understanding of statistical analysis, distribution fitting, warm-up analysis, confidence intervals, experimental design, sensitivity analysis, ANOVA, and optimization.  
Experience with LP/MIP, GA, metaheuristic optimization, or simulation-linked optimization.  
Proficiency in Python data analytics, including Pandas, SciPy, and visualization tools.  
Knowledge of AutoCAD/DWG/DXF, Plant 3D, BIM, or equivalent facility-layout technologies.  
Strong technical documentation, presentation, communication, stakeholder management, and client-facing consulting skills.  
Experience with Agile delivery, Jira/DevOps, Git, model version control, and delivery governance.  
Strong leadership capability with experience in team mentoring, technical governance, solution architecture, and program management.  
Ability to convert complex simulation results into business insights and actionable recommendations

We are looking for experienced SAP Core Banking / SAP Transactional Banking professionals to join our banking transformation programme.  
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience working on SAP Banking solutions within the banking domain, preferably across implementation, configuration, integration, migration or production support engagements.  
SAP Core Banking is an industry-specific solution for banking clients, with key capabilities across Deposits Management, Business Partner, Loans Management and Payments.  
Candidates with experience in one or more of these areas are encouraged to apply, with preference given to candidates who have worked across multiple SAP Banking modules and have strong banking domain knowledge.  
Key SAP Banking Areas  
The candidate should have experience in one or more of the following:  
1. Deposits Management (DM)  
Current Accounts and Savings Accounts  
Term/Time Deposits  
Banking product configuration  
Account opening and lifecycle management  
Interest calculation and processing  
Charges, fees and related account operations  
Deposit product migration and conversion  
Integration with Business Partner and Payments  
2. Business Partner (FS-BP)  
SAP Financial Services Business Partner  
Customer / Business Partner creation and maintenance  
Business Partner roles and relationships  
Customer data migration  
BP integration with Deposits, Loans and Payments  
Understanding of customer lifecycle processes  
3. Loans Management (LM)  
Retail/Commercial lending products  
Loan account lifecycle  
Loan creation and disbursement  
Repayment and payment schedules  
Interest and charges  
Loan closure/payoff  
Loan product configuration and migration  
Integration with Payments and Business Partner  
4. Payments / Payment Central / Payment Engine  
Payment processing and payment lifecycle  
Payment initiation and processing  
Payment routing and distribution  
Payment exceptions and investigation  
Payment-related configuration  
Integration with core banking and external payment systems  
Understanding of domestic/international payment flows  
  
Key Responsibilities  
Work with business and technology teams to understand banking requirements and translate them into SAP Banking solutions.  
Configure and support SAP Core Banking functionality based on business requirements.  
Participate in end-to-end SAP Banking implementation and transformation programmes.  
Support product configuration across Deposits, Loans, Business Partner and Payments.  
Analyse existing legacy banking processes and support their migration to SAP.  
Support data migration, reconciliation and validation activities.  
Work on integration between SAP Banking modules and external banking applications.  
Analyse and resolve functional issues, defects and production incidents.  
Support SIT, UAT, regression testing and production deployment activities.  
Work closely with technical teams on interfaces, APIs, integrations and batch processing.  
Prepare functional specifications, configuration documents, test scenarios and operational documentation.  
Participate in design discussions and provide banking domain expertise.  
Support release planning, implementation and post-go-live activities.  
Collaborate with distributed teams across business, technology, vendors and banking stakeholders.  
Required Skills  
Must Have:  
Hands-on experience in SAP Banking / SAP Core Banking / SAP Transactional Banking.  
Strong understanding of banking products and processes.  
Experience in at least one of the following:  
Deposits Management  
Loans Management  
Business Partner / FS-BP  
Payments / Payment Engine / Payment Central  
Experience in SAP Banking implementation, migration, configuration or production support.  
Good understanding of integration between SAP Banking components.  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.  
Ability to work with business and technology stakeholders.  
Preferred Skills  
Candidates with experience across two or more of the following will be preferred:  
SAP Deposits Management  
SAP Loans Management  
SAP Financial Services Business Partner  
SAP Payment Engine / Payments  
SAP Transactional Banking / TRBK  
SAP Banking Services  
Banking product configuration  
Legacy-to-SAP banking migration  
Large-scale banking transformation programmes  
Retail Banking / Corporate Banking  
Account and customer migration  
Banking payments and settlement processes  
Banking Domain Experience  
Candidates should have a good understanding of one or more of the following banking processes:  
Current and Savings Accounts  
Term Deposits  
Customer / Business Partner lifecycle  
Loans and lending products  
Account opening and closure  
Interest and fee processing  
Payments and payment processing  
Account migration  
Customer migration  
Product migration  
Banking reconciliation  
Payment exceptions and investigations  
Integration & Technical Exposure  
Good understanding of integration between SAP Banking and surrounding systems is desirable.  
Exposure to the following would be advantageous:  
APIs / Web Services  
REST / SOAP  
Enterprise integration  
Banking middleware  
Batch processing  
Data migration tools  
Database / SQL  
SAP integration frameworks  
Legacy banking platforms  
Payment systems  
Experience in Transformation / Migration  
Experience in large-scale banking transformation programmes will be highly valuable, particularly:  
Legacy banking platform ,SAP migration  
Customer and account migration  
Deposit product migration  
Loan migration  
Payment migration  
Data reconciliation and validation  
Application decommissioning  
Parallel run / cutover  
Production deployment and hypercare  
Candidate Profile  
The ideal candidate will be a SAP Banking specialist with strong banking domain knowledge, rather than a generic SAP consultant.  
  
**Qualification**  
15 years full time education

jobs.title: Client Visit Experience Manager
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**  

Owns the end-to-end design and delivery of assigned client engagements, translating client and account objectives into differentiated narratives, well-run workshops and actionable outcomes. Accountable for content quality, stakeholder coordination and execution, and for ensuring each engagement ends with documented decisions, commitments and next steps that are followed through. On strategic engagements, delivers the plan set by the Engagement Lead.

  
  
**Key accountabilities**  

* **Discovery and design.** Run context discovery, build agendas, session plans and workshop materials, and curate the stories, demos, SMEs and experience elements that fit the client context.

* **Delivery leadership.** Build the integrated readiness and stakeholder plan, coordinate presenters, Hub Operations and logistics, and identify and close readiness gaps before the cutoff.

* **Facilitation.** Facilitate standard engagements independently and co-facilitate strategic engagements with the Engagement Lead, guiding transitions, participation and decision-making.

* **Outcome capture and post-visit follow-through.** Document decisions, insights, actions and owners, issue the post-visit summary and track actions to closure with the account team.

* **Team direction and quality.** Direct the Associate Manager, Consultant and Senior Analyst on each engagement and quality-assure all outputs.

* **Community contribution.** Contribute templates, lessons learned and reusable assets to the facilitator community.

  
  
**Key deliverables**  

* Client discovery and engagement brief.

* Approved engagement narrative, agenda and session design.

* Integrated readiness and stakeholder plan.

* Facilitated engagement with documented outcomes.

* Post-visit summary, action log and handover.

* **Success looks like:** assigned engagements are ready on time, well received by participants, and end with documented decisions and actions that are followed through to closure.

  
  
  
  
  
**Core capabilities**  

* **Functional:** workshop facilitation; experience design; disciplined delivery management.

* **Digital, data and AI:** AI-assisted research and narrative development; content curation from the Centralized Digital Library; workflow and tracking tools.

* **Behavioral:** organized and proactive under competing priorities; synthesizing complex information into a clear engagement flow; executive communication.

* **Preferred:** Experience in an executive briefing center or client experience environment; formal training in facilitation or design-thinking methods.

* **Can be developed in role:** The CGX engagement framework, Visit Management System and engagement templates.

  
  
**Scope and decision authority**  

* **Owns:** Engagement plan, agenda and session design for assigned engagements; task allocation across the delivery team; content sign-off before presenter review.

* **Influences:** Content and demo selection; participant mix; hub scheduling.

**Escalates:** Readiness gaps not resolvable before cutoff; scope changes from the account team; presenter or SME non-availability

  
  
**Qualification**  
  
  
**Experience and qualifications**  

* 7+ years of experience facilitating workshops, meetings, client engagements or transformation activities.

* 2+ years developing agendas, discussion guides, workshop materials or client narratives.

* 2+ years coordinating multiple stakeholders and workstreams.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

1. Join RENSAR hardware team utilizing your board level design skills to develop digital and analog circuits.

2. Be involved in all phases of board level hardware development in small self-motivated teams.

3. Perform design documentation, component selection, schematic edits, DFMEA, DFM, DFT etc. to ensure that your design is meeting the requirements, is competitive, production friendly and highly reliable.

4. Work with the board layout designers and support the layout by providing design constraints, rules, guidelines and reviews.

5. Validate your design using simulation tools and perform functional quality analysis of your design.

6. Make technical presentations on the details of your design and project status.

7. Interface with customers and field engineers on an as needed basis, helping to resolve field problems while learning more about applications and user habits.

  
  

**Preferred candidate profile**

1. ME / M. tech., BE / B Tech. Electronics & Communication Engineering or equivalent.

2. 3-6 years of thorough hands-on experience of designing boards using 8 / 32-bit boards using MCUs like MSP 430, TMS320, STM32 etc. and analog mixed signal circuits.

3. Strong component engineering knowledge and exposure to semiconductor markets.

4. Strong knowledge of communication protocols like SPI, I2C, Ethernet, RS-232, RS-485 etc.

5. Must have worked with PWB designers to review the board designs for signal integrity, EMI/EMC compliance etc. Should be well versed with DFM / DFT using Cadence development tools.

6. Thorough knowledge of EMC standards like IEC6100, IEC 61526, CISPR 11 etc. and their practical application through out the design life cycle.

7. Hardcore board bring-up & debugging experience using instruments like Logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and in-circuit emulators.

8. Ability to interact and work with external test & certification labs to validate the product compliance.

9. Excellent verbal & written communication in Hindi & English.

10. Ready to travel across the country for gaining field and application knowledge as well as trouble shooting.

11. Should have hands on experience of board Box-up using enclosures made of polymer, sheet metal and castings, enclosures.

12. Strong linguistic skill for documentation of the development efforts.

  

**Desired**

  

1. DSP based design experience.

2. Proven track record with both Analog and high-speed digital designs.

3. Experience with low level analog signal design techniques.

4. Experience designing with programmable logic devices.

5. Software experience to generate diagnostic code (C, C++, and/or assembly language).

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Techdome**
Techdome is a product engineering company that builds AI that works in the real world, not just in demos. Our teams of engineers, designers, and AI specialists deliver LLM applications, RAG systems, AI agents, conversational assistants, and workflow automation for enterprises in FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, EdTech, Logistics, and SaaS. Every product we ship is built to pass security reviews, integrate with existing systems, and meet compliance requirements from day one.
  
  
**The Role**
Anyone can get a GenAI prototype working in a week. Getting it to survive a security audit, hold its accuracy under real traffic, and stay profitable at scale is the hard part, and that is the part you will own.
  
  
As a Technical Product Manager at Techdome, you will guide AI products from the first client conversation to launch and beyond. You are the person who spots the vague requirement, the missed handoff, or the lurking risk while fixing it is still cheap.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**
**Shaping the product**

* Turn a client’s rough idea into a clear product definition with scope, milestones, timelines, and budget.
* Understand each client’s industry, regulations, and compliance obligations, and convert them into requirements engineers can build from without guesswork.

**Taking GenAI to production**

* Partner with ML engineers to harden LLM, RAG, agent, and automation prototypes into reliable, scalable, safe systems.
* Define and track the metrics that decide success in production: accuracy, latency, evaluation scores, and cost per query.
* Make sure each AI feature connects to client systems through APIs and meets enterprise standards for security, privacy, and uptime.

**Keeping everyone aligned**

* Coordinate UI/UX, frontend, backend, mobile, QA, DevOps, and business analysts so every handoff is explicit and nothing falls through.
* Plan team capacity and keep every party accountable to their commitments.
* Manage relationships with partners such as LLM and cloud providers.

**Managing risk and communication**

* Run formal change control whenever scope, timeline, or budget shifts.
* Surface delivery, technical, and AI-specific risks early: hallucinations, prompt injection, data leakage, bias, and runaway costs.
* Track progress in JIRA or Azure DevOps and keep clients and leadership informed, with no surprises.
* Use AI tools yourself to speed up documentation, planning, tracking, and reporting.

**What You Bring**
**Must have**

* 2+ years as a Product Manager delivering complex enterprise software on time and on budget.
* Hands-on GenAI experience, ideally shipping an LLM, RAG, or agent-based product, with a practical grasp of the AI lifecycle and its risks.
* A record of leading cross-functional teams across design, engineering, QA, and DevOps.
* Working knowledge of Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall, and tools like JIRA, Azure DevOps, Trello, or Asana.
* Enough technical depth in the SDLC, APIs, microservices, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD to challenge estimates and earn engineers’ respect.
* Sound judgment on risk, change, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Clear written and spoken communication, including with senior client executives.

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with LLM evaluation, guardrails, and cost optimization.
* PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CSPO, or an AI/cloud certification.
* Domain experience in FinTech or Healthcare.
* Cross-industry exposure and the curiosity to pick up a new domain fast.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Clients trust you. They get honest updates, early warnings, and no surprises.
* Engineers trust you. Your requirements are clear, your estimates are fair, and handoffs don’t leave them guessing.
* Risks surface early. Hallucination, data leakage, and cost issues are caught before launch, not after.
* Products reach production. AI features go live within budget, with accuracy, latency, and cost per query tracked and holding steady.
* The way we work improves. You leave behind at least one process, template, or habit that makes the next project easier.

jobs.title: Digital Solution Designer
jobs.description:
**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About Divami**

Divami is a design partner to product companies working on hard, high-stakes problems in AI-first platforms, enterprise SaaS, financial products, and category-defining tools. Our clients do not come to us because their designs need polish. They come to us because their product needs to become a decision engine rather than a well-styled interface, and we turn strategy into shipped work with the frameworks to make it repeatable.

**The role**

You would own the design solution across a client engagement end-to-end. That work starts before the brief, in the effort of framing what the actual problem is. It runs through information architecture, key decision moments, edge cases, and the invisible logic tying them together. And it continues past the handover into the health of the client relationship itself. You would be the person clients trust to sharpen their thinking rather than just deliver against it, and you would produce frameworks other people at Divami reuse without rework.

**What you’ll own**

* **Client success, not just deliverables.**
  You measure your work by renewal, expansion, and satisfaction rather than by whether the file was handed off on time. Accounts grow because of your ownership.
* **The problem before the solution.**
  You proactively close gaps in user or business understanding before anyone flags them. If something is fuzzy, you name it and go after it, rather than waiting for the brief to catch up.
* **The whole solution, not just the screens.**
  Information architecture, key decision moments, edge cases, empty states, and the invisible logic tying them together.
* **Direction, not just execution.**
  You shape client or product direction through design thinking and innovation judgment. When the situation calls for it, you push for disruptive or category-defining solutions rather than defending against safe defaults.
* **Design rationale others can rely on.**
  You document trade-offs, decisions, and the reasoning behind them so the next person on the account is not starting from zero.
* **Reusable IP.**
  You produce frameworks, patterns, and playbooks that other designers at Divami pick up and use as they are. Your work compounds beyond your own engagements.
* **The room.**
  You handle direct client pushback with reasoning rather than defensiveness. You walk into leadership presentations without a safety net and walk out with alignment.
* **The bench.**
  You coach other designers in business-first thinking, disruptive versus incremental framing, and client handling. Designers around you level up because you are on the account.

**How you’ll think**

* **Problems get sharpened before they get solved.**
  You find the 20 percent that drives 80 percent of the value, and you name it clearly enough that everyone on the account can see the same problem.
* **Outcomes are visible at the moment of decision.**
  Every screen should tell the user and the business what happens next, and why. If the outcome is invisible, the design is not done.
* **Reasoning is portable.**
  Trade-offs get documented, decisions get explained, and the thinking behind a call is captured so the next person picks up where you left off.
* **Disruptive or incremental is a choice, not a default.**
  You know when to push for the category-defining answer and when the safe one is genuinely the right call. You can defend both.
* **Client success is a design metric.**
  Renewal, expansion, and satisfaction sit inside how you measure your own work, not outside it.
* **Multiplication over addition.**
  Your best work compounds through the frameworks others use, not through the individual files you personally shipped.

**The craft**

* **UX and product design mastery.**
  Information architecture, interaction patterns, decision flows, edge cases, and design systems. Craft you can defend on principle rather than just on intuition.
* **Business fluency.**
  Reading the shape of a business, sizing an opportunity, and sizing the risk of a design choice. You can talk to a CXO in their language, not just yours.
* **Facilitation.**
  Workshops, alignment sessions, and co-creation with clients. You can hold a room when the room disagrees.
* **Executive presence.**
  Walking a leadership team through a hard call without breaking rapport, and reframing the conversation when the reasoning holds up.
* **Framework thinking.**
  Turning specific learnings from one engagement into reusable IP that helps the whole practice get better.
* **Written and visual communication that lands.**
  Strategy docs, decision memos, walkthroughs, and slides that carry an argument on their own.

**Signals we look for**

These are patterns we watch for in how you talk about past work rather than items to tick off a checklist.

* **You describe a project by its client outcome.**
  The deliverable list is the least interesting part of the story you tell.
* **You can point to a moment you disagreed with a client.**
  You held the line with reasoning, and it changed the direction of the work.
* **You have produced something others still use.**
  A framework, a playbook, a decision pattern, or a system that other designers pick up without rework.
* **When you describe ambiguity, you describe how you closed it,**
  not how you flagged it.
* **You have a view on when to build the incremental thing**
  and when to push for the disruptive one. You can defend both calls.
* **You measure your work by what happened after it shipped,**
  not by how it looked at handoff.

**Qualifications**

* **4 to 8 years**
  designing digital products across SaaS, enterprise, fintech, or platforms with real complexity. Meaningful time in senior IC or lead roles.
* **A portfolio of decisions, not just artifacts.**
  Case studies that show how you moved from an ambiguous problem to a shipped solution, and where you traded off.
* **Evidence of account ownership.**
  Concrete examples of relationships you grew, renewed, or expanded because of how you showed up, not just because of what you shipped.
* **Executive-room confidence.**
  You can present to a CXO, hear a hard pushback, and respond with reasoning that reframes the conversation without getting defensive.

**Why this role**

* **Ownership that is real.**
  You own the account, the outcome, and the direction, not just a Figma file.
* **A new domain every quarter.**
  AI-first platforms, enterprise tools, financial products, and industry-defining software. Range that compresses years of learning.
* **Frameworks that are actually used.**
  Divami’s methodology (VEDA), empathy-led frameworks, and outcome-driven approaches we have validated across real client work.
* **Room to shape how we work,**
  not just what we ship. If you have opinions about how design should be practiced, we want them on the table.
* **A bench of people**
  who take craft and business seriously in equal measure.

PCSAT, utilization % achievement, no. of leads generated from the business interaction, no. of errors/ gaps in documenting customer requirements, feedback from project manager, process flow diagrams (quality and timeliness), % of deal solutioning completed within timeline, velocity generated.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  
The Business Analyst is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for working with internal and external clients to determine requirements and to define solutions to address complex business, process and systems problems, and improvements in the organization.  
  
This role acts as a liaison among stakeholders in order to understand the structure, policies, and operations of an organization, and to recommend solutions that enable the organization to achieve its goals.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Acts as a bridge between the business problems and the technology solutions.
* Analyzes, transforms and ultimately resolves the business problems with the help of technology.
* Works with internal clients and apply best practice methodologies to determine business requirements and to define solutions to address business, process, information and system problems, improvements or change.
* Delivers business projects in line with sponsor requirements and enterprise architecture.
* Proactively develops and deploys enhanced services and platforms, covering all the functional aspects from service/product definition through to build and deployment.
* Ensures the identification and documentation of operational gaps including user guides, templates, test cases and related user training.
* Assists with the resolution of issues pertaining to the service.
* Adheres to and follows the relevant development and support processes.
* Communicates and escalates if any issues arise or deliverables cannot be met and request assistance to ensure closure of issues.
* Takes responsibility for delivery of project elements with minimal supervision.
* Performs any other related task as required.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Seasoned understanding of business practices and processes.
* Excellent team player who displays good client service orientation with well-developed administrative and organization skills.
* Seasoned expertise in specific systems, processes and technologies that they will be required to analyze.
* Meticulous attention to detail whilst working under pressure.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Seasoned process mapping technology knowledge.
* Ability to build rapport and engage effectively with a variety of stakeholders.
* Seasoned knowledge of project management methodology.
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to convert business requirements into operational deliverables (functional requirements) to meet business objectives.
* Excellent documentation skills, in particular, functional requirements, test cases, system user documentation, processes and procedures and presentations.
* Seasoned working knowledge of Microsoft Exchange, Word, Excel Project, PowerPoint and Visio Good understanding of systems generally used in a services organization, for example ServiceNow, Siebel, Remedy, SAP, EMS would be advantageous.
* Seasoned understanding of and experience with ITIL (IT Infrastructure Library) and the application of ITIL tools within a service integrator.

**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Business or Information Technology or a related field.
* Project management certification would be advantageous.
* Professional in Business Analysis certification is preferred.
* IIBA Membership required.
* Relevant technology certification(s) required, such as ITIL.

**Required experience:**

* Seasoned experience as a Business Analyst gained within a technology services environment.
* Seasoned experience as a system administrator or developer would be advantageous.
* Seasoned experience in and with all operational aspects of a Services business, preferably with a Systems Integrator.
* Seasoned experience in the business requirement gathering, use case definition, process mapping and implementing new services and systems.

**Workplace type****:**

Hybrid Working

**About NTT DATA**  
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune

Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through

responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with

unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and

application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move

confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more

than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as

established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each

year in R&D.

jobs.title: Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
WE'RE HIRING! | Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager.

We are hiring a banking professional who can open, run and protect To The Moon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking relationships: INR pay-in, payout, virtual accounts, CMS and API banking for a crypto trading platform.

* **Department:** Strategic Partnerships (Banking & Payments)
* **Reports To:** Founder & CEO
* **Location:** Lucknow
* **Travel:** Regular travel to Mumbai, Delhi NCR & Bengaluru for bank meetings
* **Experience:** 5+ years in Banking or Fintech
* **Required Expertise:** Digital Banking, API Banking, CMS & Virtual Accounts
* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Seniority:** Senior Executive to Manager, based on experience

**About ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd**

ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd is an FIU-IND registered Indian cryptocurrency exchange, headquartered in Jaipur and operating since 2021. We run spot and futures trading plus OTC on-ramp and off-ramp services for Indian users. INR flows, deposits, withdrawals and settlements, sit at the center of our business, and they depend on strong, compliant banking partners.

**Role purpose**

You will own ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking ecosystem end to end. That means finding and onboarding banks, getting API banking, virtual accounts and CMS live, and keeping every relationship healthy. You will also build backup banking so no single bank or payment rail can stop INR deposits or withdrawals.

**Key responsibilities**

1.Bank partnerships and onboarding

a. Find, pitch and onboard private, small finance, cooperative and new-age banks for current accounts, escrow/nodal accounts, pay-in and payout.

b. Present ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's business model, FIU-IND registration, AML/KYC framework and risk controls to bank product, risk and compliance teams.

c. Lead the bank's due diligence: documents, questionnaires, site visits and onboarding

paperwork.

2. API banking, virtual accounts and CMS

a. Set up and expand virtual account (VAN) structures for user-wise INR deposit collection

and auto-reconciliation.

b. Get API banking live for IMPS, NEFT, RTGS and UPI payouts, plus balance, statement and

status APIs.

c. Set up CMS for collections and bulk payouts, and drive integration with our tech team

through UAT and go-live.

d. Work with UPI collect, payment aggregator and PSP partners as extra deposit rails.

3. Relationship management

a. Act as the single point of contact for every banking partner, from relationship managers

up to senior leadership.

b. Handle account freezes, lien marks, LEA and cyber-cell requests, chargebacks and

transaction holds with the bank and our compliance team.

c. Run regular reviews of volumes, TAT, success rates and issues with each bank.

4. Negotiation and commercials

a. Negotiate pricing, transaction limits, float terms, MDR, payout charges and SLAs.

b. Review and close banking agreements, API terms and SLAs with our legal team.

5. Business continuity

a. Always keep at least two live banking partners for pay-in and payout, with tested

failover.

b. Spot risk early, regulatory changes, a bank's appetite for VDA business and line up

alternatives before they are needed.

6. Compliance and internal coordination

a. Work with compliance, finance, operations and tech so bank requirements under PMLA,

FIU-IND and RBI guidelines are met.

b. Keep partner dashboards, MIS and documentation current for management.

**Must-have requirements**

* 5+ years in banking or fintech, with hands-on work in digital banking, API banking, CMS and

virtual accounts.

* Has managed these products for a corporate client, a fintech platform, a stockbroker, a payment

aggregator or a crypto exchange from the bank side or the client side.

* Has taken at least 2–3 bank integrations (VAN, payout API or CMS) from first meeting to go-live.

* An active network of decision-makers in transaction banking, CMS, digital/API banking and

fintech partnership teams at Indian banks.

* Clear understanding of INR payment rails: IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, UPI, NACH, and escrow/nodal

account structures.

* Working knowledge of KYC/AML, PMLA, FIU-IND and RBI rules relevant to banks serving fintechs

and VDA businesses.

* Strong negotiation, presentation and written communication skills in English and Hindi.

* Graduate in any field; MBA in Finance, Banking or Business preferred.

**Skills and Competencies**

* **Banking Products:** Knowledge of current, escrow and nodal accounts; virtual accounts; CMS collections and payouts; API banking; UPI collect and payout.
* **Technical Fluency:** Ability to read API documentation and understand webhooks, callbacks, reconciliation files and UAT; comfortable coordinating with developers and bank technology teams.
* **Negotiation:** Ability to negotiate pricing, transaction limits, SLAs and agreements while maintaining strong banking relationships.
* **Communication:** Strong presentation and email-writing skills; confident in meetings with bank CXOs, risk and compliance heads.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Ability to align compliance, finance, technology and operations teams around bank integration timelines.
* **Problem Solving:** Ability to resolve account freezes, failed payouts, settlement delays and reconciliation gaps quickly.
* **Ownership:** Self-driven, works independently and takes complete responsibility for follow-through until go-live.
* **Integrity:** Handles confidential banking and customer data with utmost discretion.

**Good to have**

•Earlier work in a bank's transaction banking, CMS, digital banking or fintech alliances team.

•Experience at an Indian crypto exchange, stockbroker, payment gateway, PSP or NBFC.

•Has onboarded a VDA or high-risk business with a bank and understands the bank's concerns.

•Exposure to payment aggregator rules, cross-border payments or stablecoin on/off-ramp flows.

•Familiarity with reconciliation tools, MIS reporting and Excel-based analysis.

Pay: ₹444,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Product Manager, Specialist (WT- Contact Center (Ops))
jobs.description:
**About Vanguard**
  
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.

  

**Vanguard India**

Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.

**Role Summary**

The Product Manager, Specialist role is responsible for leading digital product management initiatives, overseeing the development, implementation, and optimization of strategic products. This role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams to enhance customer experience, define product roadmaps, and drive business growth. The specialist ensures smooth product execution, manages escalations, and employs data-driven insights to refine product strategies. Additionally, they work with stakeholders to align product goals with business objectives and market needs.

This Product Manager will lead enhancements to the customer service and contact center tools used by our crew to serve clients, including the integration of AI capabilities

**Responsibilities**

* Lead digital product management efforts for multiple digital products or one strategic product, ensuring alignment with business goals.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement best practices that enhance the customer experience and drive impactful changes.

* Coach digital product teams on best practices, learnings, and product development methodologies to maximize efficiency.

* Partner with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues promptly, supporting escalations when needed to enable rapid delivery.

* Oversee the planning, development, and execution of new digital products, including market analysis, feature definition, and implementation planning.

* Develop pricing and positioning strategies, ensuring products are competitive and aligned with market demand.

* Utilize qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience and optimize product performance.

* Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes, collaborating with engineering teams to ensure timely and resource-efficient delivery.

* Lead product launches by working closely with marketing teams, executives, and other product management stakeholders to drive successful go-to-market strategies.

* Evaluate promotional plans to ensure consistency with product line strategies and effective messaging across customer segments.

* Participate in ongoing business planning, departmental prioritization activities, and special projects as required.

* Lead the modernization of contact-center desktop capabilities and supporting tools to improve the experience of contact-center staff and participants while enabling stronger customer relationships.

* Coordinate dependencies across multiple applications and product teams by understanding interconnected roadmaps, managing delivery trade-offs, and balancing technical constraints with speed to market.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of related work experience, with at least two years of experience leading large cross-functional teams on major organizational projects.

* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science or IT, or Bachelor’s in Computer Applications (BCA), or Master’s in Computer Applications (MCA).

* Strong expertise in digital product management, market analysis, and user experience optimization.

* Proven ability to translate customer insights into product improvements and new features.

* Experience working with engineering teams to drive product development from concept to launch.

* Excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

* Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities to align product strategy with business goals.

* Experience in a contact-center or service environment, including familiarity with contact-center operations, desktop platforms, and the tools that support customer-service teams.

* Demonstrated ability to manage cross-product dependencies and collaborate with multiple product managers; financial-services experience is preferred but not mandatory, and relevant banking or healthcare customer-service systems experience may be considered.

**Location**

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.

**Our mission**

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

  

**Our commitment to you**

Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:

**Financial wellness**
  
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.

**Physical wellness**
  
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.

**Personal wellness**
  
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.

**How we work**

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

* Understanding of competitive offerings and industry trends, i.e. fintechs, startups

* Interest in working in a fast pace and evolving environment

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office. Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
* Must be a self-directed, self-starter comfortable working with strong degree of autonomy to accomplish results

Embark on a journey where your unique contributions are celebrated, and your professional growth is embraced. At ADCB, we nurture a diverse, inclusive community where every voice is valued.

The Retail Banking Group (RBG) supports retail and micro-business customers in managing their finances, through expert advice and the provision of a full suite of specialist products and services in conventional and Shari’ah compliant banking. The business is committed to driving digital innovation to deliver excellence in customer service. We are actively seeking an ambitious professional to join our Retail Banking team at ADCB to work alongside passionate colleagues who share your ambition to redefine excellence in UAE banking.

We are actively seeking an ambitious professional to join our Retail Banking team at ADCB to work alongside passionate colleagues who share your ambition to redefine excellence in UAE banking.

**In this role, your key responsibilities include**
:

* Digital Channel Development and Implementation- Assess areas of development and innovation to existing and new Digital Channels (internet, mobile, tablet, SMS, wearable, digital TV) in order to broaden the overall service offering and enhance Digital Channel services in line with overall objectives of the business group.
* Digital Channel Usage and Reporting- Own and execute Digital channel onboarding, usage and migration related programmes and ensure service failures are resolved immediately to avoid customer dissonance and any threat to the Bank’s reputation. Continuously oversee and analyze Digital Channel usage and revenue KPIs to ensure overall business objectives are met
* Quality Certification, Audit and Compliance- Ensure that all services meet regulatory requirements such as ISO 9001 certification for internet Banking/mobile Banking and product development. Administer the retention of such certifications in order to remain compliant and minimize any risk of non-compliance to the Bank. Ensure timely and accurate development of risk and compliance reporting as required in line with the agreed standards in order to communicate activity/incidence reporting and assist in departmental decision making
* People Management- Manage self and team in line with ADCB’s people management policies, procedures, processes and practices to ensure adherence and to maximize own and employee contribution to business performance. Organize and supervise the activities and work of the team to ensure that targets and objectives are achieved and the business plan is delivered in line with the required policies, processes, procedures and systems
* Policies, Processes, Systems and Procedures- Implement approved departmental policies, processes and procedures, and ensure employee adherence so that work is carried out to the required standard while delivering the required standards of service to customers and stakeholders
* Continuous Improvement- Manage and motivate the team to ensure they contribute to, and participate in, the identification and implementation of change initiatives, programmes and projects in line with the Bank’s standards
* Customer Service- Demonstrate Our Promise and apply the ADCB Service Standards to deliver the Bank’s required levels of service in all internal and external customer interactions
* Product and Journey Ownership - Own assigned customer journeys or platform capabilities within Group Digital and AI, translating the needs of Retail, Business and Corporate Banking clients and stakeholders into a prioritized product backlog with clearly defined features, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Digital Journeys and Channels - Develop and enhance digital journeys across Retail, Business and Corporate Banking, including onboarding, account opening, authentication, servicing, payments and related capabilities delivered through Web and Mobile channels.
* Platform Management - Manage assigned components of the Bank’s digital platforms throughout their lifecycle, including requirements, delivery, enhancements, defect prioritization, release readiness, operational performance and reuse across client segments.
* Agile Delivery - Work closely with engineering, architecture, UX/UI, testing and business teams through the complete Agile delivery lifecycle. Own backlog refinement, sprint prioritization and acceptance of delivered functionality.
* Customer Experience - Use customer feedback, analytics and operational insights to identify pain points and improve adoption, straight-through processing, journey completion and customer experience.
* Stakeholder Management - Collaborate with Retail Banking, Business Banking, Corporate Banking, Operations, Technology, Data and AI, Compliance, Risk, Legal and other stakeholders to ensure segment requirements, dependencies and shared platform priorities are effectively managed.
* Risk, Compliance and Quality - Ensure digital capabilities meet applicable Bank policies, information security, regulatory, risk and compliance requirements.
* Continuous Improvement - Identify opportunities for digitization, automation and simplification of existing customer and operational journeys.
* Customer Service - Demonstrate Our Promise and apply the ADCB Service Standards to deliver the Bank’s required levels of service in all internal and external customer interactions.

**The ideal candidate should have the following experience**

* At least 8 years of experience in delivering projects with experience in alternate delivery channels within a Bank
* Bachelor’s Degree in relevant specialization
* Project Management Prince II or PMI or Agile (or equivalent) Certification
* Knowledge of web channels and mobile technologies
* Planning, analytical and time management skills
* Written and spoken English

  : The indicative pay range for this role is AED 35000– AED 45000 per month. Additionally, all employees are eligible to participate in one of our rewarding variable pay plans.
* **Comprehensive Benefits Package**
  : This includes market-leading medical insurance, group life and personal accident insurance, paid leave and leave airfare, employee preferential rates on loans and finance facilities, staff discounts and offers, and children education assistance (for certain job levels).

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
**Summary**

The
**Senior Product Manager – Consumer Products**
is responsible for the end to end product development, delivery, and continuous enhancement of consumer financial products, including credit cards, loans, instalment plans, balance transfers, top ups, and related value added services.

The role will lead product strategy, market research, proposition development, product launches, portfolio management, and continuous improvement. Working closely with Risk, Technology, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, and other stakeholders, the role will ensure products are commercially viable, customer focused, digitally enabled, and aligned with Finance House’s strategic and regulatory objectives.

**Major Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy & Portfolio Management**

* Develop and execute product strategies and propositions for assigned consumer products, including cards, loans, instalment plans, balance transfers, and related services.
* Own the end to end product lifecycle from market research and business case development through launch, optimization, and product rationalization.
* Develop short, medium, and long term product roadmaps covering product features, digital journeys, underwriting, technology initiatives, and business priorities.
* Conduct customer research, segmentation, competitor analysis, and market reviews to identify new opportunities and enhance existing products.
* Define product propositions, pricing, features, eligibility criteria, and customer value propositions in line with market needs and business objectives.
* Monitor portfolio performance and identify opportunities to improve acquisition, activation, utilization, retention, revenue, profitability, and customer experience.

**Product Development & Digital Transformation**

* Lead the design and delivery of new products, product enhancements, and digital customer journeys from concept through implementation and post launch optimization.
* Define product requirements, customer journeys, business processes, and functional specifications in collaboration with Technology and Operations.
* Drive digital acquisition, onboarding, credit decisioning, fulfilment, servicing, and other initiatives to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, automate product journeys, improve turnaround times, and enhance digital capabilities.
* Partner with Technology, Data, and Analytics teams to leverage automation, AI, and advanced analytics to improve product performance and customer outcomes.

**Commercial & Financial Management**

* Establish product level financial objectives and monitor revenue, costs, profitability, portfolio growth, and key performance indicators.
* Develop business cases and financial models for new products, product enhancements, pricing changes, campaigns, and strategic initiatives.
* Recommend pricing, fees, promotions, and product economics that balance customer value, competitiveness, risk, and profitability.
* Monitor product P&L and identify opportunities to improve portfolio contribution and sustainable returns.

**Credit, Risk & Governance**

* Partner with Credit Risk to define and optimize product eligibility, underwriting, credit policy, risk appetite, and decisioning requirements.
* Monitor portfolio quality, delinquency, approval rates, utilization, attrition, and other relevant risk and performance indicators.
* Ensure products and product changes comply with approved risk appetite, credit policies, regulatory requirements, and internal governance frameworks.
* Work closely with Compliance, Legal, AML, Risk, and other control functions to ensure regulatory and operational requirements are addressed throughout the product lifecycle.
* Establish and lead product governance routines, including product performance reviews, roadmap reviews, and cross functional forums.
* Represent the function in relevant audits, regulatory reviews, governance committees, and discussions with card schemes, processors, vendors, and strategic partners.

**Product Marketing & Customer Growth**

* Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Distribution teams to develop product positioning, go to market strategies, campaigns, and customer acquisition initiatives.
* Develop strategies to improve customer acquisition, activation, engagement, utilization, retention, cross sell, and customer lifetime value.
* Use customer insights, behavioural data, and portfolio analytics to identify opportunities for targeted propositions and improved customer experiences.
* Monitor campaign and proposition performance and recommend improvements based on measurable business outcomes.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with Operations, Risk, Technology, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, Legal, AML, Data & Analytics, Collections, Sales, and other stakeholders to deliver customer centric solutions.
* Build strong relationships across the organization and influence stakeholders to achieve product objectives.
* Act as the subject matter expert for assigned products, providing guidance on product strategy, proposition, economics, customer journeys, and portfolio performance.

**Knowledge & Skill Requirements**

* Strong expertise in consumer financial product management, particularly credit cards, personal loans, instalment products, and other consumer lending solutions.
* Strong understanding of the complete product lifecycle, including proposition development, acquisition, onboarding, activation, usage, retention, and portfolio management.
* Strong understanding of consumer credit, underwriting, pricing, portfolio risk, and lending economics.
* Good knowledge of card issuing, card processing, payment schemes, digital lending, credit decisioning, and digital onboarding platforms.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to develop business cases, financial models, pricing strategies, and product performance analysis.
* Strong understanding of digital product development, customer experience, data analytics, AI, and automation.
* Strong analytical, project management, problem solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good understanding of the UAE consumer finance and regulatory environment, including relevant CBUAE requirements and applicable card scheme requirements.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Technology, or a related discipline from a recognized university.
* Professional certification in Product Management, Agile, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Experience
* 10 to 12 years of progressive experience in product management within banking, consumer finance, fintech, payments, or related financial services.
* Strong experience managing consumer lending and/or card products across the complete product lifecycle.
* Proven track record of developing and launching products, enhancing existing propositions, and delivering measurable improvements in revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, or portfolio performance.
* Demonstrated experience in product strategy, roadmap development, pricing, business case development, and product performance management.
* Experience leading digital transformation initiatives involving digital acquisition, onboarding, credit decisioning, automation, or customer experience enhancement.
* Experience working cross functionally with Risk, Technology, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, and other control functions.
* Experience working within a regulated financial services environment, preferably within the UAE or GCC.
* Experience with card schemes, processors, lending platforms, digital banking ecosystems, or fintech partnerships will be an advantage.

**Client Manager Graduate Programme (UAE Nationals)**

**Join our Client Management team and help deliver the exceptional client experience that sits at the heart of Corporate & Investment Banking.**  
  
**As a Client Manager Graduate, you'll work closely with Relationship Managers, Product Partners and specialist teams to support some of the region's leading corporates and financial institutions. You'll gain exposure to client relationship management, account servicing, onboarding, credit processes and risk management, helping clients navigate their banking needs while building the foundations of a successful banking career.**  
  
**Throughout the programme, you'll develop a broad understanding of how Corporate & Investment Banking serves clients across cash management, trade finance, lending and financial markets, while working alongside experienced professionals in a dynamic, international environment.**  
**This is an opportunity to build commercial, analytical and relationship management skills while gaining first-hand exposure to how a global bank supports clients across the UAE and beyond.**

**About the Graduate Programme – how you'll learn and grow**

**Join a skills-first organisation where your potential matters more than your background.**  
  
**Over this 12-month graduate programme, you'll gain hands-on experience, build meaningful relationships and develop a deep understanding of client management within Corporate & Investment Banking. From day one, you'll contribute to real business activities while receiving structured development and support.**

**You'll benefit from:**

* **Real impact:** **Support client relationships and contribute to the delivery of banking solutions for corporate and institutional clients.**
* **Future-ready capabilities:** **Build commercial, client management, risk awareness and stakeholder management skills.**
* **Cross-functional exposure:** **Work with Relationship Managers, Product Partners, Operations, Risk, Legal and Compliance teams.**
* **Continuous growth:** **Learn through structured development, mentoring and practical experience.**

**What you'll do**

**During the programme, you may:**

* **Support Relationship Managers in delivering exceptional client service across a portfolio of corporate and institutional clients.**
* **Assist with client onboarding, account maintenance and documentation processes.**
* **Help prepare client materials, briefing notes and account reviews.**
* **Work with product specialists to support client needs across lending, cash management, trade finance and financial markets solutions.**
* **Monitor portfolio activity and contribute to maintaining strong account and risk management standards.**
* **Collaborate with teams across the bank to resolve client queries and improve the client experience.**
* **Participate in projects focused on operational excellence, process improvement and client outcomes.**
* **Build knowledge of risk, compliance and regulatory standards within Corporate & Investment Banking.**

**Bring the skills – we'll help you build your career**

**We welcome students from all degree disciplines and backgrounds, recognising that diverse perspectives drive innovation.**  
  
**We're looking for people who can:**

* **Build relationships and communicate confidently with a wide range of stakeholders.**
* **Take ownership and show initiative when tackling challenges.**
* **Think critically and solve problems using sound judgement.**
* **Learn quickly, stay curious and continuously develop.**
* **Collaborate effectively across teams and functions.**
* **Stay organised and attentive to detail in a fast-paced environment.**
* **Demonstrate commercial curiosity and an interest in clients, banking and global markets.**

**About Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB)**

**We are a super-connector for many of the world's largest companies across more than 50 markets, playing a central role in global trade, capital flows and economic growth.**  
  
**We work with governments, financial institutions and some of the world's most ambitious corporates to help them expand, invest and navigate uncertainty across increasingly complex and fast-changing markets.**  
  
**What makes us distinctive is our combination of deep local expertise with an extensive and unique global network. We support clients across risk management, financing, transaction services, advisory and sustainable finance, helping move capital to where it's needed most and supporting the real economy across our footprint.**

**Eligibility**

**To be eligible for this graduate programme, you need to be in your final year of study or be a recent graduate.**

**We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.**

**Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.**

**Together we:**

* **Do the right thing** **and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do**
* **Never settle,** **continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well**
* **Are better together,** **we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term**

**What we offer**
