jobs.title: Assistant Manager, Planning & Performance
jobs.description:
Dubai, Dubai, AE Permanent ID: 100809

  

### **Description**

Operating in the UAE for over 50 years, CBD manages the corpor financial requirements of some of the largestates and businesses operating in the country, driving the UAE economy. Over the years, CBD has transformed into a progressive and modern banking institution winning multiple awards for its digital initiatives, credit cards, bank accounts, mobile app features and services.
  
CBD has been recognized as the number one bank in the UAE on the Forbes list of The World’s Best Banks 2022.

  

As we continue to build upon our successes, we are looking for ambitious individuals who are passionate about the banking and finance industry and the markets in which CBD operates. Just as important to us is your ability to demonstrate a talent for dealing with people - your colleagues and our customers and delivering service that really goes the extra mile.

  

**Job Purpose:**
  
The Assistant Manager, Planning & Performance is responsible for supporting the bank-wide financial planning, forecasting, performance reporting, and management information processes. The role provides insightful financial analysis, performance monitoring, benchmarking, and modelling to support strategic decision-making, business growth, and effective cost management across the Group.

  

**Principal Accountabilities:**

* Support the strategic and operational financial planning process, including annual budgets, forecasts, business unit plans, cost centre budgets, and branch budgets.
* Prepare and deliver monthly management reporting packs, ensuring accuracy, consistency, integrity, and timely submission.
* Provide financial insights, scenario analysis, and performance recommendations across revenue, expenses, capital, return on equity, liquidity, funding, and regulatory metrics.
* Conduct detailed Net Interest Margin analysis across products and maintain models to assess margin compression impacts.
* Prepare peer benchmarking and market analysis reports, comparing performance against UAE banking peers and Tier 1 banks.
* Support the preparation of Board and Investor presentation materials, including macroeconomic and banking sector updates.
* Assist in implementing and monitoring the Group’s cost management framework, including expense analysis, cost reporting, and cost control initiatives.
* Review and validate sales incentive calculations, ensuring compliance with approved policies, accuracy of payouts, and timely processing.
* Prepare financial models and business cases to evaluate new initiatives, products, and strategic opportunities.
* Support finance transformation projects by gathering, analysing, and consolidating financial and accounting information for management reporting purposes.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to define performance measures, reporting methodologies, and business logic.
* Identify and resolve data quality issues, reporting gaps, and inconsistencies between business requirements and source systems.
* Respond to ad-hoc business reporting and analytical requests to support business decision-making.
* Maintain comprehensive process documentation, departmental operating instructions, and standard operating procedures.

  

### **Requirements**

**Education and Experience:**

* Experience in financial planning, forecasting, management reporting, business performance analysis, or financial modelling.
* Experience within the banking or financial services sector is preferred.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to interpret complex financial information and generate actionable insights.
* Knowledge of financial performance metrics, budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and banking industry benchmarks.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present information effectively to senior stakeholders.
* Strong planning, organisational, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across departments and manage multiple priorities.
* High attention to detail, accuracy, and commitment to delivering quality outputs.
* Professional drive, continuous learning mindset, and commitment to process improvement and innovation.
* Ability to communicate effectively with senior management and support strategic decision-making through data-driven analysis.
* Education requirements: Not specified in the provided job description.

jobs.title: Manager, Treasury Control
jobs.description:
Dubai, Dubai, AE Permanent ID: 102698

  

### **Description**

Operating in the UAE for over 50 years, CBD manages the financial requirements of some of the largest corporates and businesses operating in the country, driving the UAE economy. Over the years, CBD has transformed into a progressive and modern banking institution winning multiple awards for its digital initiatives, credit cards, bank accounts, mobile app features and services.
  
CBD has been recognized as the number one bank in the UAE on the Forbes list of The World’s Best Banks 2022.

  

As we continue to build upon our successes, we are looking for ambitious individuals who are passionate about the banking and finance industry and the markets in which CBD operates. Just as important to us is your ability to demonstrate a talent for dealing with people - your colleagues and our customers and delivering service that really goes the extra mile.

**Job Purpose:**
  
The Manager, Treasury Control (Hedge Accounting) is responsible for establishing, implementing, and managing the Bank’s IFRS 9 Hedge Accounting framework. The role will ensure robust governance, regulatory compliance, accurate financial reporting, and alignment with Treasury and Asset Liability Management strategies while supporting the Bank’s interest rate risk management objectives.

**Principal Accountabilities:**

* Lead the implementation and ongoing management of the Bank’s hedge accounting framework across banking book portfolios.
* Design hedge relationships and develop hedge documentation, designation memorandums, and governance packs.
* Perform prospective and retrospective hedge effectiveness testing and monitor hedge performance.
* Own daily, monthly, quarterly, and year-end hedge accounting processes, reporting, and disclosures.
* Prepare and review hedge accounting journals, including fair value adjustments and hedge reserve movements.
* Ensure compliance with IFRS 9 hedge accounting requirements and related regulatory expectations.
* Partner with Treasury, Risk, Financial Reporting, and Financial Control teams to support balance sheet management initiatives.
* Assess hedge accounting implications of Treasury products, ALM strategies, and business initiatives.
* Maintain strong governance, controls, audit trails, policies, procedures, and operating manuals.
* Liaise with Internal Audit, External Audit, and regulators on hedge accounting matters.
* Drive automation, process improvements, and system enhancements related to hedge accounting and treasury reporting.
* Support treasury finance activities including P&L reporting, regulatory reporting, and ad-hoc management requests.

  

### **Requirements**

**Education and Experience:**

* Qualified Accountant (ACA, ACCA, CPA, CA or equivalent).
* 15+ years of experience within Treasury Finance, Financial Control, Product Control, or a related banking finance function.
* Hands-on experience implementing and operating IFRS 9 Hedge Accounting frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of Fair Value Hedges, Cash Flow Hedges, Portfolio Hedges, and IRRBB.
* Strong understanding of treasury products, derivatives, valuation methodologies, and hedge effectiveness testing.
* Experience preparing hedge documentation, accounting assessments, and financial statement disclosures.
* Experience engaging with external auditors and regulatory stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience within the UAE banking sector is preferred.
* Experience with treasury platforms such as Murex, Calypso, Kondor, QRM, Finastra, or equivalent systems is preferred.
* Advanced Excel skills and a strong understanding of automation and process improvement initiatives.

jobs.title: Delivery Program Director
jobs.description:
Position Overview:

We are creating a new leadership role that brings Customer Success and Product Support together under one owner.

On the Customer Success side, you will be accountable for the full client experience after contract signature, from onboarding and go live through adoption, satisfaction and renewal.

On the Support side, you will have direct responsibility for the Product Support team and overall accountability for support service excellence. This includes defining support processes, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and coordinating with shared support and maintenance functions to ensure seamless collaboration and the delivery of reliable 24/7 customer support within SLA targets.

Your mandate is simple to state and demanding to deliver: every client should be well supported, getting real value from our products, and happy to recommend us. You will build the Customer Success function largely from the ground up, give the business a clear, data driven view of client health and raise the standard of our support operation.

The role is deliberately hands-on in the first year. Alongside building the team and the operating model, you will personally manage key customer relationships, lead critical escalations and work directly with the support team on day-to-day operations until the new processes and team are fully established.

Responsibilities:

**Lead Product Support**

* Define and run support processes covering triage, prioritization, SLAs, incident and problem management, root cause analysis and knowledge management, in close alignment with SaaS Operations and Engineering.
* Improve the speed and quality of incident and problem management, as well as how customers perceive it.
* Use monitoring, data and AI to move support from reactive to proactive, increasing self service and first contact resolution.
* Build a support model that scales with the customer base.

**Build and run the Customer Success function**

* Define and run the customer success operating model: customer segmentation and coverage, engagement playbooks, a common account plan and a customer health score.
* Set the rhythm of customer engagement, including onboarding reviews, regular service reviews, executive business reviews and renewal planning.
* Build a joint customer success model across SBS product lines and regions.

**Orchestrate the customer experience**

* Act as the single point of accountability for the customer experience across Support, Customer Success and delivery teams.
* Ensure customer experience responsiveness, predictability and transparency on incidents, releases and roadmap commitments.
* Own escalation management, personally leading critical escalations through to resolution and clear communication with the client.
* Work with Professional Services to ensure a smooth handover from project to run, so every go live lands well.

**Elevate customer satisfaction and retention**

* Run proactive health reviews and early risk detection, with clear recovery plans for accounts at risk.
* Own the voice of the customer: CSAT and NPS programs, app store ratings and structured feedback loops into Product.
* Contribute to the SBS Customer Satisfaction Program and embed the Golden Disciplines across customer-facing teams.
* Protect renewals by working with Account Managers well ahead of renewal dates, so there are no surprises.

**Maximize product adoption and realized value**

* Track usage and adoption across products and modules, and identify underused features and adoption gaps.
* Run adoption plans with customers to unlock more of the value they have already bought.
* Measure and demonstrate tangible ROI to client executives through regular value reviews.
* Bring structured customer insight into roadmap prioritization with Product Leaders.

**Surface growth opportunities**

* Identify new use cases, additional modules and upgrade opportunities within the installed base.
* Channel qualified upsell and expansion leads to Account Managers, and build a pipeline originated by the CSM team over time.

Qualifications:

* At least 10 years in enterprise software or fintech, including at least 5 years leading Customer Success, Support or Service Delivery teams.
* Strong track record in banking or financial services software, ideally in digital banking, open banking, payments or lending.
* Experience managing both SaaS and customer managed (on premise) clients, including SLA governance and major incident management.
* Credible with bank executives and comfortable leading difficult conversations when things go wrong.
* Experience across the Middle East and Africa, ideally with exposure to the US and Europe. Knowledge of the GCC banking market is a strong plus.
* Comfortable working in a matrix organization and influencing teams that do not report directly to them.
* Hands-on leader who can operate at executive level while confidently diving into the operational and technical details as required.
* Commercially astute, technically capable, and credible in banking conversations with both business and technology stakeholders.

Skills

* Operational discipline and a data driven approach to managing a client portfolio.
* Working knowledge of ITIL practices, support tooling such as Jira Service Management or ServiceNow, and customer success platforms such as Gainsight or equivalent.
* Technical enough to engage with Engineering on root causes across APIs, cloud platforms and mobile applications.
* Genuine interest in using AI and automation to improve support and customer success at scale.
* Strong understanding of banking operations, banking products and the realities of running software in regulated financial institutions.
* Clear, confident communicator in writing and in person.
* Fluent English. French or Arabic is an advantage.

Education

* Degree in business, engineering, computer science or a related field. ITIL or customer success certification is a plus.

Company Overview:

**Company Overview**

At SBS, we’re more than just a technology company, we’re a global fintech partner helping banks and financial institutions transform, innovate, and grow. With over 5,000 employees worldwide and clients in more than 80 countries, our solutions power everything from digital banking and lending to payments and core banking systems.

As part of **74Software**, we’re backed by a group of leading software companies delivering mission-critical solutions worldwide. Our focus is on delivering long-term value, leveraging cutting-edge technology, and fostering strong client partnerships. Join us and be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team shaping the future of finance.

**Why SBS?**

At SBS, we’re committed to supporting our employees in every aspect of their lives, from health and wellbeing to financial security and lifestyle perks.

We offer benefits that allow you to thrive at work and beyond, including health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, flexible work, career development, competitive pay, and global culture perks.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

We are committed to providing equal opportunities and ensuring a fair and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, race, religion, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Client Consulting Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. The core client segments of VCA include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.

Role Summary:

The Analyst for Digital, Strategy and AI supports the delivery of digital transformation, strategy and artificial intelligence (AI) engagements across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region.

  

The Digital, Strategy and AI Consulting practice is a team of experts specializing in strategy and digital transformation topics, including but not limited to:

Strategy:

* Defining business, segment, channel and functional strategies, such as digital banking, affluent banking, loyalty, open finance, stablecoins and artificial intelligence.

Ideation:

* Supporting the innovation agenda of clients through foresight, strategic trends research and co-creation activities.

Value proposition design:

* Developing holistic offerings, including products, services and customer experience, for strategic consumer, business and corporate customer segments.

Customer experience and engagement:

* Developing best-in-class digital customer journeys and engagement strategies, including digital onboarding, end-to-end digital journey transformation, digital channel benchmarking and user interface and user experience enhancement.

Performance analytics:

* Improving client performance and process efficiency by deploying data, digital and AI tools.

Digital delivery:

* Supporting clients with the implementation of digital strategies, including the design and development of digital channels, generative AI (GenAI) use cases and proofs of concept.

Key Responsibilities:

* As an Analyst, you will work within project teams under the guidance of senior consultants and managers, contributing to research, analysis and the development of client deliverables.
* Support the delivery of digital, strategy and AI projects across the GCC, from scoping through to final recommendations.
* Conduct market, competitor and customer research, including benchmarking and trends analysis, to inform client recommendations.
* Gather, clean and analyze data from Visa and industry sources to generate insights that support client recommendations.
* Contribute to the problem-solving process, including structuring analytical frameworks and developing insight-driven recommendations.
* Build business cases and financial models that measure business performance and quantify return on investment (ROI).
* Prepare clear and compelling client presentations and reports that communicate findings and recommendations.
* Support the preparation and running of client workshops and stakeholder sessions, and document findings, decisions and next steps.
* Track project workplans and deliverables, and keep the project leadership informed of progress, risks and issues.
* Collaborate with Visa Account Executives and the Product, Value-Added Services (VAS), Marketing and other internal teams to deliver integrated solutions as One Visa.
* Contribute to proposals and responses to requests for proposal (RFPs), as well as practice thought leadership, points of view and case studies.
* Help build reusable toolkits, templates and best practice documents that can be applied across the VCA practice.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* At least 2 years of work experience in management consulting, preferably on financial services, payments, digital or AI projects.
* Degree from a leading university, preferably in business, economics, engineering, computer science or a related field.
* Professional proficiency in English.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, including building clear and compelling presentations, financial models and data analyses.
* Strong curiosity about AI, including GenAI and agentic AI, with hands-on experience using AI tools for research, analysis or content creation and an understanding of how to use them responsibly.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience working on projects in the GCC region.
* Exposure to digital transformation, strategy or digital banking projects.
* Knowledge of banking products, services, operations; payment schemes, services, card issuing and marketing initiatives.
* Strong interest in fintech and payments.
* Proficiency in Arabic is a plus.

What You Will Need to Be Successful:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex problems and work with large data sets.
* Strong storytelling skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear and compelling presentations.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of the financial indicators used to measure business performance.
* A collaborative, diplomatic and flexible working style, with the ability to work effectively in a matrixed organization.
* High attention to detail and a commitment to deliverables quality.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines at the same time.
* Curiosity and a willingness to learn, take on feedback and develop new skills quickly.
* Ability to build strong working relationships with clients and colleagues.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

**Description**

At the **International Finance Corporation (IFC)**, a member of the **World Bank Group (WBG)**, you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

The CFO and Capital Mobilization Vice Presidency, led by IFC’s Vice President and CFO, mobilizes private capital at scale to support clients that create jobs and drive growth in emerging markets. It brings together debt and equity mobilization, investor engagement, blended finance, and partnerships functions to expand the pool of capital available for development, while also overseeing the Corporation’s financial strategy and reporting, balance sheet management, and treasury functions. This prudent financial stewardship safeguards IFC’s AAA credit rating and ensures discipline, transparency, and alignment with institutional priorities.

Looking ahead, the VPU’s vision is to channel private capital into the sectors with the greatest potential to create jobs by embedding Originate-to-Distribute (OtD) approaches into IFC’s operating model, deepening and diversifying engagement with investors, donors, and development partners, and delivering innovative financial solutions that attract institutional capital to emerging markets. It will leverage data, technology, and market expertise to scale impact and improve efficiency.

As IFC continues to scale its impact and mobilize private capital at scale, in support of the WBG goal of creating jobs that lift people out of poverty, its ability to attract long term institutional investors to invest in IFC-originated emerging market assets has become increasingly central to its operating and financial model. In the context of heightened global uncertainty, constrained public resources, and rising development needs, effective engagement with institutional investors is critical to creating jobs, and sustaining and expanding development impact across emerging markets.

IFC’s originate-to-distribute and capital mobilization initiatives—including securitization, the Managed Co Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP), B Loan syndications, parallel loans, private equity funds and anchor bond investing, thematic bond issuances, blended finance facilities, and other structured mobilization vehicles—have expanded substantially in recent years, reflecting IFC’s strong focus on originating assets that both meet World Bank Group’s development mandate and are consistent with the investment preferences of institutional investors.

To support this strategically critical agenda, IFC is seeking Principal Investor Relations Officers in IFC’s Global Investor Relations function to work in collaboration with IFC’s originate-to-distribute (OtD) initiative and to help embed OtD into the operating model of IFC, by leading and strengthening IFC’s global investor engagement approach. The role will be to lead IFC’s critical institutional investor relationships, positioning IFC as a partner of choice for institutional investors while embedding scalable, best-in-class investor relationship management practices across the organization.

The Principal Investor Relations Officer will be responsible for deepening long-term investor relationships, expanding and diversifying IFC’s investor base, aligning investor mandates with IFC’s mobilization priorities, strengthening IFC’s visibility and credibility in global capital markets, integrating investor intelligence into institutional decision-making, and institutionalizing robust systems, governance, and standards for investor relationship management.

This vacancy announcement is for nine (9) positions posted across multiple duty stations. The selected candidates’ duty stations will be determined based on organizational requirements and business needs.

**Duties and Accountabilities:**

The selected candidate is responsible for performing activities in the following areas:

Own day-to-day IFC relationships with assigned Tier 1 and Tier 2 investors, under the Director’s executive sponsorship for the most significant relationships and expand participation in IFC-originated assets by connecting investor demand with IFC opportunities and the Originate-to-Distribute agenda.

**Relationship ownership & growth responsibilities:**

* Serve as accountable owner and primary point of contact for assigned investors. Where designated as geography Team Lead, lead and coordinate the other officers in the regional hub.
* Map investor interests and identify opportunities across IFC products, platforms and programs.
* Build trusted senior relationships and coordinate integrated engagement with product, regional, industry, transaction and country teams.
* Sponsor priority platforms, roadshows, investor education and external engagements for assigned relationships

**Planning, reviews & execution responsibilities:**

* Develop customized engagement plans, including strategic dialogues, co-investment discussions, site visits, reporting, events and investor education.
* Lead MOUs, frameworks, and commercial terms, subject to Legal clearance and authorized approval/signature.
* Lead onboarding and coordinate KYC and due diligence logistics.
* Conduct quarterly business and annual strategic reviews and maintain accurate Salesforce records and relationship updates.
* Support syndication and structuring teams while engaging with investors.

**Demand, risk & coordination responsibilities:**

* Capture risk appetite, pricing, tenor, sector interests and other actionable demand signals.
* Consolidate and propose relationship risk limits for funds, subsidiaries and insurers and assess financial sustainability.
* Communicate structured investor feedback to Syndications, with the OTD Analytical Team supporting consolidation and analysis.
* Advise underwriting and structuring on investor demand; designated authorities retain decisions. Participate occasionally in OtD or strategy meetings when relevant.
* Ensure that investor engagement activities are conducted in accordance with IFC policies, World Bank Group ethical standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Compliance teams on investor agreements, side letters, and co-investment arrangements.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master’s degree or MBA, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* A minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience of increasing complexity and responsibility in institutional investor relations, capital markets, private markets, asset management, investment banking, or related areas.
* Extensive experience developing and managing senior-level relationships with institutiona

Dubai, Dubai, AE Management Permanent ID: 102331

  

### **Description**

Operating in the UAE for over 50 years, CBD manages the financial requirements of some of the largest corporates and businesses operating in the country, driving the UAE economy. Over the years, CBD has transformed into a progressive and modern banking institution winning multiple awards for its digital initiatives, credit cards, bank accounts, mobile app features and services.

CBD has been recognized as the number one bank in the UAE on the Forbes list of The World’s Best Banks 2022.

As we continue to build upon our successes, we are looking for ambitious individuals who are passionate about the banking and finance industry and the markets in which CBD operates. Just as important to us is your ability to demonstrate a talent for dealing with people - your colleagues and our customers and delivering service that really goes the extra mile.

  
  

**Job Purpose:**

The Credit Card Portfolio Manager will be responsible for managing the performance, growth, and profitability of the bank’s credit card portfolio, with a strategic focus on developing and driving instalment plan products. This includes lifecycle management, customer engagement, pricing strategies, and cross-functional collaboration to enhance product uptake and usage

**Principal Accountabilities:**

**Portfolio Strategy & Growth**

Develop and execute strategies to grow the credit card portfolio through instalment plan offerings (e.g., Cash on Card, EPP or post-purchase conversions including statement balances).

Analyze customer behavior and transaction data to identify opportunities for instalment plan adoption- especially through building strong propensity models

Monitor portfolio KPIs including activation, usage, balances, and profitability.

**Instalment Plan Development**

Design and launch new instalment products tailored to customer segments and merchant partnerships.

Collaborate with product, risk, and technology teams to ensure seamless customer experience and operational efficiency.

Optimize pricing, tenures, and merchant discount rates to drive uptake across channels including telesales and digital establishing excellence in offering across the industry

**Risk & Compliance**

Work closely with credit risk teams to ensure instalment plans are aligned with underwriting policies and regulatory guidelines.

Monitor delinquency trends and implement proactive risk mitigation strategies.

**Customer Engagement & Marketing**

Partner with marketing and analytics teams to develop targeted campaigns promoting instalment plans.

Drive digital adoption through app-based and online instalment conversion journeys.

**Stakeholder Management**

Liaise with internal stakeholders including finance, operations, legal, and compliance to ensure product success.

Manage relationships with external partners such as merchants, networks

  

### **Requirements**

**Education and Experience**

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics or related field; MBA preferred.

5+ years of experience in credit card portfolio management or consumer lending.

Strong understanding of instalment lending, credit risk, and customer lifecycle management.

Analytical mindset with proficiency in data tools (Excel, SQL, SAS, etc.).

Excellent communication and project management skills.

jobs.title: Product Stream Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations
Senior Product Lead
jobs.description:
**Organization:**
At CommBank, you will work in an environment that aims to combine the scale and responsibility of Australia's leading bank with empowered, product-led teams. Our best teams are outcome-focused and take end-to-end ownership. That means staying close to the customer problem, using evidence to make decisions, being clear about trade-offs, learning quickly and owning what we build through its full lifecycle. It also means delivering safely and sustainably: risk, resilience and controls are part of good product design, not something added at the end. We value people who demonstrate Care, Courage and Commitment. You will have the opportunity to work on a material payments problem, own an important product area within a new strategic capability, collaborate with deep payments and technology specialists, and explore how automation and emerging AI can responsibly transform payment servicing.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Senior Product Lead
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Business & Team:**
As Product Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations, you will own a defined product area within the broader Payment Exceptions & Investigations product stream. Working within the product strategy and direction established for the stream, you will translate customer and operational problems into clear product outcomes, priorities and an executable roadmap for your squad. You will lead the product lifecycle for your area from discovery and problem definition through delivery, adoption, run performance and continuous optimisation. You will make evidence-based trade-offs across customer value, operational efficiency, risk, technology and delivery considerations, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Architecture, Payments Operations, frontline teams, Risk and other specialist teams.
  
  
You will work closely with other Product Leads and Product Managers across the PEX stream to ensure your product area contributes to coherent end-to-end payment exception journeys and reusable capabilities rather than creating isolated solutions.
  
  
**Impact & contribution:**
As a Product Lead within the Payments Channel and Reporting Crew, you will work closely with the business to deliver exceptional outcomes for our business stakeholders and customers. You will be responsible for developing and delivering customer reporting capability for the Payments Domain. This will incorporate the delivery of reports, modernisation of existing reporting capabilities and development of the strategic roadmap for future state delivery. You will be leading a team of engineering experts to achieve this, while creating a psychologically safe, inclusive, accountable and high-performance culture, and working collaboratively within and across Crews.
  
  
**Reporting lines:**
Dhivya Elanchezhian – Senior Product Capability Lead
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Own and evolve the product vision, outcomes and roadmap for a defined Payment Exceptions & Investigations product area, aligned to the overall PEX product strategy.
* Deeply understand the customer, colleague and operational problems within your product area through discovery, data, research and engagement with frontline and operational teams.
* Translate those problems into clearly defined product opportunities, measurable outcomes and prioritised initiatives.
* Own squad-level prioritisation and roadmap decisions, balancing customer value, operational efficiency, risk, technology, delivery constraints and expected business outcomes.
* Lead discovery and delivery of reusable product capabilities that contribute to the broader PEX target state rather than creating point solutions for individual processes or systems.
* Shape simple experiences for customers, bankers, investigators and payment operations colleagues within your product area.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Architecture on product and engineering trade-offs, feasibility, sequencing, integration and delivery confidence
* Identify opportunities to move journeys from manual handling toward assisted resolution and straight-through processing where policy, evidence and controls support it.
* Explore practical applications of automation and AI for use cases such as context reconstruction, classification, summarisation, investigation support, next-best-action and response drafting.
* Ensure AI-enabled and automated outcomes within your product area are explainable, evidence-backed, auditable and appropriately bounded by human accountability and risk controls.Use customer, operational and product data to understand product performance, identify recurring pain points and continuously optimise outcomes.Define and own measurable product outcomes relevant to your area, which may include resolution time, straightthrough-processing rate, repeat contact, touches per case, queue ageing, SLA performance, customer-update timeliness, control effectiveness and colleague adoption.Embed risk, controls, regulatory and operational resilience considerations throughout discovery, design, delivery and ongoing product management.Lead and develop Product Managers within your squad/product area and contribute to strong product discipline across the broader PEX stream.Partner with other PEX Product Leads and Product Managers to manage dependencies and deliver consistent endto-end customer and colleague outcomes.

**Essential Skills:**
We’re interested in hearing from people who:
  
  

* Bring strong product management and product leadership experience, with a track record of taking complex products from discovery through delivery, adoption and continuous optimisation.
* Have payments domain knowledge, ideally across Australian domestic and/or international payments, payment processing, exceptions or servicing.
* Understand, or are able to develop strong knowledge of, payment ecosystems such as NPP, BECS/Direct Entry, BPAY, RTGS/HVCS, SWIFT and international/correspondent banking.
* Have experience with payment investigations, trace and recall, returns, repairs, failed payments, mistaken payments or related exception-servicing journeys.
* Have worked with complex workflow, case-management, servicing, operational or platform products, preferably within a regulated financial-services environment.
* Demonstrate strong product discovery, customer research, roadmap, prioritisation and lifecycle-management disciplines.
* Can turn complex customer and operational problems into simple product propositions and pragmatic delivery increments.
* Are comfortable making evidence-based trade-offs across customer value, operational outcomes, technology, risk and delivery considerations.
* Build strong partnerships across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk and customer-facing teams.Understand risk, controls and operational resilience and embed them into product decisions rather than treating them as downstream gates.
* Are curious about automation, AI and emerging technologies and can identify where they create genuine customer or operational value.
* Coach Product Managers, create clarity through ambiguity and build collaborative, outcome-focused teams

**Years of Experience:**
11+
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Product Lead with business/product background and payments domain expertise.
  
  
**Qualifications:**
B.Tech

**Job Description**
Global Merchant & Network Services brings together American Express' merchant and network-related businesses, including relationships with merchants, issuers, acquirers, processors, and strategic partners globally.
  
  
The Network Product team develops and delivers secure, resilient, and scalable payment network capabilities. This includes Authorization, Tokenization, Authentication, Digital Wallets, Local Network solutions, and Network-to-Network integrations that support market expansion, regulatory requirements, and global interoperability.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Network Product professional to drive the development and delivery of strategic payment network capabilities. The role requires strong knowledge of payment networks, issuing, acquiring, transaction processing, and digital payments, along with the ability to translate business and partner needs into clear product requirements and executable delivery plans.
  
  
Strong project management, communication, and stakeholder management skills are critical. The individual will coordinate cross-functional workstreams, manage risks and dependencies, drive governance, and communicate progress and decisions effectively to senior leaders, internal teams, and external partners.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute product roadmaps for payment network capabilities aligned with enterprise priorities, market needs, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead end-to-end delivery of capabilities across Authorization, Tokenization, Authentication, Digital Wallets, Local Network solutions, and Network-to-Network integrations.
* Translate business, customer, partner, and regulatory needs into features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery milestones.
* Apply strong understanding of payment networks, issuing, acquiring, processing, transaction flows, and network specifications to guide product decisions.
* Ensure solutions meet intended business outcomes and consider scalability, security, resilience, operational readiness, and interoperability.
* Partner with Engineering and Quality Assurance teams across solution design, development, testing, implementation, and post-launch readiness.
* Maintain integrated delivery plans covering scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and decisions.
* Coordinate execution across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and external partner teams.
* Proactively identify delivery risks and blockers, drive mitigation, and escalate matters requiring leadership attention.
* Prepare concise executive updates, dashboards, roadmaps, and governance materials, translating complex topics for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Build trusted relationships and influence decisions across global, cross-functional, and highly matrixed teams.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualification**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business Management, or related field.
* Relevant experience in payment network products, digital payments, product management, network delivery, or payment technology.
* Strong understanding of the payment's ecosystem, including networks, issuers, acquirers, processors, and digital payment providers.
* Knowledge of payment transaction flows and capabilities such as authorization, authentication, tokenization, clearing, and settlement.
* Experience delivering products or capabilities through requirements, development, testing, implementation, and operational readiness.
* Demonstrated project or program management experience across multiple teams, workstreams, risks, and dependencies.
* Ability to translate business requirements into clear product and technical deliverables.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, executive communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and highly matrixed environment.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Demonstrated experience working with payment networks, issuers, acquirers, processors, digital wallet providers, or network capability modernization programs is strongly preferred.
* Experience with Authorization, Tokenization, Authentication, SafeKey, Digital Wallets, Local Network solutions, or Network-to-Network integrations.
* Knowledge of card processing, payment message flows, network specifications, and payment operations.
* Experience delivering complex modernization, migration, regulatory, or market-enablement initiatives.
* Experience managing product roadmaps, backlogs, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience with Agile or SAFe delivery methodologies and knowledge of Rally, JIRA, Confluence, or similar tools.

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

jobs.title: Business Head - Navi UPI
jobs.description:
**About Navi**

At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology-first products built at scale.

Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold – building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience.

Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes and one of India’s fastest-growing UPI platforms.

**What makes Navi different is the way we build. We move fast, solve real customer problems and give people the ownership to create meaningful impact early in their journey.**

**Why Explore a Career at Navi?**

**Where Ownership Creates Real Impact**

At Navi, ownership starts early. People here are trusted to solve problems, make decisions and drive outcomes that directly shape the products and experiences used by millions of customers every day.

**Where Careers Accelerate**

Growth at Navi is driven by impact, not tenure. We strongly believe in promoting from within and creating opportunities for people to take on larger responsibilities as they grow. If you consistently raise the bar, you’ll find the space to grow quickly here.

**Where Great Talent Builds Together**

We take pride in building high talent-density teams where ambitious people learn from one another every day. Working on high-scale business and technology problems creates steep learning curves, fast execution cycles and opportunities to make visible impact throughout your journey.

**About the Team**

Since launching in August 2023, Navi UPI has grown from strength to strength to become India’s fourth-largest UPI TPAP. In a crowded market with large incumbents, Navi UPI has been able to capture a significant market share and win the loyalty of users on the back of a customer-first, product-led strategy. Our mission is clear: build on this foundation and become a leading and dominant player in India’s payments landscape.

**About the Role**

As Business Head, you will drive:

* The core acquisition engine of the group, bridging efforts across teams including product, growth, engineering, data and marketing; and
* The go-to-market strategy and execution of our to-be-launched PA (Payment Aggregator, i.e. merchant acquisition) business.

You will also act as the primary point of contact for our key partners and stakeholders including NPCI and work closely with our compliance, fraud, risk and engineering teams to ensure we deliver a stable and reliable experience to our customers. As a leader, you will be responsible for overseeing cross-functional efforts to build the Navi UPI user base, increase its loyalty and grow market share.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* Proven experience in driving outcomes in business, sales, operations or other generalist roles;
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions and measure impact / ROI;
* Entrepreneurial mindset and work ethic with high ownership and comfort operating in a 0-to-1 setup;
* Sharp attention to detail and a strategic mindset for long-term process optimisation;
* Ability to think outside the box and be comfortable dealing with unstructured problem statements;
* Exceptional leadership, team management, collaboration and communication skills; and
* Adaptability to navigate the evolving payments landscape, leveraging new trends and technologies to drive innovation.

**Soft Skills & Traits**

To succeed in this role, you will need to:

* Operate with speed, ownership and a builder mindset—constantly challenging the status quo to scale our UPI and, eventually, PA businesses;
* Lead end-to-end program management, ensuring timely delivery, execution excellence and speedy resolution of issues;
* Constantly design, execute and iterate experiments to test new ideas and identify the most effective approaches to drive business growth or cost optimisation;
* Leverage data to identify pockets of inefficiency and opportunity and influence stakeholders and leaders across the organisation;
* Partner with marketing, product, analytics, data science, FRS (Fraud Risk & Strategy), compliance and finance teams to ensure delivery of key business goals;
* Lead, manage and mentor a lean and dynamic team, and foster a culture of collaboration that ensures each team member contributes effectively to Navi's goals;
* Build and manage relationships with key stakeholders such as NPCI, PSP banks and other partners to ensure Navi UPI’s strategic goals are being met; and
* Collaborate with our FRS), Data and Engineering teams to drive our Trust & Safety (TnS) and reliability agendas.

**The Navi OS**

The Navi OS is our Operating System for how we work every day. Success at Navi is defined by living these core values.

* Start with the Customer
* Master the Details
* Act with Urgency
* Own the Outcome
* Build for a Decade - Not a Day
* Win as One

We hire talented individuals who already show these strengths, because those who share these values thrive at Navi and grow with the organisation.

To read more about the Navi OS, visit
navi.com/our-values

**Life at Navi**

Life at Navi is fast-paced, ambitious and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable.

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through flexible leave policies, strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, ESOPs and a workplace designed for both productivity and well-being.

Whether it’s the sports turf, gym, focus zone or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable.

If you’d like to know more about life at Navi, our culture and employee benefits, head to our careers page:
navi.com/careers/life-at-navi

If solving meaningful problems, building at scale and growing alongside ambitious teams excites you,

**Navi could be the place for you.**

jobs.title: Head Of Product
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Senior Manager-Digital Product Management
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Global Merchant & Network Services brings together American Express' merchant and network-related businesses, including relationships with merchants, issuers, acquirers, processors, and strategic partners globally.
  
  
The Network Product team develops and delivers secure, resilient, and scalable payment network capabilities. This includes Authorization, Tokenization, Authentication, Digital Wallets, Local Network solutions, and Network-to-Network integrations that support market expansion, regulatory requirements, and global interoperability.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Network Product professional to drive the development and delivery of strategic payment network capabilities. The role requires strong knowledge of payment networks, issuing, acquiring, transaction processing, and digital payments, along with the ability to translate business and partner needs into clear product requirements and executable delivery plans.
  
  
Strong project management, communication, and stakeholder management skills are critical. The individual will coordinate cross-functional workstreams, manage risks and dependencies, drive governance, and communicate progress and decisions effectively to senior leaders, internal teams, and external partners.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute product roadmaps for payment network capabilities aligned with enterprise priorities, market needs, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead end-to-end delivery of capabilities across Authorization, Tokenization, Authentication, Digital Wallets, Local Network solutions, and Network-to-Network integrations.
* Translate business, customer, partner, and regulatory needs into features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery milestones.
* Apply strong understanding of payment networks, issuing, acquiring, processing, transaction flows, and network specifications to guide product decisions.
* Ensure solutions meet intended business outcomes and consider scalability, security, resilience, operational readiness, and interoperability.
* Partner with Engineering and Quality Assurance teams across solution design, development, testing, implementation, and post-launch readiness.
* Maintain integrated delivery plans covering scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and decisions.
* Coordinate execution across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and external partner teams.
* Proactively identify delivery risks and blockers, drive mitigation, and escalate matters requiring leadership attention.
* Prepare concise executive updates, dashboards, roadmaps, and governance materials, translating complex topics for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Build trusted relationships and influence decisions across global, cross-functional, and highly matrixed teams.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business Management, or related field.
* Relevant experience in payment network products, digital payments, product management, network delivery, or payment technology.
* Strong understanding of the payment's ecosystem, including networks, issuers, acquirers, processors, and digital payment providers.
* Knowledge of payment transaction flows and capabilities such as authorization, authentication, tokenization, clearing, and settlement.
* Experience delivering products or capabilities through requirements, development, testing, implementation, and operational readiness.
* Demonstrated project or program management experience across multiple teams, workstreams, risks, and dependencies.
* Ability to translate business requirements into clear product and technical deliverables.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, executive communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and highly matrixed environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience working with payment networks, issuers, acquirers, processors, digital wallet providers, or network capability modernization programs is strongly preferred.
* Experience with Authorization, Tokenization, Authentication, SafeKey, Digital Wallets, Local Network solutions, or Network-to-Network integrations.
* Knowledge of card processing, payment message flows, network specifications, and payment operations.
* Experience delivering complex modernization, migration, regulatory, or market-enablement initiatives.
* Experience managing product roadmaps, backlogs, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience with Agile or SAFe delivery methodologies and knowledge of Rally, JIRA, Confluence, or similar tools.
* Experience engaging with external network partners, processors, vendors, or payment ecosystem participants.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
  
  
Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

* Strong technical judgment and ability to partner with ML/ranking teams on signal quality, bidding systems, and delivery optimization

* Exceptional cross-functional leadership: ability to drive alignment across engineering, data science, design, sales, partnerships, and policy

* Experience in building and scaling early-stage growth efforts

About Meta:
  
  
Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. jobs.title: Digital Channels Cash Product Lead
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

* Own the Cash product agenda across the Digital channels, with strategic accountability for translating Cash and Payments priorities into scalable capabilities across Host-to-Host (H2H), SWIFT and Common Channel Services (CCS).
* Lead the development, prioritisation and commercialisation of channel capabilities and features, ensuring investment is anchored in clear client use cases, measurable commercial value, regulatory needs and end-to-end client outcomes.
* Lead and develop a team of Product Owners to convert strategy into an executable global roadmap and deliver consistent, secure and reusable Cash Digital capabilities across markets, client segments and connectivity models.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy, portfolio and business partnership**

* Own the global Cash channel strategy and roadmap across Web, H2H, SWIFT and CCS, aligning country, regional and global demand to business priorities.
* Act as the senior Channels counterpart to Cash Product heads and represent the portfolio in senior governance, investment and prioritisation forums.
* Partner with global, regional and country Cash Product heads to understand business, client and product priorities in every market.
* Manage senior stakeholders across global product and country management, Channels and Technology, setting expectations on scope, timing and trade-offs. Make transparent trade-offs across growth, client commitments, regulatory or scheme deadlines, resilience, simplification and platform modernisation.

**Product execution and prioritisation**

* Own the global Cash backlog for Channels and rank demand using commercial value, client impact, regulatory urgency, risk, effort and delivery feasibility.
* Lead the working relationship between Cash, country, Channel Product and Technology teams to agree scope, dependencies, release plans and accountable outcomes.
* Run one intake process for all demand, sorting each request, assess client requests tied to mandates /RFPs and implementation deadlines, track regulatory requirements against deadlines.
* Apply a clear prioritisation framework, ringfence capacity across regulatory, client driven scope on revenue and client priority, and sequence delivery. Spot common needs across markets to deliver them as global capabilities.
* Maintain executive oversight of multiple initiatives running in parallel across markets, products and channels, keep a portfolio view of status, risks, milestones and cross-channel dependencies, intervening early where delivery or value is at risk.

**Client insight, proposition and commercialisation**

* Build evidence-based country and client use cases covering target segments, revenue and volumes at stake, adoption barriers, competitive gaps and the cost of not acting.
* Define differentiated value propositions and commercialisation plans for new capabilities, partnering with Sales, Implementation, Onboarding and Client Service to drive launch readiness and adoption.
* Track adoption, transaction volumes, client feedback and realised benefits after launch, using insights to refine the proposition and roadmap.

**Cross-channel capability and solution leadership**

* Translate Cash and Payments needs into end-to-end capabilities spanning digital journeys, entitlements, approvals, connectivity, formats, payment status and reporting.
* Guide solutioning across H2H connectivity (SFTP, AS2 and HTTPS), SWIFT channels (FileAct, FIN and gpi), ISO 20022 messages and legacy or local clearing formats.
* Promote reusable components, standard formats and common services while safeguarding security, resilience, sanctions, fraud, accessibility and regulatory requirements.

**People and talent**

* Lead, coach and develop Product Owners, translating strategy into clear objectives and allocating capacity to the highest-value work.
* Build strategic, commercial, client and channel depth across the team, strengthening prioritisation, stakeholder management, product discipline and succession capacity.
* Role-model the Bank’s valued behaviours, sound risk judgement, constructive feedback, inclusion, wellbeing and accountability.

**Risk, controls and governance**

* Embed product, operational, information security, regulatory and conduct requirements throughout discovery, design, delivery, release and post-launch review.
* Ensure material decisions, exceptions, residual risks and control dependencies are appropriately governed and documented.
* Maintain accurate client-facing specifications, user guidance, release notes, testing support and migration plans for new or changed capabilities.

**Skills And Experience**
**Must-have Skills**

* Cash and Payments Product Strategy
* Digital Channels and Corporate Connectivity
* Product Commercialisation and Value Proposition

**Other Skills**

* Portfolio Prioritisation and Investment Discipline
* Client and Market Insight
* Senior Stakeholder Influence
* People Leadership and Product Team Development

**Motivations**

* Shaping client-channel strategy and turning complex Cash and Payments needs into scalable propositions with visible commercial and client value.
* Leading across business, product and technology boundaries to resolve competing priorities and deliver high-impact outcomes across markets.
* Building empowered Product Owner teams that combine deep channel expertise with strategic thinking, disciplined execution and strong client focus.

**Qualifications**
**Key Experiences**

* 15+ years of senior-level experience in Transaction Banking, Cash Management, Payments or enterprise digital channels, including product strategy, proposition development, commercialisation and execution.
* Deep experience in corporate connectivity and more than one client channel, with working knowledge of H2H, SWIFT, APIs and corporate Web banking.
* Strong Cash and Payments domain understanding across domestic and cross-border payments, real-time and bulk payments, payroll, receivables, liquidity, statements and reporting.
* Working command of ISO 20022 payment and reporting messages, legacy MT formats, local clearing formats, and ERP or treasury management system integration.
* Demonstrated experience building business cases, prioritising investments and managing multiple initiatives across countries, products and channels.
* Strong experience in Portfolio management at scale, running a large backlog with many initiatives in parallel, while sharing limited delivery capacity across countries and demand types.
* Proven leadership of Product Owners or Product Managers and senior-level influence across Product, Sales, Technology, Operations, Risk and Compliance.

**Certifications / Qualifications (only where mandatory):**
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in business, finance, engineering, computer science or a related discipline. No role-specific certification is mandatory.
  
  
**Languages:**
English: professional fluency. Additional languages are advantageous where relevant to the role’s market coverage.
  
  
**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Core bank funding

At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.
  
  
As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.

If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.
  
  
**About the Role:**
This isn’t a typical Head of Product role. The expectation is not just to optimize flows, but to fundamentally redefine how trading works for millions of users. You’ll step in at a critical inflection point, owning the next phase of growth for a platform already operating at scale. This role is about expanding into new product frontiers, unlocking new opportunities, and building category-defining trading experiences. * Worked in an agile environment or on the scrum methodology
* Passion for cryptocurrency, financial markets, and the CoinDCX mission

* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving

**Bengaluru**

**Job Description:**

**About the Role**

We are looking for Implementation Analysts Products to support the implementation and deployment of a SaaS-based Consent Management solution for Enterprise and Small & Medium-sized Business (SMB) clients.

  

The role involves working closely with clients, business stakeholders, product teams and technical teams to drive implementation activities from requirements gathering through go-live and hypercare.

The deployment location will be Mumbai, Delhi NCR or Bangalore, depending on the client's office locations. Each deployment is expected to last approximately 68 months, and candidates may subsequently be deployed on other client projects.

Prior experience in Consent Management, DPDP or Cybersecurity is not mandatory, as product-specific training will be provided.

This is an early-career implementation role suitable for candidates with 1- 3 years of relevant experience.

  

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Support end-to-end implementation and deployment of a SaaS/product solution at client locations.
* Translate business requirements into configuration and implementation activities.
* Support product demonstrations, customer onboarding and configuration activities.
* Identify risks proactively, mitigate them and escalate as deemed appropriate.
* Coordinate integration discussions involving APIs, data flows, interfaces and technical dependencies.
* Manage SMB demo and implementation deals for the Consent Management solution, with a primary focus and special emphasis on supporting Free Plan users.
* Guide SMB customers through self-service setup, configuration and troubleshooting to ensure quick go-live and faster Time to Value.
* Gather feedback on product experience throughout the customer lifecycle through targeted surveys.
* Gather customer feedback and support continuous improvement of the implementation experience.
* Travel to and work from client locations for extended deployment periods, as required.

**Mandatory Skills & Eligibility Criteria**

* 1- 3 years of experience in technology products, SaaS or Cloud products, implementation or technology consulting.
* Prior exposure to customer onboarding, product demonstrations, technical support or pre-sales is preferred.
* Understanding of APIs and basic general technical architecture and components is a must.
* Good to have development experience in REST APIs, JavaScript and JSON/XML data structures.
* Understanding of Kubernetes, Docker and deployment workflows is preferred.
* Understanding of infrastructure components such as databases, queues, API gateways and firewalls is preferred.
* Willingness to learn on-premise deployment concepts and assist senior team members on enterprise accounts.
* Understanding of BFSI (Banking, Financial Services and Insurance) would be preferred.
* Fluency in English is mandatory; fluency in Hindi is preferable.
* Ability and willingness to travel to client locations for extended deployment periods.
* Willingness to undergo product-specific self-paced training and certification before deployment.
* Candidates must be currently based in Mumbai, Delhi NCR or Bangalore.

  

**Employment & Engagement Conditions**

* **The position is offered as a fixed-term contractual employment opportunity for a period of 12 months.**
* **The contract is non-extendable and non-renewable.**

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
============================================================

1. Senior Platform Engineer - Kubernetes & Operators

============================================================

The role

You'll build the Kubernetes Operators that automate how our platform components are deployed, configured, upgraded, scaled, backed up and recovered, and you'll help keep the clusters they run on healthy, secure and up to date. Expect to spend most of your time writing Go and the rest working on the platform itself. This is the most important profile in the team.

What you'll do

- Design and build Kubernetes Operators and custom controllers in Go, using Kubebuilder, Operator SDK or controller-runtime.

- Design CRDs properly: schema validation, versioning and conversion webhooks.

- Write reconcile loops that are idempotent and safe to re-run, with proper status conditions, finalizers, owner references and events.

- Build validating and mutating admission webhooks, and keep controller RBAC to the minimum it needs.

- Test your work thoroughly with unit tests, envtest integration tests and end-to-end tests on kind or minikube.

- Package and release Operators with Helm and OLM, and handle upgrades and rollbacks safely.

- Build, configure and upgrade Kubernetes/OpenShift clusters with Terraform, Helm and Kustomize.

- Run CI/CD and GitOps delivery for platform components using Jenkins, G3 and Flux.

- Look after cluster networking (CNI, Ingress, service mesh basics), storage (CSI, StatefulSets, persistent volumes) and multi-tenancy (namespaces, quotas, network policies).

- Apply platform security: Pod Security Standards, OPA Gatekeeper or Kyverno, image scanning, and secrets management with Vault or External Secrets.

- Make sure your controllers and platform components expose good metrics, logs and traces (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).

- Join the on-call rotation, help resolve incidents, and fix the root cause in code rather than working around it.

What we're looking for

- 8-12 years in software or platform engineering, with at least 3 years writing Go in production.

- At least 2 years building Kubernetes controllers or Operators that are actually running in production.

- A solid grasp of client-go and controller-runtime: informers, watches, work queues, caches and leader election.

- At least 4 years running Kubernetes in production. You should be comfortable with scheduling, networking, storage, RBAC, upgrades and troubleshooting.

- Hands-on with infrastructure as code and GitOps (Terraform, Helm, Flux or ArgoCD).

- Everyday use of CI/CD and container builds (Git, Jenkins, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, Docker).

- Strong Linux and networking debugging skills (processes, DNS, TLS).

It's a bonus if you have

- Experience with Red Hat OpenShift.

- Worked with well-known Operators such as Strimzi, the OpenTelemetry Operator, the Prometheus Operator, cert-manager or database Operators.

- Used Cluster API, Crossplane or similar tools.

- Run GKE, EKS or AKS.

- Contributed to CNCF or other open-source projects (please send your GitHub link).

- CKA, CKAD or CKS certification.

- Worked in banking or another regulated industry.

jobs.description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity.
