**Role Overview**
We are seeking a seasoned technology leader to serve as Senior Manager, Software Engineering. This role is accountable for end-to-end delivery across Azure Cloud, modern web applications, Salesforce, and payment platforms. The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise with disciplined execution, build high-performing engineering teams, and coordinate complex initiatives across multiple functions and geographies. This leader will translate business priorities into scalable technology outcomes while strengthening engineering practices, operational resilience, security, and accountability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end execution: Own planning, architecture alignment, engineering delivery, testing, release readiness, production launch, and post-production stabilization for a portfolio of strategic initiatives.
* Drive multi-platform delivery: Provide leadership across Azure Cloud services, web application ecosystems, Salesforce capabilities and integrations, and payment processing platforms.
* Translate strategy into outcomes: Partner with product, business, architecture, security, risk, operations, and infrastructure leaders to convert priorities into roadmaps, executable plans, and measurable results.
* Strengthen engineering excellence: Champion scalable architecture, secure coding, automation, CI/CD, observability, performance engineering, reliability, and disciplined software development lifecycle practices.
* Build high-performing teams: Recruit, develop, coach, and retain engineers; establish clear expectations, empower decision-making, and create succession and capability-development plans.
* Coordinate globally: Align teams, vendors, dependencies, and stakeholders across multiple geographies and time zones, ensuring clear ownership, effective handoffs, and timely escalation of risks and decisions.
* Manage delivery health: Establish transparent governance for scope, schedule, quality, budget, capacity, dependencies, risks, and technical debt; use metrics to guide decisions and continuous improvement.
* Own operational outcomes: Ensure platforms meet availability, resilience, security, compliance, recovery, and support expectations; lead effective incident response and root-cause remediation.
* Influence technology direction: Evaluate emerging technologies, guide build-versus-buy decisions, and shape modernization plans that balance innovation, maintainability, cost, and risk.
* Communicate with impact: Provide concise, data-driven updates to senior leaders and stakeholders, surfacing trade-offs and enabling timely decisions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven technology delivery experience, including significant experience leading engineering teams across multiple projects/initiatives in parallel.
* Demonstrated success delivering complex, enterprise-scale programs from concept through production and ongoing operations.
* Strong working knowledge of Azure Cloud architecture and services, cloud-native design, integration patterns, APIs, and DevSecOps practices.
* Experience overseeing modern web application delivery, including front-end, back-end, security, performance, accessibility, and production support considerations.
* Experience with Salesforce platforms, custom development, integrations, release management, and governance.
* Experience with payment ecosystems, including transaction flows, integrations, reconciliation, resiliency, security, and regulatory or control requirements.
* Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, resolve cross-team dependencies, and lead distributed teams across geographies.
* Strong financial, vendor, resource, risk, and change-management capabilities.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

Founder & CEO

KGIL is building a diversified technology ecosystem with products spanning fintech, digital lending, credit solutions and emerging consumer internet businesses.

Through SwipeLoan and our expanding portfolio of digital platforms, we aim to develop and scale technology-driven businesses across multiple industries.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on technology leader with
**CTO-level capabilities**
who can take complete ownership of technology strategy, architecture, engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity and product development across our growing ecosystem.

This is not a conventional IT management role.

The selected candidate must be capable of independently evaluating new business concepts, selecting appropriate technology stacks, designing scalable systems, building engineering teams and delivering end-to-end technology solutions.

We are looking for a technology generalist with deep engineering expertise who is comfortable working across different programming languages, frameworks, architectures and business domains.

The candidate should have the technical judgment and leadership ability to build products using both existing and emerging technologies, without being restricted to any single programming language or framework.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Technology Ownership**

* Own the complete technology function across existing and future KGIL platforms.
* Define long-term technology strategy, architecture standards and engineering roadmaps.

**2. Multi-Technology & Full-Stack Engineering Leadership**

Lead engineering across multiple technology stacks, including but not limited to:

* **Backend:**

* **Frontend:**
  React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular and modern frontend frameworks.
* **Mobile Applications:**
  Flutter, React Native, native Android and iOS development.
* **Databases:**

* **Cloud & Infrastructure:**

  REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, third-party APIs, payment gateways and external services.
* **AI & Automation:**
  AI/ML integrations, LLM-based applications, intelligent automation and data-driven product capabilities.

The candidate is not expected to write production code in every language personally but must possess sufficient architectural and technical depth to evaluate, guide and manage engineering teams working across different technology stacks.

**3. New Product Development & Technology Expansion**

* Lead technology development for new businesses across fintech and non-fintech industries.

* Design and deliver MVPs, scalable applications and enterprise-grade platforms.
* Lead development of consumer applications, marketplaces, subscription platforms, SaaS products, social networking applications and e-commerce solutions.
* Build reusable technology components, shared services and APIs wherever commercially appropriate.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, third-party platforms and outsourcing opportunities.
* Ensure new product launches meet defined timelines, budgets and quality standards.
* Support rapid experimentation, prototyping and product-market validation.

**4. Technology Architecture & Scalability**

* Design scalable, secure and high-performance application architectures.
* Make informed decisions between monolithic, modular and microservices architectures.
* Establish standards for API design, database architecture, system integrations and data management.
* Implement performance optimisation, caching, monitoring and system observability.
* Plan infrastructure capacity for high-volume applications and rapid user growth.
* Ensure appropriate system resilience, backup, disaster recovery and business continuity arrangements.
* Identify and resolve technical debt and architectural limitations.

**5. Engineering Team Leadership & Recruitment**

* Lead existing backend, frontend, mobile, QA, DevOps and AI/ML teams.
* Independently recruit developers, architects and technical specialists based on business requirements.
* Build and manage multiple engineering teams working on different products simultaneously.
* Establish clear reporting structures, engineering ownership and accountability.
* Define development standards, code review processes and technical documentation requirements.
* Conduct technical interviews and assess candidate capabilities across different technology stacks.
* Mentor engineering leads and develop future technology leaders.
* Manage internal development teams, freelancers, technology vendors and outsourced partners.

**6. DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Cybersecurity**

* Own cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, production environments and system monitoring.
* Manage AWS infrastructure and evaluate alternative cloud services where appropriate.
* Establish robust CI/CD, release management and automated testing processes.
* Implement cybersecurity controls, vulnerability management, access controls and secure development practices.
* Oversee incident response, disaster recovery and infrastructure reliability.
* Coordinate technical security requirements relating to ISO 27001, applicable data protection laws and regulatory obligations.
* Ensure company-controlled access to source code, repositories, servers, cloud accounts and technology assets.
* Monitor infrastructure expenditure and implement cost optimisation initiatives.

**7. Fintech & Third-Party Integrations**

* Oversee technology integrations with banks, NBFCs, credit bureaus, KYC providers, Account Aggregators, payment gateways and other financial technology service providers.
* Ensure reliability, security and performance of partner APIs.
* Support lending journeys, credit eligibility systems, subscription payments and automated financial workflows.
* Coordinate with business and compliance teams on technology-related regulatory requirements.

**8. Product, Business & Leadership Collaboration**

* Work closely with the Founder & CEO to evaluate and execute new business opportunities.
* Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Finance, Business Development and Operations teams.
* Provide technical recommendations in business planning and strategic discussions.
* Prepare technology budgets, development roadmaps and resource allocation plans.
* Communicate technical risks, dependencies and investment requirements clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Take independent ownership of technical execution while keeping management informed of major decisions.

**Candidate Requirements**

**Mandatory**

* 10–15+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 4–5 years in engineering leadership or architecture roles.
* Strong hands-on software engineering background with experience designing and scaling production app

--------

Share your **updated resume, preferred job location, and a brief summary of the national-brand campaigns you’ve handled**. Include the brand name, type of campaign, and what you managed on-site.

jobs.title: Vice President - Business Management, Design Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Our Business Management team acts as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and optimizes business performance by helping to drive key initiatives. We act as a counterweight to business and group heads and are responsible for identifying, escalating, and mitigating business risks. The role is dynamic and can vary from business to business, in line with the priorities of different lines of business. This is a time-pressured and high-profile position, instrumental in assisting and advising senior management. You will help coordinate the deployment of corporate resources to address strategic and tactical objectives.

Job summary

As a **Business Management** professional within the **Business Management team**, you will help drive strategic and tactical objectives by coordinating corporate resources and advising senior management. You will implement new business strategy, strategic initiatives, or platforms by aligning partners across Finance, Technology, Operations, Legal, and Compliance. You will optimize bottom-line performance by driving key initiatives related to fees, cost base, risk-weighted assets, and capital utilization. You will identify, escalate, and mitigate business risks that could impair the ability to do business, including legal, tax, regulatory, capacity issues, and extraordinary transaction costs. You will partner across functions to define future workflows and implement related technology and infrastructure projects to support an evolving market structure.

Job responsibilities

* **Implement** new business strategy, strategic initiatives, or platforms, including aligning department and support groups (Finance, Technology, Operations, Legal, Compliance)
* **Optimize** bottom-line business performance by driving key initiatives (fees, cost base, risk-weighted assets, and capital utilization)
* **Identify** business risks that could impair the ability to do business and **escalate and mitigate** those risks (e.g., legal, tax, regulatory, capacity issues, extraordinary transaction costs)
* **Analyze** financial performance, including expenses; **identify** productivity initiatives and **drive** implementation
* **Partner** with the business, Operations, and Technology to define future workflows and **implement** related technology and infrastructure projects to prepare for evolving market structure requirements
* **Partner** with relevant external service and infrastructure providers
* **Represent** the business in internal and external working groups

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or other related area
* Previous product knowledge and/or prior Business Management or Chief Operating Officer experience
* Energetic and dynamic style
* Highly motivated self-starter with excellent time management and prioritization skills
* Ability to present well to senior and global business heads
* Ability to forge strong internal relationships across a broad range of functions
* Self-motivated, tenacious, and able to work with a high degree of independence
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Ability to define and deliver a strategic agenda across multiple groups
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including ability to analyze large data sets and present conclusions concisely
* Excellent project management and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail and a logical thought process

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

  

Global Finance & Business Management works to strategically manage capital, drive growth and efficiencies, maintain financial reporting and proactively manage risk. By providing information, analysis and recommendations to improve results and drive decisions, teams ensure the company can navigate all types of market conditions while protecting our fortress balance sheet.

jobs.description:
Designation: Chief Manager

Location: India Tamil Nadu Adyar - Chennai

Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title**
=============

**Zonal Sales Manager (South) - IndusInd Bank Affluent & NRI Channel**

**Location**
------------

South India (Chennai) handles all four states of South.

**Reporting To**
----------------

National Sales Head - IndusInd Bank Relationship

**Role Purpose**
================

Lead the South India region for ABSLI's strategic partnership with IndusInd Bank's Affluent, HNI, and NRI Banking segments. The incumbent will be responsible for driving life insurance penetration across the bank's affluent customer base by building strong engagement with banking leadership, enhancing frontline capability, driving sales productivity, and ensuring sustainable business growth.

The role requires deep expertise in bancassurance, wealth management, relationship selling, and team leadership to establish ABSLI as the preferred insurance partner within IndusInd's affluent banking ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

### **Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Drive insurance sales across Affluent, Imperia, HNI, and NRI customer segments.
* Deliver annualized premium targets (APE/FYP) for South India.
* Increase wallet share within the affluent customer base.
* Build a robust opportunity pipeline from wealth, investment, and protection-led discussions.
* Drive high-ticket and protection-focused product penetration.

### **Relationship Management**

* Manage relationships with Zonal Heads, Regional Heads, Cluster Heads, and Wealth Leaders of IndusInd Bank.
* Position ABSLI as a strategic partner within the bank's affluent business model.
* Conduct regular business reviews with banking stakeholders.
* Ensure alignment of branch priorities with insurance business objectives.

### **Team Leadership**

* Lead a team of Regional Managers and Relationship Managers across South India.
* Drive productivity and capability building.
* Coach teams on HNI sales conversations and financial planning discussions.
* Build a high-performance sales culture.

### **Capability Development**

* Upskill bank relationship managers on:
  + Financial protection planning
  + Estate planning solutions
  + Retirement planning
  + Wealth transfer concepts
  + NRI insurance solutions
  Tax-efficient insurance products

### **Sales Governance**

* Ensure compliance with IRDAI regulations.
* Monitor suitability and quality parameters.
* Drive persistency and customer retention.
* Maintain healthy business mix and reduce concentration risks.

### **Customer Engagement**

* Conduct HNI customer meets, wealth seminars, and investment forums.
* Participate in client acquisition and portfolio review events.
* Engage with key customers for large-ticket closures.

**Key Result Areas (KRAs)**
===========================

**KRA**

  
  

New Business Premium (APE/FYP) Achievement

  
  

Affluent & HNI Customer Acquisition

  
  

Product Mix & Protection Penetration

  
  

Active Branch Productivity

  
  

Banker Activation & Engagement

  
  

Team Productivity & Retention

  
  

Persistency & Quality Metrics

  
  

Stakeholder Relationship

  
  

**Critical Challenges of the Role**
===================================

### **1. New Partnership Establishment**

* Building mindshare and trust for ABSLI within an existing banking ecosystem.
Competing with legacy bancassurance relationships and established insurers.  

### **2. Affluent Customer Expectations**

* HNI and NRI customers demand advisory-led conversations rather than transactional selling.
Higher scrutiny on product suitability and value proposition.  

### **3. Banker Engagement**

* Securing mindshare from affluent bankers already focused on liabilities, investments, and AUM acquisition.
Maintaining insurance visibility amidst competing priorities.  

### **4. Geographic Complexity**

* Managing multiple states, languages, and diverse customer demographics across South India.

### **5. High Ticket Closure Cycles**

Longer sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, family members, and financial advisors.  



### **6. Wealth vs Protection Balance**

* Driving sustainable protection business while meeting premium targets.
Avoiding overdependence on single-premium or investment-oriented sales.  

### **7. NRI Business Development**

Navigating regulatory processes, documentation requirements, and customer accessibility challenges.  



### **8. Talent & Capability Building**

* Developing teams capable of engaging affluent customers on sophisticated financial planning topics.

**Desired Candidate Profile**
=============================

### **Experience**

* 10-15+ years in Wealth Bancassurance.
* Minimum 5 years in a leadership role.
* Strong experience with HNI, Emerging Affluent, Wealth, or NRI segments.
Proven track record of managing large geographies and partnerships.  

### **Preferred Background**

* Bancassurance leadership.
* Insurance distribution leadership.

### **Key Skills**

* Strategic Sales Leadership
* Wealth & Protection Planning
* Stakeholder Management
* Relationship Management
* Team Development
* Negotiation & Influence
* Business Planning
* Data-Driven Sales Management

**Success Profile (First 12 Months)**
=====================================

The ZSM should be able to:

* Establish ABSLI as a preferred insurance partner within IndusInd's Affluent Banking ecosystem.
* Activate 80-90% of targeted affluent banking locations in South India.
* Build a strong pipeline of HNI/NRI business.
* Deliver target APE/FYP with healthy protection mix.
* Develop a high-performing regional sales team.
* Create sustainable banker engagement and referral generation mechanisms.

jobs.description:
**Company** | Hybon Technologies Private Limited  
**Location** | The Executive Centre, 7th Floor, Worldmark 4, Aerocity, New Delhi  
**Employment Type** | Full-time  
**Reporting To** | Chief Financial Officer

Role Overview

Hybon Technologies is looking for a **Head of Accounts** to lead the accounting function for its domestic trading and export business in mobile phones, electronics and IT products. The role owns the books of accounts, financial close, statutory compliance, audit coordination and internal controls. The successful candidate will lead the accounts team and work closely with sales, procurement, logistics and banking teams to keep financial records accurate and resolve discrepancies promptly.

Key Responsibilities

* **Accounting and financial close** — Oversee the general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, fixed assets and intercompany balances. Lead monthly and year-end closing and prepare financial statements and supporting schedules.
* **GST and tax compliance** — Oversee GST returns, GSTR-2B reconciliations, input tax credit, e-invoicing and e-way bills. Manage TDS deductions, deposits and returns, and coordinate with tax advisors on statutory filings and notices.
* **Import and export accounting** — Review invoices, bills of entry, shipping bills, customs duties, freight and landed costs. Monitor foreign currency receivables and payables, exchange differences and export realisations. Coordinate with banks and internal teams on remittance documentation and support GST refund claims where applicable.
* **Inventory and cost controls** — Reconcile inventory records with the books and physical stock counts. Investigate stock discrepancies, review valuation and landed costs, and oversee IMEI or serial-number reconciliation where applicable.
* **Receivables, payables and cash flow** — Monitor customer and vendor ageing, advances and credit balances. Drive account confirmations and dispute resolution, review payment schedules and prepare cash flow forecasts for management.
* **Management reporting** — Prepare monthly reports on profitability, gross margins, inventory, overdue receivables and working capital. Explain material variances and flag issues that require management action.
* **Audits and internal controls** — Coordinate statutory, tax and internal audits. Maintain supporting documentation, close audit observations and strengthen review controls for invoicing, payments, credit notes and journal entries.
* **Team leadership** — Supervise and develop the accounts team, set clear responsibilities and review deadlines, and improve accounting processes and ERP workflows.

Qualifications and Experience

* CA preferred. CMA, M.Com or B.Com candidates with relevant senior accounting experience may also be considered.
* 8–12 years of accounting experience, including at least 3 years leading an accounts team.
* Experience in trading, distribution or import/export is preferred. Exposure to mobile phones, electronics or IT hardware is an advantage.
* Hands-on experience in financial closing, GST, TDS, inventory accounting, reconciliations and audit coordination.
* Proficiency in Tally Prime or a comparable ERP, along with strong Excel skills for reconciliations and management reporting.
* Ability to lead a team, meet statutory and reporting deadlines, and communicate clearly with management, auditors, banks and business teams.

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Head of Platform Product
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 90 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About the Role

We are looking for a senior product leader to lead our Internal Platform Product organization and build the systems that enable our financial and digital-asset businesses to operate efficiently, reliably, and at scale.

You will own the product strategy, architecture, roadmap, and team development for internal platform products spanning payments and assets, user and security systems, CRM, customer engagement, and multi-jurisdiction compliance infrastructure. Your mandate is to turn fragmented business requirements into coherent, reusable capabilities and move the organization from requirement-taking and feature delivery to end-to-end ownership of business outcomes.

What You Will Own

* **Internal platform product strategy.**
  Define the capability map, product boundaries, and roadmap across internal systems. Identify common needs and justified business differences, reduce duplicate investment, and balance near-term delivery with long-term platform quality.
* **End-to-end workflows and product architecture.**
  Define business models, module responsibilities, data definitions, and API contracts across user, account, payment, asset, permission, risk, and operational workflows. Partner with engineering, architecture, security, and compliance teams to translate these into practical solutions.
* **Business and operational efficiency.**
  Understand how internal users work and improve automation, self-service configuration, and cross-system workflows. Measure improvements through operational efficiency, error reduction, and effective adoption rather than launch checklists alone.
* **Multi-jurisdiction compliance enablement.**
  Translate business and regulatory requirements into configurable, auditable system capabilities, including jurisdiction-specific site setup, KYC/KYB workflows, access controls, and regulatory data reporting.
* **Portfolio governance and prioritization.**
  Manage requirements across multiple product teams, identify the highest-value problems, and make explicit decisions about scope, sequencing, dependencies, and resources. Establish outcome-based OKRs, delivery reviews, and product lifecycle discipline.
* **Product organization leadership.**
  Recruit, develop, and retain strong product talent. Establish clear ownership across product lines, develop product leaders, and strengthen systems thinking, independent judgment, and execution quality.
* **AI-enabled internal productivity.**
  Apply AI to requirement analysis, documentation, knowledge access, and suitable operational workflows. Demonstrate measurable efficiency and quality improvements while maintaining appropriate access controls, data protection, and human review.
* **Collaboration with Financial Cloud.**
  Define the reuse boundaries and change impacts of shared capabilities. Align with the Financial Cloud product leader and technology leadership on dependencies and priorities, avoiding duplicate builds and unmanaged disruption to critical internal work.

What We Are Looking For

* 10+ years of product management experience, including at least 5 years in senior product leadership, with direct responsibility for multi-team product organizations and the development of product leaders.
* A proven track record building and shipping complex internal platforms, financial systems, or infrastructure products. You can explain how you converted fragmented requirements into stable, reusable capabilities.
* Strong systems thinking and the ability to reason about business models, product architecture, module catalogs, data governance, and API contracts beyond screens and user stories.
* Experience in fintech, banking, payments, digital assets, or another regulated environment, with an understanding of how security, audit, and regulatory requirements shape system design and workflows.
* Demonstrated experience in portfolio prioritization, cross-team decision-making, and outcome-based OKRs, supported by concrete business results.
* The ability to work effectively across business, operations, engineering, architecture, security, and compliance, making clear decisions when information is incomplete or stakeholders disagree.
* Fluency in Mandarin Chinese for in-depth communication with engineering teams and business stakeholders.

Strongly Preferred

* Experience with exchange platforms, payment and asset systems, account infrastructure, CRM, KYC/KYB, AML, or multi-jurisdiction compliance products.
* Experience leading product organizations through restructuring, rapid scaling, or legacy-system consolidation.
* Measurable results from self-service platforms, configurable systems, workflow automation, or AI-enabled productivity initiatives.
* Experience working with global teams and professional working proficiency in English.

Leadership Profile

You take ownership of problems and outcomes, not just coordination and delivery. You can narrow a broad portfolio to the most important priorities, explain trade-offs clearly, and acknowledge what remains unknown. jobs.title: Head of India
jobs.description:
**The Role**
India is the biggest remittance market with over $130 billion a year flowing home to it, from everywhere: engineers in the Bay Area and Sydney, cabbies in Toronto, construction crews in Dubai, shopkeepers in Leicester, students in Berlin. From Punjabis, Gujaratis, Tamils, Malayalis and Telugus. From people wiring $3,000 a month to a Mumbai mortgage and people sending $80 to a village in Bihar. Your job is to win this market.
  
  
You are someone who gets excited by the nuances of the Indian diaspora and how to reach each group, and who wants to own the P&L, the regulatory landscape and pricing at the same time. If you find the price sensitivity of each cohort exciting, and "why do Malayali nurses cluster in specific hospital systems, and what does that mean for acquisition?" as interesting as "what's RBI's latest remittance policy and which banks make the best partners," this is it.
  
  
As the GM, you own the P&L, and set pricing. For customer growth, you decide which communities to acquire and in what order. Know the RBI's rules well enough to see the openings inside them, not just the limits. A Gujarati family in New Jersey and a Punjabi trucker in Brampton got abroad through completely different networks, and reaching them takes completely different channels.
  
  
Reports to the Head of South Asia. Builds a team of FX Advisors in India and growth managers in sending markets. The face of India inside and outside the company. Total ownership. Be your own CEO
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* The P&L. Volume, gross profit and CAC across every India corridor. Not influence, own. A miss is your miss. A beat is your win.
* Strategy and sequencing. Which sender markets, which communities, which channels, in what order. US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia and UAE to start. Build the plan, defend it to leadership, execute it.
* Pricing. India is the most rate-sensitive, most competitive remittance market in the world, up against competitors who reprice daily. Set FX and fee strategy corridor by corridor.
* The regulatory and partner landscape. RBI rules, bank partnerships, payout rails. Know the terrain cold and own the local relationships.
* Product. Obsess over UX and the services NRIs actually need. Closer to the customer than anyone in the company, and what you hear feeds straight into product, pricing and customer support.
* The diaspora puzzle. Community partnerships, temples and gurdwaras and churches, cricket leagues, student associations, remittance-heavy employers, influencers, festivals (Diwali is a season, not a day). Get in front of each community authentically, and cheaply.
* The team. Hire, coach and retain people in India and in sending markets. Small, dense, fast.

**Who You Are**

* 10 to 15 years in high-growth environments: startups, operations, consulting, finance, fintech. Has owned a number and talks about it the way owners do.
* Diaspora-fluent. Real knowledge of and networks in the Indian diaspora, and real curiosity about it. Migration patterns, community structures, who sends money to whom and why.
* Commercially sharp. Holds pricing, unit economics and CAC math in their head, and works the data directly. Excel or Sheets required, SQL a real plus.
* A hustler with judgment. Closes a bank partnership Monday, reviews corridor margins Tuesday, shows up at a community event in Jackson Heights on Saturday. Likes all three.
* A regulatory realist. Understands (or can quickly master) RBI rules and the compliance realities of moving money into India. Treats compliance as a partner, not an obstacle.
* Multilingual, ideally. Fluent in English. Hindi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu or Malayalam are genuine assets.

Location: London or Dubai. Regular travel to India and sending markets is part of the job.
  
  
**Why This Role**
India is the largest remittance market in the world, and winning it moves the whole company forward. This role owns that outcome, with the authority and the accountability that come with it. It also drives real value for the customers: Immigrants work hard for this money, and every basis point saved goes home.
  
  
**About Us**
We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fuelling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.
  
  
Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.
  
  
We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends
**real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation**
.
  
  
**Here’s a Little More**

* Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)
* Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more
* Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission
* Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages
* Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word

Taptap Values
  
  
Impact first
  
  
Team next
  
  
Accept reality
  
  
Propose solutions
  
  
Win with grit
  
  
Be proactively candid, with yourself and others
  
  
Love the particular
  
  
Own it
  
  
Create positive energy
  
  
Maybe, even have fun
  
  
Taptap Send is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment decisions are decided on the basis of qualifications, experience and business need. We strongly encourage applications who are members of underrepresented communities to apply.
  
  
If you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to let us know. Any information you provide us in this respect will only be used to accommodate your requirements.
  
  
*Note: we recognize imposter syndrome is real - any candidate that does not perfectly fit every characteristic of this role is still strongly encouraged to apply.*

jobs.description:
**Summary**

The Manager – Digital Payments is responsible for managing the development, implementation, and ongoing enhancement of Finance House's digital payment products and services. The role supports the execution of the organization's digital payments strategy by managing card products, merchant acquiring, digital wallets, prepaid solutions, and payment partnerships while ensuring an excellent customer experience and compliance with regulatory requirements.

The incumbent will work closely with business, technology, operations, risk, compliance, and external partners to deliver innovative payment solutions that support business growth, operational efficiency, and digital transformation initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Digital Payments Management**

* Manage the day-to-day development, enhancement, and performance of digital payment products and services.
* Support the execution of the digital payment’s roadmap aligned with business objectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve existing payment products and introduce new payment capabilities.
* Monitor product performance and recommend enhancements to improve customer adoption and profitability.
* Support the rollout of new payment initiatives, ensuring timely delivery and successful implementation.

**Product Development**

* Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of digital payment products, including debit, prepaid, merchant acquiring, payment gateways, and digital wallet solutions.
* Coordinate product launches, enhancements, and system upgrades with internal and external stakeholders.
* Prepare business requirements, user stories, and functional specifications for new initiatives.
* Support the development of business cases and product proposals for new payment solutions.
* Utilize customer feedback, market intelligence, and data analytics to improve products and customer experience.

**Stakeholder & Vendor Management**

* Work closely with Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance, and Customer Experience teams to deliver payment initiatives.
* Coordinate with payment processors, card schemes, fintech partners, and solution vendors during implementation and ongoing operations.
* Support relationship management with external partners and service providers.
* Facilitate communication between business users and technology teams throughout project delivery.

**Project Delivery**

* Manage digital payment projects from planning through implementation and post-launch support.
* Coordinate project activities, monitor timelines, risks, budgets, and deliverables.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and support continuous delivery initiatives.
* Ensure project documentation, testing, and operational readiness are completed before implementation.

**Performance & Analytics**

* Monitor key business metrics including transaction volumes, active customers, revenue, product utilization, and operational performance.
* Prepare dashboards, reports, and management updates on payment product performance.
* Identify trends and recommend initiatives to improve product adoption and customer engagement.
* Support pricing reviews, campaign analysis, and revenue optimization initiatives.

**Compliance & Risk**

* Ensure digital payment products comply with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and card scheme rules.
* Support operational risk assessments and implementation of appropriate controls.
* Coordinate with Compliance, Information Security, and Risk teams during product implementation.
* Assist in managing vendor governance, audit requirements, and issue resolution.

**Market Research & Innovation**

* Stay informed on emerging payment technologies, customer trends, fintech innovations, and regulatory developments.
* Evaluate new payment solutions and recommend enhancements that improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Support digital transformation initiatives by identifying opportunities for automation, AI-driven analytics, and process improvements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Professional certifications in Payments, Product Management, Agile, FinTech, or Digital Banking will be an advantage.

**Experience & Requirements**

* Minimum 8+ years of experience in digital payments, cards, merchant acquiring, issuing, digital banking, fintech, or retail banking.
* Experience managing digital payment products, payment projects, or card programs.
* Good understanding of card issuing, merchant acquiring, payment gateways, prepaid cards, QR payments, and digital wallets.
* Knowledge of payment ecosystems, payment processing, and industry best practices.
* Experience preparing business requirements and coordinating product implementations.
* Familiarity with payment regulations, risk management, and operational controls.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams and external vendors.
* Knowledge of Agile delivery methodologies and digital product development.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools is desirable.
* Commercial mindset with a focus on customer experience, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Consumer Platforms, CEMEA
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Visa is evolving its consumer-facing platforms to create stronger customer value propositions, enable new product solutions, and support sustainable growth across CEMEA.
  
  
The Senior Manager, Consumer Platforms CEMEA will support the strategic evolution of Visa's consumer-facing and backend platforms, helping shape the products, propositions, customer experiences, and solutions that can be built through them in the future.
  
  
The role requires a commercially minded problem solver with strong business acumen, structured thinking, and the ability to translate complex business questions into practical recommendations.
  
  
The leading indicator of a good fit will be experience within a scaled, digital-first consumer business such as e-commerce, mobility, on-demand delivery, travel, marketplaces, subscriptions, or other technology-enabled services, with direct involvement in building and evolving consumer-facing mobile applications, digital journeys, and high-frequency customer experiences.
  
  
Working across regional and global Product, Technology, Design, Data, Finance, Marketing, Risk, Compliance, market teams, issuers, and partners, the incumbent will develop strategic perspectives, assess opportunities, build business cases, and support senior leadership decisions on platform direction and investment.
  
  
**The Senior Manager Will**

* Drive the evolution of consumer-facing applications and digital experiences, applying best practices from scaled digital-first businesses to create intuitive, engaging and high-frequency customer journeys.
* Shape the CEMEA consumer platform strategy across internal and external platforms, defining how capabilities should evolve to support future products, propositions and customer experiences.
* Structure complex and ambiguous business problems, evaluate strategic options and translate insights into clear recommendations, business cases and executable solutions.
* Translate strategic priorities and new CVP propositions into platform capabilities and product roadmaps, partnering with Product, Technology, Design and Data teams across digital journeys, benefits, loyalty, personalization, servicing and engagement.
* Shape the role of AI within consumer experiences, including conversational, generative and agentic capabilities, while defining the data, governance and operating-model requirements needed to scale responsibly.
* Develop investment recommendations and performance frameworks to assess platform health, customer outcomes, adoption, commercial impact, cost and return on investment.
* Lead cross-functional and cross regional strategic discussions and develop executive-ready recommendations to align regional and global stakeholders, resolve trade-offs and support senior leadership decisions.
* Act as a strategic thought partner to Consumer Solutions leadership, bringing external perspectives from digital commerce, marketplaces, mobility, travel, fintech and emerging consumer technologies.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience across consumer products, strategy and/or payments, with a strong preference for experience building and scaling consumer-facing mobile or D2C platforms in sectors such as e-commerce, mobility, on-demand delivery and travel. Payments, strategy/consulting or financial services experience is an added advantage.
* Strong business centric and strategic acumen, with the ability to connect customer needs, product and platform capabilities, operating models and financial outcomes.
* Demonstrated experience shaping digital-first platforms and growth strategies, including market-entry assessments, proposition development, business cases and investment recommendations.
* Ability to translate strategy into execution, converting recommendations into product roadmaps, business requirements and implementation priorities.
* Strong analytical capabilities, including market sizing, financial modelling, performance analysis, scenario development and synthesis of complex data into actionable insights.
* Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics, develop high-quality decision materials and influence senior stakeholders across matrixed, multicultural organizations.
* Experience shaping and scaling consumer digital experiences, including personalization, intelligent recommendations and other capabilities that drive engagement and customer value.
* Bachelor’s degree required
* MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification preferred.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.description:
**About Revolut**
People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.
  
  
As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 15,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Product team shapes the experiences that power Revolut. They turn complex problems into simple, scalable solutions — collaborating across Design, Engineering, and Data to build features our customers love.
  
  
We're looking for a Head of Product to rethink our products and fraud systems to be AI-centric. You'll leverage AI for automation and enable intuitive, multi-modal customer interactions to build trust and streamline compliance processes.
  
  
Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Leading and building AI; Machine Learning; Data Science products to solve business problems
* Leading a financial crime product team, designing features that improve security across Revolut’s global platform
* Building teams to align with product objectives and developing team members to enable their career growth
* Overseeing your team's product roadmap, from strategic planning and conception, to execution and launch.

**What You'll Need**

* 7+ years of product management experience
* 3+ years of experience managing large teams
* Experience managing AI products, data science products, customer-facing products, and back office systems
* Experience formulating and driving a focused product vision, and owning the narrative with leadership, customers, and partners
* High analytical acumen along with solid business sense that guides ROI-based prioritisation
* A bias towards action and bootstrapping major projects, never hesitating to roll up your sleeves and be hands-on
* Experience leading product development and launch from scratch
* The ability to provide insight and deliver measurable results for sophisticated products under ambiguous situations in a fast-paced environment

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.
  
  

* Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
* Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

**We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.**

jobs.description:
Sokin is looking for a strategic, hands-on Content Marketing Manager to lead the development of engaging, high-impact content across our global marketing channels. You will be responsible for shaping and executing content that drives awareness, educates stakeholders, supports growth campaigns and reinforces Sokin’s positioning as a trusted innovator in the digital payments space.

This role will collaborate closely with the copywriter, localization lead, growth marketing, PR, and design teams to ensure all content aligns with business goals, brand standards and regulatory requirements. **About Us**

Sokin is a fast-growing B2B financial services provider, focused on simplifying global payments and receivables for businesses. Our mission is to make cross-border transactions faster, more transparent, and cost-effective — all at competitive wholesale exchange rates.

We’re a next-generation payments platform, enabling businesses to hold, send, receive, and exchange over 75 currencies from a single access point. Our integrated payment acceptance tool, SokinPay, offers even more flexibility for global trade. From sports and entertainment to logistics and travel, our client base is diverse and expanding rapidly.

We’re scaling fast — and looking for passionate, experienced professionals to help us realise our ambitious vision.

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**  
NEXT Ventures is where ambition takes shape and momentum becomes movement. As a global platform, revolutionising access to performance-based capital, we empower the world’s most driven individuals to rise. Through our flagship brand, FundedNext, we empower dreamers to become doers and potential to turn into performance. FNmarkets is our international brokerage arm, serving clients across global markets*.*

With 500+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm—220,000+ daily users, from 170+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.

**Your Role in Our Mission**  
As a Manager, Payments & Treasury (FNmarkets Brokerage), you own the end-to-end movement, safeguarding, and optimization of client and corporate funds across FNmarkets’ international brokerage operations. You will run the PSP and banking portfolio that powers client deposits and withdrawals, manage multi-currency liquidity and FX exposure, and keep settlement, reconciliation, and treasury controls tight as the brokerage scales across markets. Sitting at the intersection of payment operations, treasury, and bank/PSP relationship management, you partner closely with Compliance, Finance, Risk, and trading-platform teams to keep funds flowing reliably, cost-efficiently, and within regulatory requirements.

This role reports to the group Head of Payments & Treasury.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* **Payment Operations & PSP Portfolio:**

* **Portfolio Ownership:** Own the PSP and payment-method portfolio (cards, local bank rails, e-wallets, crypto) across the brokerage’s active markets, from onboarding and integration through performance monitoring and offboarding.
* **Payment Routing Optimization:** Optimize payment routing in the orchestrator to lift approval rates, reduce decline and failure rates, and lower blended cost per transaction.
* **SLA & Performance Tracking:** Track and improve deposit/withdrawal success rates, processing times, and chargeback/dispute ratios against agreed SLAs.

**2. Client Funds & Payout Operations:**

* **End-to-End Flow Oversight:** Oversee client deposit and withdrawal flows end to end, ensuring funds are processed accurately, on time, and in line with client-money safeguarding rules.
* **Payout Management:** Manage brokerage client withdrawals and wallet transfers, including volume forecasting, queue management, and exception handling.
* **Fund Segregation & Reporting:** Maintain segregation of client funds from corporate funds and support audit and regulatory reporting on balances.

**3. Treasury, FX & Cash Management:**

* **Multi-Currency Liquidity:** Manage multi-currency liquidity across entities and accounts, ensuring sufficient funding for client withdrawals, settlements, and operating needs.
* **FX & Hedging Execution:** Run FX operations and conversions, monitor currency exposure, and execute hedging or rebalancing as directed by policy.
* **Cash Forecasting & Yield:** Forecast cash positions, optimize working capital, and manage the placement of eligible corporate cash within approved investment and counterparty limits—with client funds held separately and safeguarded at all times.

**4. Banking & Relationship Management:**

* **Partner Management:** Own relationships with banks, PSPs, and acquiring partners—covering commercials, fee and settlement-term negotiation, issue escalation, and periodic performance reviews.
* **Cost Reduction:** Drive down processing, settlement, and FX costs through negotiation and transfer-pricing/routing optimization.
* **Infrastructure Redundancy:** Build banking and PSP redundancy to protect the continuity of client deposits and withdrawals.

**5. Reconciliation, Compliance & Risk:**

* **Multi-Ledger Reconciliation:** Own daily and periodic reconciliation across PSPs, banks, crypto wallets, and the ledger, resolving breaks and ensuring settlement accuracy.
* **Regulatory & Compliance Alignment:** Partner with Compliance on KYC/AML, licensing, and regulatory requirements affecting payment flows and client funds.
* **Risk Mitigation:** Identify and mitigate operational, settlement, counterparty, and fraud risk across the payment and treasury stack.

**6. Projects & Optimization:**

* **Expansion & Automation Initiatives:** Lead payments and treasury projects, including new-market and new-method launches, orchestrator and system integrations, and process automation.
* **Executive Reporting:** Build reporting and dashboards on approval rates, cost, settlement cycles, liquidity, and payout performance for leadership.
* **Cross-Functional Scaling:** Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Risk to scale payment and treasury capability as the brokerage grows.

**7. Build & Scale, Team Leadership & Innovation:**

* **Build & Scale:** Define and build out the FNmarkets payments and treasury operating model - people, processes, and systems - to support the brokerage’s growth across new markets and product lines.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead, develop, and grow a high-performing payments & treasury wing for FNmarkets business line, setting clear priorities, fostering accountability, and building capability at every level.
* **Innovation & Knowledge Sharing:** Champion continuous improvement by staying current on industry developments, introducing best practices, and ensuring knowledge flows across the team and key stakeholders.

**What You Bring**

* **Industry Experience:** Minimum 5 years in payments, funds management, and treasury functions at an international brokerage (CFD/FX/securities); strong candidates from payments firms serving brokerage clients also considered.
* **High-Volume Payment Operations:** Hands-on experience managing client deposit and withdrawal flows, PSP relationships, and payment routing in a high-volume, multi-currency environment.
* **Treasury & FX Mastery:** Treasury experience across multi-currency liquidity and cash management, FX operations, and working-capital or settlement optimization.
* **Payment Ecosystem Knowledge:** Strong grasp of digital payment methods and ecosystems—card networks, local/alternative payment rails, e-wallets, and crypto/stablecoin settlement.
* **Commercial Negotiation:** Demonstrated bank and PSP negotiation experience, with a track record of reducing fees and improving settlement terms and approval performance.
* **Reconciliation & Breaks Resolution:** Solid command of reconciliation and settlement across multiple payment partners and ledgers, including breaks investigation.
* **Compliance & Safeguarding:** Working knowledge of KYC/AML, client-money safeguarding, and the compliance/licensing considerations affecting cross-border payment flows.
* **Data & Analytics:** Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with transaction data, dashboards, and spreadsheets to drive decisions.
* **Education & Communication:** A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field; paired with fluent written and spoken English for coordinating across international partners and internal stakeholders.

**Preferred (Nice-to-Haves)**

* **Payment Orchestration:** Experience with payment orchestration platforms and routing logic (e.g., cascading, smart routing, retry optimization).
* **Multi-Jurisdiction Setup:** Familiarity with regulated-entity treasury across multiple jurisdictions, including banking setups and licensing considerations.
* **Market Launches:** Prior experience launching payment methods or banking relationships in new markets.
* **Certifications & SQL:** Relevant certifications (e.g., CTP, payments or treasury qualifications) and SQL or data-analysis skills for working with transaction-level data are good to have.
* **Crypto Settlement:** Exposure to crypto settlement and reconciliation (USDT, TRC-20/ERC-20) and crypto–fiat on/off-ramp flows.

**Your X-Factor**

**Country Compliance Office – Vice President - Dubai**

The Middle East and Africa Compliance team is seeking a Vice President, based in Dubai and reporting to the Head of Middle East and Africa Compliance. This broad regional role supports Compliance advisory, Operational Risk and Regulatory Relations priorities, with specialist investment management expertise as a core capability. The Vice President will provide entity-level oversight, including potential registered Compliance Officer or other controlled-function responsibilities as the regional footprint expands, while delivering specialist coverage for MSIM Portfolio Management and Sales & Distribution activities across GCC jurisdictions.

  

**About Morgan Stanley and the DIFC Branch:**

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm and has served clients in the Middle East and Africa since the early 1970s. From offices in Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar and Johannesburg, the Firm provides investment banking, capital markets, sales and trading, asset management and private wealth management services. The DIFC Branch forms part of this regional platform, connecting clients to Morgan Stanley's global capabilities and solutions. Our success is underpinned by integrity, excellence and a strong team ethic, providing an environment in which people can learn, achieve and grow.

As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people are critical to our success. We share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence and strong team ethic. Morgan Stanley provides a strong foundation for building a professional career and a place for people to learn, achieve and grow.

  
  

**Department Overview:**

Compliance advises Business Units and staff on applicable laws, regulations, exchange requirements and Firm policies. The Department implements Compliance and Global Financial Crimes policies and procedures, delivers training, undertakes monitoring and surveillance, and partners with Legal, GFC, Operational Risk and other control functions to maintain a robust second line of defence.

  

**What you'll do in the role:**

* Provide broad MENA Compliance advice across regional business, legal-entity and strategic priorities, applying regulatory requirements and Firm policies with sound judgement and effective challenge.
* Support regulatory governance and entity-level oversight, including submissions, notifications, inspections, remediation, regulatory engagement and controlled-function responsibilities where required and subject to approval.
* Maintain and enhance MENA Compliance and GFC policies, procedures, training and practical guidance, and execute Compliance Monitoring Programme reviews and Operational Risk activities.
* Partner with Legal, GFC, Operational Risk and business stakeholders on new products, services, business models and strategic initiatives, providing pragmatic, solutions-oriented advice.
* Provide specialist investment management coverage for MSIM Portfolio Management and Sales & Distribution activities, including cross-border business, fund and mandate structures, foreign fund registration, distribution, promotion and marketing across GCC jurisdictions.
  

**What you'll bring to the role:**

* Results-oriented Compliance professional with 8+ years' regional or multi-jurisdictional experience, including substantive investment management expertise across public and/or private markets.
* Strong knowledge of MENA regulatory frameworks and practical experience in Saudi Arabia and the UAE; familiarity with Qatar and Kuwait is advantageous.
* Demonstrated expertise in asset and portfolio management, fund distribution and foreign fund marketing, together with experience supporting cross-border activities and global stakeholders.
* Experience in regulatory engagement and change, including submissions, inspections and remediation; prior controlled-function experience, or the credibility to assume such responsibilities subject to regulatory approval, is desirable.
* Excellent analytical, drafting and communion skills.

**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:**

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. **Job Summary**

**About SC Ventures**

**SC Ventures is Standard Chartered ’s innovation, fintech investment and ventures arm. We were established to reinvent banking, as the significant technological disruptions to the industry was impacting its ability to serve clients and customers, in the ways they needed to be served. We are a unique ecosystem of innovators, banking experts, business builders and partners who are focused on rewiring the DNA in banking and bringing breakthrough ideas to scale, together. We are building ecosystems around four high conviction themes: Online Economy & Lifestyle, SMEs & World Trade, Digital Assets, and Sustainability & Inclusion. We are a global team of "Members" (excluding individual ventures), including dedicated colleagues from the Group's support functions, based in Singapore, Hong Kong, London, and the United Arab Emirates**

**About HAL**

**HAL is a B2B domestic and cross border marketplace being built for SMEs in the UAE. Incubated by SC Ventures, the ventures arm of Standard Chartered Bank, the platform will enable digital commerce and access to financial & value-added services. HAL’s vision is to act as a super glue connecting multiple partners & ecosystems by bringing together buyers, sellers, financial institutions, logistics partners under one roof. We are building this as an agentic AI native stack along with several strategic partners in the UAE who bring different capabilities into the platform.**

**SMEs are the backbone of the UAE economy and vital for economic growth and diversification. We want to help SMEs grow profitably, safely and with ease. Hal is being built for scale with the latest technologies and with a vision to truly become the one stop shop for SMEs. We are looking to launch later in the year.**

**The Senior Marketing Manager will lead HAL's marketing function, working closely with the CEO and the commercial, product and partnerships teams. This is a commercially driven role: success is measured by the qualified B2B leads you generate (sellers, buyers and SMEs looking for finance), the revenue they bring in, and HAL's growing share of the UAE SME market. You will be hands-on and highly experimental, testing new channels and ideas quickly, doubling down on what works, and doing whatever it takes to help HAL win in the market.**

**Strategy**

* **Develop and own HAL's go-to-market marketing plan, turning business targets for sellers, buyers and finance referrals into lead generation goals, channel priorities and budget.**

* **Build simple, reliable full-funnel reporting covering leads, cost per lead, conversion to onboarded users and revenue, and share insights and recommendations with leadership regularly.**

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager 3
jobs.description:
#### **About Behavox**

Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world.

From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise.

Our approach is unique, and it's validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are.

We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before.

**About the Role**

Behavox's Strategic Account Managers own the full commercial relationship with some of the world's most complex and highly regulated financial institutions. This includes delivery outcomes, commercial performance, executive relationships, and long-term strategic growth across a portfolio of global banks, hedge funds, asset managers, and energy firms operating under the world's most demanding regulatory frameworks.

Clients in this portfolio are building or strengthening unified controls frameworks that bring together communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management into a single, defensible control system. The Strategic Account Manager's role is to understand where each client sits on that journey, ensure Behavox is delivering against their current needs, and position the platform to serve the full scope of their controls framework over time. This requires full end-to-end ownership of the relationship, delivery, health, satisfaction, retention, and growth for every account in the portfolio, operating with a high degree of autonomy on account strategy, renewals, escalations, and executive relationships.

The role requires the ability to think strategically and execute operationally, often in the same day. The Strategic Account Manager will own all renewals across the portfolio, build retention strategy, lead negotiations, and close; accurately forecast ARR churn risk and develop mitigation plans; drive inbound expansion deals independently in collaboration with Account Executives; and lead executive business reviews that are genuinely strategic: conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value.

This is a hybrid position based out of our London office.

**What You'll Bring**

* **Enterprise compliance technology and unified controls frameworks.** Deep working knowledge of how communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management converge into a single control system at regulated financial institutions; understands how clients evaluate and mature their compliance posture over time.
* **Financial services regulatory environment.** Understands the regulatory obligations driving client demand, from communications monitoring requirements to trade reconstruction and archiving mandates, across global banking, hedge fund, asset management, and energy sectors.
* **Multi-stakeholder account management across regulated financial institutions.** Navigates complex organizational structures involving Heads of Surveillance, compliance analysts, technology teams, and operations teams; manages both executive-level strategic relationships and working-level practitioner relationships simultaneously.
* **Commercial lifecycle management for enterprise SaaS.** Owns the full renewal and expansion cycle: retention strategy, churn forecasting, negotiation, close, and pipeline development in partnership with Account Executives; understands how delivery health directly impacts commercial outcomes.
* **Escalation management and operational accountability**. Owns ticket triage, escalation, and resolution end to end for the full portfolio; manages complex, multi-workstream escalations with minimal manager involvement; builds relationships with Product, Engineering, and Support counterparts to accelerate resolution.

**What You'll Do**

* **Account health monitoring and risk identification.** Independently assesses account health and risk across commercial, operational, and relationship dimensions; surfaces risk early by reading ticket patterns, stakeholder signals, and adoption data as intelligence; builds intervention plans without manager direction.
* **Executive business review design and delivery.** Designs and executes QBRs and EBRs for all accounts including executive-level engagement; leads conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value rather than product update calls.
* **Renewal ownership and churn forecasting.** Owns all renewals across the portfolio: builds retention strategy, leads negotiations, closes; accurately forecasts ARR churn risk and develops mitigation plans using account health data, stakeholder intelligence, and delivery performance indicators.
* **Expansion identification and commercial execution.** Drives inbound expansion deals independently; collaborates with Account Executives per Unit of One model for strategic accounts; leads with value, not discount-first positioning; builds commercial plays grounded in customer intelligence.
* **Delivery follow-through and client communication ownership.** Owns the client-facing narrative when delivery issues arise, ensuring commitments made to the client are tracked and fulfilled; translates technical or operational updates into language the client can act on; holds internal teams accountable through to confirmed resolution so the client has everything they need without chasing.

**What We Offer**

* A truly global mission with a passionate community in locations all over the world
* Huge impact and learning potential as our aspirations require bold innovation
* Highly competitive compensation
* Benefits include fully covered health coverage for employee and family
* Generous time-off policy and flexible work schedule

**About Our Process**

  

We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment - the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment.  
  
During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies.  
  
The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers. Finally we will ask you to meet with a number of our senior leaders to make sure that you are making the most informed call possible.

**Please note that:**

* We want to get to know you and have a genuine conversation, so the use of AI tools or assistance during live interviews is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification from the process
* Interviews may be recorded for internal review purposes to ensure fairness and enable collaborative hiring discussions within the team.
