jobs.description:
**Key** **Account Manager** – **Payments**

OxyX | SME Growth · Accounting Practice Partnerships · Payments & Business Technology  
Position: Key Account Manager – Payments

**Business: OxyX - Kanzpay**  
***www.KanzPay.com***  
***www.OxyTech.ae***

Reports to: Sales / Business Head  
Location: UAE – field and office-based

***Role purpose***

The Key Account Manager – Payments will drive the adoption and growth of OxyX among UAE small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs). The role combines two complementary routes to market: building productive referral relationships with accounting firms and acquiring, onboarding and managing SMEs directly.

The successful candidate will help business owners understand how OxyX can improve collections, payment journeys, customer engagement and day-to-day business decisions. The role is focused on consultative selling, trusted relationships, activation and sustained usage—not simply signing up accounts.

***Key responsibilities***

*1. Accounting firm partnership development*

* Identify, map and approach accounting, bookkeeping and tax advisory practices serving UAE SMEs. **Build relationships with practice owners, partners, directors and client-facing teams; explain the OxyX partner proposition clearly.** Position accounting firms as trusted referral partners who can introduce OxyX to suitable SME clients while retaining their own client relationships. **Arrange partner meetings, briefings, demonstrations and follow-ups; maintain a structured pipeline of prospective and active firms.** Equip partners with approved presentations, product information, referral processes and client onboarding support. **Identify client needs with partner firms and coordinate introductions with the SME's consent.** Maintain partner engagement, track referred opportunities and support partner activation and retention.

*2. Direct SME acquisition and sales*

* Identify and approach SMEs across relevant sectors, including retail, trading, professional services, hospitality and other suitable business categories. **Understand each prospect's business model, current ERP/accounting setup, payment and collection processes, operational pain points and growth priorities.** Conduct needs-based discussions and demonstrate relevant OxyX capabilities rather than delivering generic product presentations. **Explain how OxyX works as an intelligence and action layer alongside the SME's existing systems, subject to connector availability, permissions and supported data.** Develop proposals, manage objections, follow up opportunities and progress prospects through evaluation, decision and onboarding. **Build relationships with business owners, finance managers, operations managers and other decision-makers.**

*3. SME onboarding, activation and account management*

* Coordinate onboarding with the SME, accounting firm and internal implementation/support teams. **Ensure the SME understands agreed use cases, onboarding requirements, connector prerequisites and each party's responsibilities.** Support initial setup, user orientation and first-use milestones; escalate technical or integration issues promptly. **Monitor engagement, identify underused capabilities and recommend relevant steps to improve adoption and business value.** Maintain regular account reviews, resolve relationship issues and identify opportunities for expansion, renewal and referral. **Capture customer feedback and share product, integration and service improvement suggestions internally.**

*4. Product and market understanding*

* Develop working knowledge of OxyX's SME cockpit, business controls, AI-assisted insights, collections and payment-related workflows, rewards, expense-related capabilities and e-invoicing integrations where available. **Understand the distinction between OxyX technology/workflows and services delivered by banks, payment service providers, acquirers and accredited e-invoicing service providers.** Keep up to date with SME operating challenges, accounting practice needs, market developments and competitor propositions. **Translate customer feedback and market observations into clear inputs for product, marketing, operations and management.**

*Performance expectations*

Performance will be assessed on the quality and consistency of partner development, SME acquisition, successful onboarding, active usage, customer retention and value created for SMEs and accounting partners.

* Qualified accounting firms engaged and converted into active referral partners. **Qualified SME opportunities generated through partner referrals and direct acquisition.** SMEs successfully onboarded and activated, with agreed first-use milestones achieved. **Ongoing product adoption, account engagement, retention and expansion.** Quality of customer relationships, partner feedback and resolution of escalations. **Accurate CRM records, pipeline forecasts, meeting notes and sales reporting.**

*Skills, experience and attributes*

* Experience in B2B sales, key account management, merchant services, payments, fintech, banking, SaaS or SME business solutions. **Ability to sell through relationship-based channels, referral partners, professional firms or business ecosystems.** Confidence engaging business owners, accounting practice partners, finance leaders and operational decision-makers. **Strong consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, follow-up and account-management skills.** Ability to understand business workflows and explain technology in clear, practical, non-technical language. **Comfortable conducting field visits, meetings, product demonstrations and structured follow-ups.** Organised, self-driven and capable of managing a pipeline and multiple partner/customer relationships. **Good written and spoken English; additional languages commonly used in the UAE SME market are an advantage.** Working knowledge of UAE SME business practices and the payments/accounting ecosystem is preferred.

*Working relationships*

The role will work closely with the Sales / Business Head, accounting practice partners, SME owners and finance teams, product and implementation teams, customer support, and relevant external payment or technology partners.

*Professional conduct and role boundaries*

* Represent OxyX accurately and use only current, approved product descriptions, pricing, proposals and marketing materials. **Do not promise product features, integrations, settlement timelines, rewards, savings or business outcomes that have not been confirmed.** Do not present OxyX as a bank, payment service provider, acquirer or accredited e-invoicing service provider. Regulated payment and e-invoicing services are provided by relevant authorised partners. **Follow company policies for customer consent, data confidentiality, information security, onboarding and record keeping.** Do not collect, store or share customer credentials, banking passwords, OTPs or sensitive payment credentials. **Escalate complaints, suspected fraud, data incidents, compliance concerns and requests outside approved authority promptly.**

*What success looks like*

A successful Key Account Manager builds a dependable network of accounting practice referral partners while independently developing SME relationships. SMEs understand the practical value of OxyX, complete onboarding, use the capabilities relevant to their business and continue to engage. Accounting firms see OxyX as a way to strengthen their client service and create additional value—not as a threat to their role. This role is a senior role qualifying for the ESOPS as well. You may choose to apply at: **reach@OxyTech.ae**

Pay: AED3,900.00 - AED17,000.00 per month

At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates. jobs.title: Vice President, Finance Data Product Management – P&L
jobs.description:
The VP, Finance Data Product Owner – P&L Data (India) is the execution lead for the P&L data product agenda on
**One Data Foundation**
, supporting the VP, Global Data Product Owner – P&L. The role starts with
**Revenue and Expense Accrual**
data and sits where Finance, Accounting and Technology meet. It works day to day with data producers, consumers and P&L process owners’ teams, and turns the Global Product Owner’s priorities into certified, reusable data products.
  
  
The leader works with process owners to understand how the data is used and what outcome it supports and documents the manual processes and adjustments on both the production and consumption sides. The goal is to raise productivity and efficiency and keep the data products golden by reducing manual manipulation and point-to-point sourcing. The role builds
**governance by design**
(CDEs, definitions, ownership, lineage, DQ rules and controls) into each product and uses AI and automation to modernize a largely waterfall and manual delivery lifecycle.
  
  
*The Global Data Product Owner sets product strategy, priorities, the portfolio roadmap and senior stakeholder agreements. This role executes, recommends and escalates. Controllers, Global Accounting and FP&A own the process and the reported numbers, and Technology owns engineering and production operations.*
**Key Accountabilities**

* Bridge Producers and Consumers
* Be the working-level link between upstream accrual data producers and downstream consumers, so issues are raised once, routed to the right producer and tracked to closure.
* Partner with P&L process owners’ teams (Controllers, Global Accounting, FP&A and other consumers) to understand how they use the data and the outcome they need. Surface pain points and new needs early to the Global Product Owner.
* Draft and maintain producer–consumer terms: definitions, scope, frequency, granularity, quality thresholds, ownership and issue handling, for approval by the Global Product Owner.
* Support the consumer forum by preparing the agenda and facts, and make differences in how consumers interpret or override the same data visible.
* Understand and Reduce Manual Work
* Document the manual processes, adjustments and overrides on the production and consumption sides of each in-scope P&L process. Quantify the effort and find the root causes.
* Recommend and drive fixes: move adjustments upstream or into the product so they are made once and governed, remove spreadsheet dependencies, and stop point-to-point sourcing. Priorities are agreed with the Global Product Owner.
* Use AI and automation to speed requirements, metadata, CDE identification, lineage, DQ rules, documentation and testing, within agreed controls.
* Execute the P&L Data Products
* Run day-to-day delivery of the accrual data products. Maintain the backlog, define requirements, and work with architecture and engineering on sources, transformations, business rules and lineage.
* Prepare each product for certification: definitions, CDEs, lineage, DQ rules and controls complete, reconciled to the authoritative source, and confirmed to meet accounting requirements.
* Fix issues at the source with producers, strengthen reconciliation, and maintain a shared business glossary.
* Publish and reuse on One Data Foundation, enhancing existing products before creating new ones, and support retiring legacy sources and BI reports in favor of certified data.
* Report, Escalate and Lead
* Give the Global Product Owner clear, regular updates on progress, risks and decisions needed. Escalate early and prepare materials for senior stakeholder discussions.
* Work across time zones with agreed overlap hours, documented handoffs and clear written follow-up.
* Guide and develop team members in India as the work grows.

**Required Qualifications**

* Significant banking or financial services experience in Finance, Accounting or P&L functions.
* Strong working knowledge of revenue and/or expense accruals, accounting concepts, controls and reconciliations.
* Solid grasp of data lineage, quality and governance principles, with the ability to analyze and validate data independently (for example, SQL) and reconcile it to source.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to analyze manual processes and adjustments to find root causes and efficiency opportunities.
* Experience working between business and technology teams, with the ability to influence without direct authority and work effectively with global stakeholders across time zones.
* Clear written and verbal communication that explains data issues in terms of business impact.
* Demonstrated curiosity and a record of improving ways of working through automation or AI.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience with Databricks, Power BI or similar platforms; working knowledge of SQL and data modeling.
* Exposure to billing, revenue or general ledger systems and how they integrate with reporting platforms.
* Experience with platform migration or re-engineering programs, and with leading complex, multi-team work.
* Familiarity with GenAI or machine learning use cases in Finance, and agile or product ownership experience.
* Background in regulated or audit-sensitive environments, including regulatory and external reporting.
* Professional qualification (CA, CPA, CFA) or a degree in Finance, Accounting, Data or a related field.

MEASURES OF SUCCESS
  
  

* Delivery: accrual data products prepared and certified against the agreed plan, with documented producer–consumer terms.
* Manual work: manual processes and adjustments documented for each in-scope P&L process, with a measurable reduction in manual manipulation, spreadsheet dependencies and point-to-point feeds.
* Consistency and reuse: one agreed definition per P&L measure, more consumers on the certified products, and fewer report-level overrides.
* Issue efficiency: fewer duplicate issues sent to producers and faster resolution.
* Reliability: timely updates, early escalation and clean handoffs, as rated by the Global Product Owner.
* Partnership: process owners and producers report the role is fair, responsive and effective.

LEADERSHIP PROFILE AND CANDIDATE CALIBRATION
  
  

* Bridge-builder mindset (most important)

****What Good Looks Like****
Sits between producers and consumers by choice. Explains each side’s constraints to the other, gets both to commit to a shared agreement, and follows up until it holds.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Acts as a requirements taker or a ticket router. Describes the role as “gathering requirements” or “sending tickets.”
  
  

* Curious about the manual work

****What Good Looks Like****
Wants to see how consumers really use the data and finds the adjustments and spreadsheets behind it. Asks why until the root cause is clear.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Accepts manual adjustments as normal. Reports what people do without asking why.
  
  

* Ownership of execution

****What Good Looks Like****
Acts as an owner, not an order-taker. Follows through, flags problems early and keeps the Global Product Owner informed without being asked.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Waits for detailed direction or makes portfolio-level commitments without agreement from the Global Product Owner.
  
  

* Reuse-first and governance by design

****What Good Looks Like****
Defaults to one certified source and one definition. Builds CDEs, lineage, DQ rules and controls in as the product is built. Challenges point-to-point feeds and local copies.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Builds a new dataset for each request. Treats governance as a separate sign-off step.
  
  

* Curious and AI-forward

****What Good Looks Like****
Questions waterfall and manual ways of working. Experiments with AI and automation and keeps controls intact.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Defends the current process. Views AI as hype or as a replacement for judgment.
  
  

* Works well across time zone

You will support over 15 markets and currently 6000 global platform users with a view to increase utilisation in near future. You will ensure the platforms deliver value to the business and are used effectively. You will work closely with CX specialists and other platform users to understand and deliver their business needs through the platform capabilities. You will manage the relationship with platform suppliers to maximise value to IWPB by driving the implementation and adoption of new functionality and ensuring the rapid and effective response to our required fixes and CRs.

**In This Role, You Will**

* Manage the full product lifecycle to ensure that, over time, the needs of the platform users continue to be met
* As platform SME, work closely with Technology, Transformation, D&A and market teams to ensure the VOC platforms change agenda is delivered on time and in budget. Be hands-on and remove delivery blockers through appropriate action and escalation
* Operationalise the voice of the customer platform at its full potential across users, securing ROI and value to business and customers

**Platform management (BAU)**

* Manage the integrity of the platforms and all aspects of the of business-as-usual platform operation
* Improve platform functionality, eg. Text Analytics evolution, Topic creation, AI, rules, process, triggers, surveys
* Monitor the performance of the platform to optimise value to the local and global change agenda
* Ensure platforms updates are implemented, assessed and used
* Contribute to achievement of objectives and key results across the VOC Product and use data to inform prioritisation and decision making. Maintain a focus on ROI to ensure priorities align to areas of greatest impact
* Create and manage a standard process and ways of working to respond to requests for changes
* Own the global operationalisation of the customer platforms (e.g. Medallia; Complaints platform)
* Provide status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks and issues
* Communicate and align with multiple stakeholders across organizational levels and locations
* Work creatively and solution-focused, demonstrating collaboration, innovation, and excellence
* Establish gaps in platform utilisation and opportunities to create value to business from the platform capabilities
* Own the management of training, support materials, product enquiries. Develop and report utilisation KPIs
* Own, deliver and report on a program plan to meet HSBC’s needs, maximise value from the customer platforms and maintain the functional and security integrity
* 3rd party supplier management

**Platform development (transformation)**

* Manage the pipeline of new capabilities, improvements, fixes, and requests from VOC platforms’ users
* Prioritise product requirements and own the product backlog; coordinate pilots/launches/training
* Keep up with trends and emerging business models, reimagining how to generate value to the business/customers
* Work with platform suppliers to influence their development plans, derive value from updates and ensure speedy satisfactory resolution of HSBC requests
* Obsess about how to apply technology and data to solving problems or finding new opportunities

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
The Senior Product Manager-Trading will collaborate with the other Trading Product Managers and Trading Product Leads to help guide the vision for Trading, OMS, and IBOR products. We are building this product suite anew and collaborating with our design team to improve the advisor/trader facing workflows and build engaging experiences that scale. You will execute product vision, implement strategy, and collaborate with a cross-functional team in a manner that improves their efficiency and productivity.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Possess a solid understanding of Trading, Rebalancing, and OMS systems used in the US and European wealth management industry. You understand trading products in terms of their users, business value, technical landscape, data, vendors, and can relate these to other areas of the Addepar ecosystem
* Document and communicate goals for the product and drive an innovative product roadmap that conveys the team vision and goals to our clients
* Build consensus with the team to prioritize and define increments of work based on level of effort, interdependencies, and other relevant criteria
* Assist in adjusting strategy in response to changing company, business, market, and technical needs.
* Identify appropriate users, partners, competitors, and market trends from which to elicit input and draw inspiration

**Who You Are**

* Minimum 5+ years of relevant work experience and education in product management, software development, user workflows, and efficiently leading teams
* Fundamental knowledge in finance, trading, and investments, specifically with trading for wealth management firms
* Ability to communicate finance domain knowledge, problems and knowledge well both in person and in writing for internal development and sales teams as well for clients and 3rd party data partners
* Ability to partner with engineering to define the functional and technical implementation to tackle a business problem. This includes understanding of high level data development concepts, data modelling and the ability to write and review technical requirements documents
* Practical knowledge of agile thinking and lean practices; project management, and a strong ability to guide teams through project iterations
* A superpower for identifying the appropriate tools, people and techniques to accomplish objectives

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. As Director of Product Management, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for the capabilities that let Teradata's Enterprise Context Engine understand customer data on its own: schema and ontology discovery, natural language processing, and AI driven workflow and policy extraction. The Context Engine extracts, curates, and continuously improves metadata and business context, grounded in Teradata's industry knowledge models, so that human analysts move faster and AI agents are grounded in trusted enterprise meaning.
  
  
You will serve as the Context Engine's senior product leader in the region and partner closely with local engineering, data science, and architecture teams along with product and engineering leaders across the US. You will set direction, make prioritization decisions, and hold your team accountable for customer outcomes, from discovery and design through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy, Roadmap & Outcomes**

* Own the roadmap knowledge graph completion / Ontology Learning, Reflexion-based memory extraction, and reinforcement learning-focused feature sets within the Context Engine portfolio. Translate customer needs and business priorities into clear requirements, prioritization decisions, and success criteria.
* Act as the primary touchpoint and evangelist for Context Engine to customers, executives, and field teams in the APJ region.
* Define how these capabilities are reusable by and drive value across Teradata products, personas, and business domains, and across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Shape the competitive position and differentiation of the Context Engine against competitors such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft, Google, and emerging AI data platform and semantic layer vendors.

**Automated Workflow Assembly**

* Define the product vision for automatically assembling workflows from discovered schemas and semantics, including data preparation, mapping, validation, enrichment, and publication of context, without hand-built pipelines for each customer.
* Specify how agents plan, compose, and execute these workflows, including reusable workflow templates, orchestration, approval checkpoints, and rollback.
* Set requirements for observability, explainability, and auditability so that customers can see why a workflow was assembled the way it was and trust what it produced.
* Define how workflows and discovered context are exposed to external agents and frameworks through Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other open agent interfaces.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Customer adoption and production deployments of semantic extraction and automated workflow capabilities, including successful agent and application consumption of the context they produce.
* Discovery and mapping quality: accuracy, coverage, and confidence calibration of discovered schemas, relationships, and semantic mappings, and the share accepted by stewards without correction.
* Automation outcomes: reduction in time and manual effort to onboard a new customer data estate and reach usable context, and the share of workflows assembled and run without hand-built pipelines.
* Platform usability as measured by targeted KPIs and customer sentiment.
* Pipeline influence, win-rate contribution, and analyst and customer perception of Teradata's context and trusted-AI position.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor's degree and 12+ years of experience, including 6+ years in product management or equivalent technical product leadership, with 4+ years on enterprise NLP, search, or metadata and data discovery platforms.
* Hands-on experience with NLP and LLM-based applications such as entity and concept extraction, semantic matching, embeddings, and natural language grounding to structured data, including how to evaluate them.
* Experience with BPMN 2. 0 structured workflows, and a demonstrable record of bringing agentic AI solutions from concept to production.
* Working familiarity with ontology and knowledge graph concepts, and with how graph-based context is consumed by retrieval and agent systems.
* Experience with utilizing agent self-learning approaches such as Reflexion, Reflective learning (ERL), or similar approaches to verbal reinforcement learning to improve agents in response to events and encounters in production systems.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

**Experience:** 2–8 Years

**Salary:** ₹40,000 – ₹50,000 per month (based on experience and interview)  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Only

**Note:** This is a field-based role, not an office-based job. Candidates are not required to visit the office every day. You will manage your daily field activities, client meetings and follow-ups independently.

* Self-driven, proactive and capable of independently managing sales activities.
* Honest and transparent approach towards client acquisition.
* Immediate joiners only.

Monthly Targets

* Certified candidates who complete training and join will receive a training completion bonus equivalent to 7 days of their monthly salary package, along with

Pay: ₹45,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

jobs.title: Associate - Legal Counsel - Cross Border - Asset & Wealth Management
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

JPMorgan Chase & Co. is a leading global financial services firm with assets of $2.6 trillion and operations worldwide, and its Legal Department provides specialized legal support aligned to the firm's lines of business and corporate staff areas. Asset & Wealth Management is one of the largest asset and wealth managers in the world, serving institutional and retail clients through Asset Management and high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients through the Private Bank. The business offers global investment management across equities, fixed income, real estate, hedge funds, private equity, and liquidity, and provides trust and estate, banking, brokerage, and retirement services. The Legal Department is seeking an experienced lawyer to support cross-border efforts, focusing on reviewing and analyzing legal opinions related to the cross-border provision of asset and wealth management products and services, and helping document and communicate related legal and regulatory requirements.

This role is based in Mumbai, India, at the J.P. Morgan Mumbai Corporate Centre, and functionally reports to:

* A Managing Director and Associate General Counsel for Asset & Wealth Management in the United States
* An Executive Director and Assistant General Counsel for Asset & Wealth Management in the United Kingdom
* A local Asset & Wealth Management Legal supervisor in Mumbai

Job summary:

As an Associate Legal Counsel within Asset & Wealth Management Legal, you will support cross-border efforts with a primary focus on reviewing and analyzing legal opinions related to the cross-border provision of products and services. You will help drive documentation of cross-border laws and regulations and communicate related requirements to business stakeholders. You will partner with lawyers, compliance partners, business stakeholders, and external counsel to maintain clear, current, and usable guidance for the business.

Job responsibilities:

* Conduct the first review of new or updated legal opinions from external counsel and new or revised draft rules for the business to provide products and services on a cross-border basis, and facilitate periodic and ad hoc updates of existing materials based on legal or regulatory changes or business developments
* Draft summaries of updates to facilitate the review-and-approval process via an internal workflow tool
* Engage with external counsel, Asset & Wealth Management lawyers, Compliance, and business stakeholders to obtain and resolve feedback on updates
* Field stakeholders' basic queries concerning the materials and fact-specific queries
* Advise as the Legal Department's first point of contact on potential issues relating to cross-border materials
* Provide regular feedback to business stakeholders and cross-border forums on pending reviews
* Conduct additional research and assist on special projects as needed
* Create and enhance audit-ready processes in a highly regulated environment, including through the use of technology

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

* Demonstrate excellent English writing and communication skills
* Hold a law degree
* Be in compliance, prior to commencement of employment, with all relevant licensing requirements, including the requirements of the jurisdiction where the role will be located
* Be sufficiently well qualified to interpret and summarize external legal advice and articulate clear “rules of the road” for the business
* Operate as a self-starter who works collaboratively in a high-performing team, takes ownership of responsibilities and projects, and is results-oriented and flexible
* Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, complex business environment and maintain communication with attorneys regarding project status and estimated completion timelines
* Demonstrate competence with Microsoft Office products, including Microsoft Excel, and the use of large language models and artificial intelligence
* Successfully complete a conflicts of interest clearance review prior to commencement of employment (applicable to all Legal Department roles)

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

* Master of Laws (LLM) preferred
* 2–4 years of experience in financial services law
* Experience instructing and interacting with external counsel directly
* Experience working across jurisdictions and time zones

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

jobs.title: Gen AI Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Join us as a Gen AI Product Engineer
  
  

* In this key role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and scaling Generative AI (GenAI)-powered products and features that deliver tangible business value
* We’ll look to you to bridge product thinking and engineering execution, translating user needs into robust, production-ready AI solutions while driving innovation in the application of GenAI capabilities
* This is an opportunity to design and deliver production-grade GenAI solutions, including AI agents, conversational AI, and automation, with a focus on scalability, reliability, and performance
* We're offering this role at vice president level

What you'll do
  
  
As a Gen AI Product Engineer, you'll design, build, and deploy production-grade GenAI products and systems that turn user and business needs into secure, scalable, and reliable solutions. You'll also translate product and user requirements into scalable technical solutions, balancing model quality, latency, system complexity, and long-term maintainability, while building and integrating large language model (LLM) capabilities using modern frameworks and application programming interfaces (APIs).
  
  
This will include working across orchestration layers, retrieval pipelines, system integrations, prompt and context engineering, and model evaluation.
  
  
**You'll Also Be**

* Converting ambiguous product requirements and research concepts into robust technical architectures, balancing model capability, latency, cost, complexity, and maintainability
* Ensuring all GenAI solutions meet enterprise security, governance, responsible AI, and risk management standards, with appropriate controls, escalation, and mitigation built into delivery
* Developing and operating LLM solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, agent workflows, orchestration, prompt and content engineering, and model integration patterns
* Integrating GenAI capabilities into existing platforms through internal APIs, services, event flows, and data pipelines, ensuring resilience, observability, and maintainability in production environments
* Defining and applying approaches to model evaluation, benchmarking, monitoring, and continuous optimisation to improve quality, accuracy, reliability, and user outcomes
* Identifying and managing real-world AI system failure modes, including hallucinations, retrieval failures, tool-call errors, degraded model performance, and unsafe or non-compliant outputs
* Supporting production operations, including service monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, and on-call responsibilities where required for business-critical GenAI systems

The skills you'll need
  
  
We're looking for someone with proven experience designing, building, and operating production-grade GenAI software systems, with strong capabilities in Python, front-end design frameworks, distributed systems, API design, cloud-native engineering, observability, and performance-critical workloads. You should also bring experience translating ambiguous research concepts, emerging AI capabilities, user needs, and product requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable production systems within fast-moving product or research-led environments.
  
  
To succeed in this role, you'll need experience delivering GenAI or LLM-powered products beyond the prototype stage, including self-hosted model inference with frameworks such as vLLM, OpenAI-compatible serving patterns, orchestration layers, software development kit integration, and production systems. You must also bring a practical understanding of LLM application architecture, including prompt and context engineering, embeddings, vector search, RAG pipelines, agent workflows, tool-calling patterns, memory and context management, and the mitigation of real-world AI system failure modes.
  
  
**You'll Also Demonstrate**

* An understanding of model training, fine-tuning, adaptation, inference, and serving pipelines, including trade-offs in model selection, performance, cost, reliability, scalability, and operational complexity
* Experience evaluating, monitoring, and optimising AI systems, with working knowledge of responsible AI, model risk, security, governance, and operational controls in enterprise or regulated environments
* Hands-on experience deploying small language models for latency-, cost-, privacy-, or domain-specific use cases

jobs.title: Global AML Center, Vice President
jobs.description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
We are looking for an experienced leader with a strong track record in AML/KYC operations and transformation to provide senior leadership within the Global AML Center (GAC) in Hyderabad.
  
  
As part of the GAC leadership team, you will own delivery & transformation across AML/KYC portfolios - onboarding, event-driven reviews, periodic reviews, screening and quality assurance. You will also help shape and drive GAC’s strategic agenda. That means leading technology-enabled change, automation and AI adoption to build a scalable, standardized and data-led operating model. You will also take on Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) responsibilities for GAC: overseeing business management, budget and headcount planning, governance, and the site and people agenda in Hyderabad. You will balance strong day-to-day delivery with a clear view of where the function needs to be in the future.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The Global AML Center carries out AML/KYC activities as part of State Street’s global AML operating model. This includes Customer Identification Program (CIP), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), customer verification and customer risk rating across all business areas. Hyderabad is a key part of GAC’s global footprint.
  
  
Volumes, regulatory expectations and methodology changes keep growing, and adding capacity alone is not a sustainable answer. This role is central to changing how GAC operates: cutting manual effort, strengthening controls through technology and data, and positioning GAC as a strategic partner to the business rather than a purely operational function. As GAC grows, it also needs strong business management discipline: clear financial and headcount oversight, consistent governance, and a well-run site and people agenda.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As Vice President you will:
  
  
***Operational Leadership***

* Provide senior leadership for GAC operations in Hyderabad and act as a key point of contact for local India management and global stakeholders
* Own end-to-end delivery across assigned AML/KYC portfolios against agreed service, quality, risk and productivity standards
* Keep active oversight of volumes, pipeline, ageing and capacity, and raise emerging pressure before it affects delivery or compliance
* Set clear priorities across BAU, new business, remediation and regulatory commitments, and move resources as demand changes

***Strategy & Technology Change***

* Help shape GAC’s strategic direction and multi-year transformation roadmap, in line with business growth, regulatory change and the target operating model
* Lead strategic change initiatives from idea through to delivery and adoption, with clear business cases, measurable outcomes and benefits tracking
* Act as the business lead for technology change, working with Technology, product and change teams on enhancements to KYC platforms, workflow tools and data capability
* Identify and drive opportunities for automation, AI, digitization and workflow integration that reduce manual effort, improve turnaround times and strengthen controls
* Champion data-led decision making through better MI, dashboards and real-time visibility of pipeline, risk and performance
* Make sure process, policy and methodology changes are turned into sustainable system and operational changes, reducing reliance on manual workarounds
* Prioritize the change portfolio and balance investment, capacity and risk to deliver the greatest business value
* Build a culture of innovation and continuous improvement, and grow change and digital capability within the team

***Business Management & CAO***

* Act as CAO for GAC, partnering with the GAC Head on business management, planning and execution of the leadership agenda
* Lead annual budget, headcount and workforce planning, including capacity models, run-rate tracking, attrition and backfill planning
* Track expenses, productivity and cost efficiency, and support business cases for investment and location strategy
* Run the GAC management operating rhythm, including leadership meetings, governance forums, management reporting and executive or board materials
* Coordinate senior stakeholder and regulatory reporting, ensuring information is accurate, consistent and on time
* Track key initiatives, decisions and actions across the leadership team, making sure commitments are followed through
* Oversee administrative controls, including policies and procedures, entitlements and access, business continuity and resilience planning
* Partner with HR, Finance, Procurement, Real Estate and Technology on hiring, onboarding, workforce management, space and infrastructure
* Lead the Hyderabad site and culture agenda, including employee engagement, communications, town halls, recognition and talent programs

***Risk, Control & Governance***

* Maintain a strong control environment in line with AML/KYC policies, procedures and regulatory requirements
* Identify and address emerging operational and regulatory risks before they affect the business, and escalate where needed
* Ensure new technology, automation and AI solutions are put in place with appropriate controls, governance and risk oversight
* Support audit, regulatory and governance requirements

***Stakeholder Leadership***

* Work with Business Units, Compliance, Technology and Risk teams to resolve dependencies, close control gaps and drive accountability
* Represent GAC in senior forums with clear, fact-based views on delivery, strategy, risk, capacity and the decisions required
* Influence senior stakeholders to secure support and investment for strategic and technology initiatives

***People Leadership***

* Attract, develop and retain strong talent, and build leadership depth and succession across the Hyderabad organization
* Hold managers and teams accountable for outcomes while empowering them to make decisions, and create opportunities for them to realize their full potential
* Lead teams through change, building adoption and new ways of working

**What We Value**
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* Strong understanding of KYC/CDD/EDD, client onboarding, periodic reviews, screening and financial crime controls
* Strategic thinking: the ability to set direction and turn a long-term vision into executable plans
* A proven track record of leading technology-enabled transformation, automation or digital change in a regulated environment
* An understanding of how workflow platforms, data, automation and AI can redesign operating models
* Proven ability to lead large, complex teams, including managing other managers
* A forward-looking approach to risk, with the ability to anticipate issues rather than react to them
* Strong analytical skills, with experience using MI, KPIs and capacity data to drive decisions
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively
* Strong business management and financial acumen, including budgeting, headcount and workforce planning
* Ability to run a disciplined management rhythm and produce clear executive and board-level materials
* A collaborative leadership style that balances empowerment with accountability

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* 15+ years of relevant experience in AML/KYC, financial crime or operations within a large global financial institution
* Demonstrated experience leading strategic transformation and technology change programs, from business case to adoption
* Significant senior people leadership experience, including leading leaders
* Experience in business management role, including budget, headcount and governance ownership, is strongly preferred
* Bachelor’s degree required
* Strong knowledge of global AML/KYC regulatory requirements
* Experience with KYC workflow platforms (e.g., Fenergo/FenX), automation tools or AI solutions is an advantage
* Change or pro

Citi enables clients to achieve their strategic financial objectives by providing them with cutting-edge ideas, best-in-class products and solutions, and unparalleled access to capital and liquidity.

  
  

The Derivatives Credit Risk Technology Team is responsible for delivering Counterparty Credit Risk Management software solutions to Citi’s Risk organization which manages Citi’s exposure to financial institutions, governments and corporates that trade with Citi. The team builds and maintains software used to compute metrics that help mitigate Citi’s exposure to counterparty default. * Develop and review test scripts with business users as well as technology teams for System, User and Impact testing.

* Understand, analyse, and explain counterparty mark-to-future exposures on Derivatives books to users. Investigate Potential Future Exposure/EPE/EAD/RWA and related calculations for internal risk management and BASEL regulatory capital reporting based on the exposure profiles generated by the systems.

* Ability to trace changes in day to day exposures to changes in markets, books and or legal agreements.

* Where feasible develop excel prototypes to demonstrate and analyse risk calculations.
  

  

**Knowledge/Experience:**

  
  

* 8-12 years related experience in Business Analysis and Project Management in Capital Markets domain.

* SDLC awareness including knowledge of quality issues in software development.

* Excellent understanding of the mechanics and life cycle of derivatives products, including Options, Futures, Forwards and Swaps. Knowledge of Securities Financing Transactions (SFT) products an advantage.

jobs.title: Data Information Manager - Assistant Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

**Overview**:

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Our core activities are safeguarding assets, lending money, making payments and accessing the capital markets on behalf of our clients.

Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We strive to earn and maintain our clients and the publics trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviors that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities.

  
  

**The Quality Assurance and Testing Validation (QATV) team** delivers independent oversight and rigorous validation across the organization's regulatory reporting ecosystem and is dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, reliability and control through testing Citi’s regulatory and management reporting while providing an objective assessment of issue remediation.

QATV Reporting & Analytics team provides analytical support on:

Reporting & Intelligence — Building and maintaining data marts, synthesizing test results into quantitative metrics, and authoring detailed qualitative narratives and formal publication reports for senior stakeholders and report owners.

Operational Intelligence & Capacity Planning — Monitor testing sprints to ensure timeline adherence, leading proactive capacity planning across all execution phases, and leveraging skill assessments to assign qualified personnel to appropriate testing stages.

Testing & Exception Management Automation — Automation of design, creation, and execution of test scripts

  
  

**Job Summary:**

In this role, the Analyst will support the QATV function by maintaining dedicated testing data marts, consolidating validation outcomes, identifying data inconsistencies, and assisting in the drafting of detailed narrative reports and metrics for final publication to key stakeholders.

Working in close collaboration with team leads, the Analyst will also support testing delivery governance and resource management. jobs.title: Corporate Credit Underwriter - Senior Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.

Citi continues to enhance its business control and governance framework by building out Institutional Credit Management (ICM), a first line of defense business line, to house and consistently manage credit risk activities performed for Citi’s institutional clients. ICM’s objective is to provide integrated end-to-end credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, and monitoring for wholesale credit across the enterprise.

Within ICM, the Credit Underwriting function (“ICM UW” or “UW”) provides credit analysis, underwriting, and first line of defense credit approval for periodic / material transaction reviews, and any necessary subsequent credit monitoring across all institutional business including Corporate Banking, Services, and Markets relationships.

ICM Underwriters manage a portfolio of relationships, being responsible for the continuous monitoring of that portfolio. That includes the production of annual reviews, quarterly reviews, and the support of ad-hoc transactions and portfolio & industry reviews and stress testing, in partnership with Business and Risk.

**In this role, you’re expected to:**

Executes, aligned with global and regional strategies, all responsibilities regarding underwriting, including, but not limited to:

* Adoption of leading practices in credit analysis, underwriting, and monitoring, including the end-to-end underwriting process, from early origination discussions to development of credit approval memos, and senior approval forums

* Detailed review of financial analysis, due diligence, projection modeling, stress testing, risk ratings and other in-depth analysis performed by junior resources

* Review and approval of Credit Approval Memos (CAM) packages

* Partner with Front Office on structuring and production of term sheet for new transactions

* Facilitate relationships with key clients in Banking and Risk and with key Regulators, Internal Audit, and control functions

* Support ICM Underwriting organization on strategic initiatives / projects as required

**Risk Management Experience:**

* Senior credit approval authority covering large and complex underwritings, capital commitments, derivatives with multi-industry experience
* Experience in and exposure to global credit risk management standards
* Ability to understand capital markets products and complex financing and product structures
* Ability to provide strategic insights and strong sensitivity to macro and regulatory issues
* Able to discuss and address issues associated with the allocation of risk assets and risk capital in partnership with banking and product organizations

**Client Relationships / Business Partnership:**

* Proven ability to understand nuances of local markets, local regulation, and the capabilities and practices of competitors
* Navigates organizational complexity and breaks silos
* Creates and sustains a network of strong partnerships with the business in all segments geographies and other risk functions
* Provides well-reasoned, balanced assessments of risk/return trade-offs associated with transactions and client relationships

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the India Demat Team within India International Wealth and Premier Banking as Assistant Vice President – Demat Operations.

  

**Role Purpose**

  

The role holder will manage end-to-end depository participant operations within a regulated bank environment, encompassing demat account opening and servicing, settlement monitoring, reconciliations, income and DP charge controls, and regulatory reporting. The role will ensure accurate and timely execution in accordance with applicable SEBI requirements, NSDL/CDSL rules and bye-laws, PMLA, and HSBC policies and operating procedures.

  

The incumbent will drive operational efficiency and customer service quality across retail and corporate/institutional DP services, maintain robust risk and control standards, manage audit and regulatory review requirements, and implement regulatory and system changes within prescribed timelines.

  

**Principal Accountabilities**

* + Oversee demat account opening, modification, servicing and closure, including verification of client documentation and KYC/AML requirements, periodic account reviews, and corporate demat requests.
  + Ensure accurate and timely processing of dematerialisation and rematerialisation requests (DRF/RRF), Delivery Instruction Slips (DIS), pledge, un-pledge and invocation requests, and off-market and inter-depository transfers.
  + Monitor settlement cycles and ensure timely reconciliation with depositories and clearing corporations.
  + Oversee daily, weekly and monthly reconciliations of client holdings, DP balances, suspense accounts and control accounts; investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks.
  + Manage provisioning of income entries and reconciliation of DP charges in coordination with Finance/Accounts.
  + Prepare and submit regulatory and depository reports within prescribed timelines and maintain accurate MIS for management review and compliance oversight.

**Customers / Stakeholders**

  

* + Manage DP-related customer queries, grievances and escalations in coordination with branches, relationship and service teams, ensuring timely resolution.
  + Liaise with NSDL/CDSL, registrars and transfer agents (RTAs), Finance/Accounts, Compliance and other internal stakeholders to resolve servicing and operational matters.
  + Drive customer-centric improvements in turnaround time and service quality across retail and corporate/institutional DP services.
  + Act as the principal contact for Demat operational and regulatory matters across Operations, Compliance, Legal, Technology, Risk, Finance, Treasury, the business and relevant depositories.
  + Coordinate responses to regulatory queries, inspections, internal and external audits, and compliance reviews.
  + Drive cross-functional actions independently, secure clear ownership and deliver within agreed timelines.
  + Provide concise management reporting on key operational risks, regulatory actions, exceptions and outstanding deliverables.
  + Promote disciplined execution, clear accountability and strong collaboration across first- and second-line stakeholders.

* **Leadership and Teamwork**
  

* + Demonstrate ownership and accountability for assigned DP operations and coordinate with stakeholders to meet operational, regulatory and audit deadlines.
  + Work collaboratively with branches, service teams, Compliance, Finance and Technology on regulatory implementation, escalations and process changes.

* **Operational Effectiveness & Control**
  

* Conduct periodic process and control reviews to identify operational and regulatory risks.
* Own audit and inspection observations, agree remediation plans and ensure timely, evidenced closure.
* Monitor implementation of regulatory and product changes and confirm that required controls operate effectively.
* Proactively identify and escalate material operational, regulatory, conduct or control risks.
* Regulatory and business deliverables completed within prescribed timelines.
* Timely and sustainable closure of audit, inspection, compliance and control actions.
* Accuracy and completeness of regulatory trackers, governance records, evidence and management information.
* Reduction in repeat exceptions, overdue actions and material control gaps.
* Effective implementation of regulatory, product and process changes with appropriate documentation and stakeholder sign-off.
* Positive stakeholder feedback and effective escalation of material risks.
* Identify opportunities for automation and digitisation to reduce manual intervention and operational errors.
* Track new and revised regulatory and depository circulars and implement required process and control changes within defined timelines.
* Identify operational risks and ensure adherence to maker-checker controls, segregation of duties, standard operating procedures and HSBC operational risk frameworks.
* Monitor exceptions, failed transactions and reconciliation breaks, ensuring timely resolution and escalation of control issues.
* Strengthen controls over DIS usage, fraud prevention and unauthorised transactions, and maintain adherence to applicable KYC/AML, PMLA and depository requirements.
* Manage internal and concurrent audits, compliance inspections and regulatory reviews relating to DP operations; ensure closure of observations within stipulated timelines.
* Maintain HSBC internal control standards and ensure timely implementation of actions arising from audits and regulatory reviews.
  

This specialist role requiring independent judgement, strong execution discipline and the ability to influence senior and cross-functional stakeholders. The role holder will operate within approved product programmes, HSBC policies, procedures and governance standards, escalating matters outside delegated authority or risk appetite.

The role holder will maintain HSBC internal control standards, comply with relevant Group and local policies and procedures, and ensure timely implementation and closure of internal and external audit points and issues raised by regulators, Compliance or Risk.

  

**Role requirements / Educational Qualifications /Certification / Experience:**

  

* Graduate or postgraduate qualification, with relevant experience in banking or financial services, preferably across Liabilities, Banking Operations, Product Management and/or Demat/DP Operations
* 4–10 years of experience in DP operations, custody operations or capital markets operations within a bank, brokerage or financial institution, with hands-on experience of NSDL/

jobs.title: Chief Data Office - Data Management & Governance Lead - Vice President
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

**Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in our team to partner with the Business to provide a comprehensive view.**

As a Data Governance Lead (Vice President) within the Chief Data Office, you will lead Markets data quality and data lineage initiatives, partnering across business, control functions, and Technology to deliver measurable risk reduction, operational efficiency, and regulatory-ready outcomes.

**Job Responsibilities :**

* Lead discussions with technology teams to agree and implement technical solutions for data quality remediation, including control automation/industrialization, monitoring, and evidence generation where appropriate.
* Discover and document end-to-end data lineage, tracing data from creation to consumption to support regulatory requirements such as BCBS 239 and internal standards for critical data elements and critical data flows.
* Partner with Markets operations, technology, and product control teams to establish and document data quality controls across critical data flows, including control points, thresholds, exception workflows, and ownership.
* Implement and champion Data Quality practices across the Commercial & Investment Bank, supporting firmwide regulatory and strategic objectives by defining and driving adoption of data quality standards, thresholds, remediation SLAs, and control expectations.
* Provide advisory services on high-profile data initiatives, leveraging project management and business analysis expertise to embed data quality, data lineage, and control requirements into strategic change (e.g., platform migrations, new product initiatives) from inception.
* Influence and guide stakeholders at all levels to drive adoption of data quality standards and best practices, and lead stakeholder forums to drive decisioning, escalations, and risk acceptance where required.
* Represent the Chief Data Office in cross-functional forums, contributing to the development of data management strategies and frameworks, including data quality strategy, issue management cadence, control documentation standards, data lineage documentation standards, and executive-level materials for senior stakeholders.
* Define and maintain management reporting (KPIs/KRIs) for data quality performance, including issue aging, defect recurrence, lineage completeness, and control coverage, to support senior decision-making.
* Apply AI/LLM tools to accelerate data quality investigations and delivery (e.g., drafting lineage/control documentation, synthesizing investigation findings, generating validation logic/test cases), ensuring appropriate data handling, human oversight, and adherence to firm policies.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Significant experience in financial services, with a background in operations, finance, program management, data analytics, or business analysis, and demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional delivery across business and Technology stakeholders.
* Proven track record leading projects or business-as-usual initiatives focused on data quality, data lineage, control documentation, and metadata management, with clear accountability for outcomes, issue management cadence, and closure discipline.
* Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think strategically and connect detailed analysis to broader business objectives, including translating complex investigations into executive-ready options and recommendations.
* Proficiency in manipulating and analyzing large data sets using Excel (pivots, formulas, charts) and other data tools to validate issues, quantify impact, and evidence remediation effectiveness.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with experience engaging senior stakeholders across business and technology, including chairing working groups and contributing to senior steering forums.
* Self-starter with strong time management and organizational skills; adept at managing multiple priorities and delivering high-quality outcomes under pressure while operating with strong risk discipline and attention to controls.
* Deep understanding of business practices and products within the Commercial & Investment Bank, with a focus on Markets.
* AI/LLM experience (required): demonstrated experience using AI/LLM tools to improve productivity in data quality and data lineage documentation, analysis, and/or control design, with strong judgment around confidentiality, appropriate use, and required human review/validation.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Expertise in data quality, data lineage, metadata management, and data control concepts, including standards and control frameworks.
* Experience in a Chief Data Office or Data Quality organization within an investment bank or large financial institution.
* Proficiency in querying databases or data stores for advanced data analysis.
* Skilled in producing executive-level PowerPoint presentations for senior audiences.
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as BCBS 239 and industry best practices in data management, and ability to translate regulatory expectations into practical data quality, data lineage, and control outcomes.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.

  
  

Citi continues to enhance its business control and governance framework by building out Institutional Credit Management (ICM), a first line of defense business line, to house and consistently manage credit risk activities performed for Citi’s institutional clients. ICM’s objective is to provide integrated end-to-end credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, and monitoring for wholesale credit across the enterprise. Within ICM, the Credit Underwriting function (“ICM UW” or “UW”) provides credit analysis, underwriting, and first line of defense credit approval for periodic / material transaction reviews, and any necessary subsequent credit monitoring across all institutional business including Corporate Banking, Services, and Markets relationships.

  
  

ICM Underwriters manage a portfolio of relationships, being responsible for the continuous monitoring of that portfolio. That includes the production of annual reviews, quarterly reviews, and the support of ad-hoc transactions and portfolio & industry reviews and stress testing, in partnership with Business and Risk.

The successful candidate will join the Commodities Underwriting team and will manage a group of junior analysts based in Mumbai who support Underwriters in London. The Commodities Underwriting team is responsible for the coverage of commodity traders as well as clients from other commodity related industries globally.

**In this role, you’re expected to:**

  
  

Executes, aligned with global and regional strategies, all responsibilities regarding underwriting, including, but not limited to:

  
  

* Maintains underwriting coverage of an existing portfolio of clients while supporting the underwriting of prospective commodities managed clients (CMC); the geographical coverage will include companies from Europe and Asia.
* Manage a team of 4/5 junior analysts in Mumbai by focusing on talent development, workflow management, and performance evaluations.
* Adoption of leading practices in credit analysis, underwriting, and monitoring, including the end-to-end underwriting process, from early origination discussions to development of credit approval memos, and senior approval forums.
* Detailed review of financial analysis, due diligence, projection modeling, stress testing, risk ratings and other in-depth analysis performed by junior resources.
* Review and approval of Credit Approval Memos (CAM) packages for monitoring or transaction purposes.
* Partner with Front Office on structuring and production of term sheets for new transactions.
* Partners with Legal in the negotiation of credit terms related to trading documentation (such as ISDA, EFET and other trading documents).
* Facilitate relationships with key clients in Banking and Risk and other control functions.
* Support ICM Underwriting organization on strategic initiatives / projects as required.

**Risk Management Experience:**

  
  

* Senior credit approval authority covering large and complex underwritings, capital commitments, derivatives with multi-industry experience.
* Ability to work independently, demonstrated credit judgement and experience navigating risk policies.
* Experience in and exposure to global credit risk management standards.
* Ability to understand capital markets products and complex financing and product structures including derivatives.
* Ability to provide strategic insights and strong sensitivity to macro and regulatory issues.
* Able to discuss and address issues associated with the allocation of risk assets and risk capital in partnership with banking and product organizations.

**Client Relationships / Business Partnership:**

  
  

* Proven ability to understand nuances of local markets, local regulation, and the capabilities and practices of competitors
* Navigates organizational complexity and breaks silos
* Creates and sustains a network of strong partnerships with the business in all segments, geographies and other risk functions
* Provides well-reasoned, balanced assessments of risk/return trade-offs associated with transactions and client relationships
* Proven track record of partnering with global peers in leveraging and implementation of best practices

**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**

  
  

* Around 13+ years risk/risk-related credit work experience in banking/financial institutions or a commodity trader.
* Proven ability to effectively engage with Senior Credit Officers.
* Prior experience in managing a small team is preferred.
* Demonstrates strong ethics and integrity.
* Ability to see the ‘big picture’ in a complex environment.
* Can make decisions under pressure and short timeline.
* Excellent verbal & written communication skills. Active listening skills.
* Excellent presentation skills – adept at presenting effectively to audiences of various sizes and various constituencies.
  

  

**Education:**

  
  

* Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred.

Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential.

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) is an emerging markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

Credit & Capital Management Services (CCMS) under CIB are in the process of implementing a new, modern, and consistent E2E operating model. A key component of this operating model is the introduction of a first line credit management office, the Business Credit Office (BCO). The BCO function will complete tasks currently owned by multiple actors in the management of the first line credit risk responsibilities including structuring, credit analysis and rating recommendation, client credit monitoring tasks, credit terms and document negotiation and clients acting as a single handoff from a RM to the BCO for all Credit & Lending (C&L) tasks, creating a single control point. The function will be client facing and customer service orientated.

We are currently seeking an ambitious professional to join the team as an Assistant Vice President who will provide credit advisory and support services to Relationship Managers (RMs) / Coverage. This includes facilitating client review and renewal activities, and is responsible for carrying out customer outreach, research, financial and credit analysis on behalf of the RMs, ensuring exemplary risk management acumen and control standards are embedded within the end-to-end C&L process

  

**In this role, you will:-**

* Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk
* Responsible for the delivery of BCO tasks in line with agreed OKRs, SLAs and KPIs

• Own the end-to-end Credit & Lending servicing journey, ensuring a seamless and efficient process for customers and internal stakeholders• Participate in deal discussions and meetings with clients or credit risk
  

* Build and maintain strong relationships across the teams, including credibility with both Business and Risk leaders.
* Demonstrates ability to engage in constructive and consistent dialogue with risk partners, in a manner that effectively balances commercial outcomes and risk management
* Work with the BCO Team Lead to ensure adequate credit risk management controls are built into the operational process and robust MI is in place to track and measure risk against agreed thresholds
* Drive continuous improvement in productivity whilst enhancing client experience.
