jobs.title: Senior Vice President Marketing
jobs.description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:**

At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.

As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.

We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.

If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.

**About the Role:**

At CoinDCX, brand and growth are one system. Brand earns trust, and trust brings in users who stay, trade and recommend us. As
**SVP – Growth & Marketing**
, you will own both sides and make them work as one.

Your mandate is not to promote crypto, but to normalise it and make it trusted. You will shape how millions of Indians understand, assess and use this new asset class. You will own the full path from first awareness to a loyal customer: brand trust, recall, acquisition, activation, retention, win-back, product-led growth and consumer understanding.

You will work at the meeting point of cultural narrative, regulatory nuance, reputation and capital discipline. We need a leader who plans in multi-year horizons, stays steady under public scrutiny and builds systems that hold up through market cycles.

You will lead the full marketing organisation (Brand, Creative, Content, Social and Community, PR), the Growth teams (Retention, Resurrection, PLG, Product Marketing, SEO and Digital Marketing) and Consumer Insights. You will partner closely with the Business unit, which owns CLM, and with Product, Policy, Analytics and Leadership, so that what we build, say and stand for stays aligned.

If building one of India’s most consequential financial brands, and the growth engine behind it, excites you, this role will both challenge and reward you.

**What You'll Do:**

* You are the
  **DRI (Directly Responsible Individual)**
  for the full Growth & Marketing budget across ATL, BTL, digital media, performance, social, content and PR. You are accountable not just for outcomes, but for the reasoning behind every spend decision.
* **Metric & Budget Ownership:**
  Own the brand KPIs (brand health, social media metrics, organic acquisition) and the growth KPIs (new users, activation, retention, blended CAC, LTV). You are accountable for full funnel marketing and building brand trust.
* **Brand Strategy:**
  Own the multi-year brand roadmap. Turn complex VDA (Virtual Digital Asset) topics into simple, education-led stories that enhance trust while keeping technical accuracy.
* **Growth Strategy:**
  Own the plan from first install to long-term customer, with one shared view of the funnel across marketing and growth.
* **Retention & Resurrection:**
  Keep active users coming back, and bring lapsed users back, through product-led and marketing-led programmes.
* **PLG & Product Marketing:**
  Build referrals, in-product loops and organic acquisition with Product. Own positioning, launches and go-to-market for each product line.
* **SEO & Digital Marketing:**
  Own organic search and paid digital channels. Manage CAC, ROAS and cost per activated user, and direct media buying and budget allocation.
* **Consumer Insights:**
  Lead the insights team. Use research, user behaviour data and brand tracking to guide decisions across marketing, growth, product and business.
* **Org Design:**
  Lead and grow the full team, from creatives to analysts to performance specialists. Build a strong layer of second-level leaders so day-to-day execution does not depend on you.
* **Reputation Systems:**
  Design and own proactive PR and “Issue Readiness” playbooks to protect institutional credibility during market volatility.
* **Product & Policy Partnership:**
  Work with Product and Policy so the brand promise of “Responsible Education” shows up in the app experience and in all advertising, and stays compliant.
* **Experimentation & Measurement:**
  Run a steady pipeline of growth and brand experiments with Product and Analytics, and set one trusted set of numbers for the whole function.

**You’ll Excel in This Role If You Have:**

* **Think in First Principles:**
  You look for the real reason users do not trust us or do not stay, rather than applying standard marketing frameworks.
* **Act as an Owner:**
  You treat company capital and reputation as your own, and make hard trade-offs to protect long-term brand value over short-term “hacks.”
* **Are Equally at Ease with Story and Numbers:**
  You can judge a brand film and read a funnel or cohort chart with the same confidence.
* **Translate Strategy:**
  You turn disruptive technology into simple, trusted, mass-market stories without losing technical accuracy.
* **Build Systems:**
  You build scalable content, PR and growth engines instead of managing individual tasks.
* **Lead Leaders:**
  You have led large, mixed teams of creatives, analysts and performance specialists, and earned the respect of each.
* **Decide Under Scrutiny:**
  You are comfortable being the final decision maker in moments of reputational, regulatory or public pressure.

**You’ll Know You’re Winning When:**

* **Trust & Recall:**
  “Institutional Trust” scores and “Responsible Education” recall rise in a measurable way.
* **Growth:**
  More new users complete KYC, make a first deposit and place a first trade, and retention and win-back rates improve.
* **Efficiency:**
  Blended CAC falls as organic acquisition and brand-led conversion improve.
* **Market Share:**
  CoinDCX’s share of the total Indian crypto user base grows.
* **Evidence-Led Decisions:**
  Consumer Insights visibly shapes major campaign, product and business decisions.
* **One Plan with Business:**
  Growth, Marketing and CLM run to shared targets without friction.
* **Independence:**
  Your leadership bench runs high-impact campaigns and growth programmes with little intervention from you.

**Why This Role Matters & What’s In It For You:**

You will bring brand and growth together under one leader at a $2.45B unicorn, and shape how a nation learns to trust a new financial system. You will work side by side with the founders to drive the company’s mission, and you will see first-hand how a brand and a user base scale from 10 → 100 in one of the world’s fastest-evolving industries. Very few roles offer this. This is one of them.

**Hiring Process:**

Here’s what your journey with us looks like:

* **Application Review**
  – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* **Recruiter Connect**
  – A short conversation to understand you better
* **Functional Round(s)**
  – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving
* **Assignment / Simulation Round**
  –A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios
* **Culture & Values Discussion**
  – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best
* **Founder Conversation (Optional)**
  – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit

**Where We Work:**

We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.

With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our
**Bangalore**
office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.

**Perks That Empower You:**

We believe great people deserve great experiences.

* **Design Your Own Benefits:**
  Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* **Unlimited Wellness Leaves:**
  Rest and recharge as you need
* **Mental Wellness Support:**
  Access to therapy and wellness resources
* **Learning Sessions:**
  Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities

**Ready to Bu

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Commercial Services
jobs.description:
**About Tide**

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

**Tide Facts**

* Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

**About The Team**

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Commercial Services. You will report to the CDTO and partner with Product and Design leadership as one leadership team accountable for the outcomes of the domain.

Commercial Services is where Tide extends from helping members run their business to helping them grow it. You will shape how quickly every member becomes discoverable, how much of their buying and selling runs through Tide, and how far AI can turn that into a lasting advantage across every market we serve.

Sell gives every member a live, discoverable presence, from the Tide Business Pages we are launching for 2 million members across the UK and Europe, to Own Website, catalogue, bookings, CRM and lead capture, and embedded fulfilment through Delivery as a Service.

Buy turns that member base into a two-sided marketplace through the Tide Online Network, alongside Tide Promotions (gift cards, cashback and personalised offers), business supplies from partners, and Vendor Hub for e-procurement.

You will be the single owner accountable for engineering delivery, architecture and people across both.

**About The Role**

This role sits at the intersection of SME commerce, marketplaces and banking. Our members sit on both sides of the marketplace, our partners extend what we can offer them, and our banking platform lets us layer payments, credit, insurance and rewards into the experience at the point of need, which few commerce players can do. We need someone who can bring both streams onto one consistent engineering bar, ship quickly and build the platforms that turn Commercial Services into a material recurring revenue line for Tide.

As Director of Engineering you will

* Set the engineering strategy and technical direction across the Sell and Buy value streams, from launch through to scale.
* Lead the Heads of Engineering for Sell and Buy, build the leadership bench underneath them, and own headcount planning, hiring and organisation design.
* Partner with Product and Design leadership on one shared plan, jointly owning delivery and outcomes, including members activated through real sales and purchases, engagement and recurring revenue.
* Scale the Tide Business Pages and Tide Online Network into a trusted, high-traffic marketplace, including search, listings, member-to-member leads, chat and buyer requests.
* Build the partner integration platform behind our website, gift card, business supply and logistics partners, enabling new partners and offers to be onboarded quickly and safely.
* Work with Payments, Acquiring, Credit, Insurance and Wealth to embed payments, credit, insurance and rewards into commerce journeys at the point of need.
* Build trust into the marketplace in partnership with Ongoing Monitoring and Risk, from verified seller status to initial and ongoing monitoring of listings and member-to-member communication.
* Set a consistent engineering practice and quality bar across architecture, delivery health measured through DORA metrics, reliability and security.
* Lead our move towards AI-assisted and agentic commerce, where a member describes what they need and Tide finds, compares and sources it.
* Apply our OnePlatform principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Director engineering leadership of a multi-team organisation of around 50 engineers across backend, frontend, data and analytics, led through at least one layer of engineering leaders.
* Domain experience in e-commerce, two-sided marketplaces, CRM or procurement platforms, including the trust and safety controls they need, with fintech or SME banking experience a plus.
* Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable product and commercial outcomes.
* Experience building partner and third-party integration platforms at scale.
* Strong product and design partnership instincts.
* Comfortable setting direction through ambiguity and launching new products into multiple markets.
* Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, architecture and technical quality.
* Experience bringing AI or agentic experiences into customer-facing commerce products would be a bonus.

**Our Tech Stack**

* Backend: Java, Spring/Spring Boot, microservices architecture
* Mobile/Web: Flutter / Angular
* Infrastructure: AWS (SNS+SQS), PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora, GCP (BigQuery, Vertex)
* Observability: Coralogix (OpenTelemetry
* Claude for agentic ways of working

**What You’ll Get In Return**

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

* Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options.
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
* Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
* Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
* Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
* Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a
**flexible workplace**
model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transpare

-Experience in building teams and delivering measurable business outcomes.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
About
**Bright Money**

Bright Money
is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products that help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and access suitable loans and credit cards - the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck to paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with a revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with financial services marketplace revenue from loans, credit cards, and credit-building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by three top global venture capital firms and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was established in 2019 by a leadership team drawn from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi’s Data Sciences organisation (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, joined more recently by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright has a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture, and is building a global Consumer FinTech with all functions operating from India.

**What is the role about?**

Bright is looking for a Director - Engineering to lead and scale a core part of our engineering organisation in Bengaluru, reporting to the CTO. You will own delivery and technical direction for the systems behind Bright’s consumer app, credit decisioning, and AI products, and you will build the leadership layer that runs them.

This is a leader-of-leaders role. You will manage engineering managers and leads, shape architecture and platform strategy for your area within the CTO’s technical direction, own headcount, budget, and cloud spend for your teams, and partner with Product, Data Sciences, and the wider leadership team on what gets built next.

Bright is profitable, scaling fast in the U.S. market, and building AI into both the product and how the company runs. The systems are distributed, data-heavy, and carry real money and credit decisions, so engineering quality is a business outcome here, not an internal metric.

**What will you do?**

* Lead your organisation: Own and scale a multi-team group, with engineering managers and leads reporting to you; set the operating rhythm, standards, and performance bar across your teams.
* Build the leadership layer: Hire, coach, and retain senior engineers, leads, and managers, and develop the next line of engineering leadership beneath you.
* Technical strategy: Shape and execute architecture and platform strategy across services, data, and developer tooling for your area, in line with the CTO’s technical direction, and make the build-versus-buy and platformisation calls that shape how fast your teams can ship.
* Delivery at scale: Own end-to-end delivery of distributed, data-heavy systems - roadmap commitments, release predictability, and the trade-offs between speed and durability.
* Reliability & risk: Own availability, performance, security, and the engineering side of compliance obligations for the systems your teams run in a U.S. consumer-lending business.
* AI & ML in production: Partner with Data Sciences to productionise ML and Gen AI systems-serving, monitoring, and retraining - and raise engineering leverage through AI tooling across the org.
* Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Product, Data Sciences, Infrastructure, and business teams on priorities, sequencing, and the commitments engineering makes to them.
* Planning & budget: Own annual and quarterly planning for your area - headcount, vendor decisions, cloud cost and TCO, and the resourcing choices behind them.
* Reporting & visibility: Report clearly to the CTO and the wider leadership team on progress, risk, capacity, and investment, and contribute to leadership reviews as needed.

**Ideal candidate profile**

**Experience & Background:**

* Experience: 12+ years in engineering, with 5+ years in engineering leadership and at least 2 years managing managers or leads.
* Organisation scale: Has led a multi-team group of 20+ engineers, and has grown a team through a period of rapid scaling.
* Systems depth: Deep hands-on background in distributed, high-throughput, data-heavy systems; still able to go deep in a design review and hold a credible technical argument.
* Architecture & platform: Proven ownership of architecture, platformisation, and developer tooling, with evidence of the delivery gains those investments produced.
* ML & AI in production: Experience productionising ML or Gen AI systems in partnership with data science teams.
* Commercial ownership: Experience owning engineering budgets, cloud cost and TCO, vendor decisions, and resource planning.
* Hiring record: A strong track record of hiring and developing senior engineers and engineering managers.
* Domain: Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or another regulated, high-reliability consumer business is a strong plus.
* Location: Based in Bengaluru, or willing to relocate.

**Mindset & Operating DNA:**

* Ownership: Takes accountability for outcomes beyond their own remit, not only for their teams’ deliverables.
* Technical credibility: Earns the respect of senior engineers through judgment and depth, not position.
* Strategic thinking: Connects technical choices to business outcomes and can defend the trade-offs to a non-technical audience.
* Builder of leaders: Measures success by the strength of the managers and engineers they develop.
* Pace: Thrives in a high-growth environment where structure is still being built, and brings clarity rather than waiting for it.

**Non-Fit Profiles**

* Individual contributors or architects without sustained people-leadership experience.
* Managers who have led a single team, without experience managing managers or leading a group through scale.
* Leaders who have moved fully away from technical depth and cannot hold their own in architecture and design discussions.
* Candidates from large, process-heavy environments who need established structure, and are uncomfortable in a fast-moving, ambiguous setting.
* Delivery or programme managers without hands-on engineering ownership.

**What Bright Offers?**

* A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale - liquidity potential at $1-3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You own delivery and technical direction for a core part of the platform, with a direct line to the CTO.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Benefits: Excellent benefits package in line with sector best practice.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing/Growth
jobs.description:
**Head of Marketing / Head of Growth**

**AppsForBharat | Bengaluru | 10+ Years Experience**

**About AppsForBharat**

At
**AppsForBharat**
, we are building Sri Mandir, a leading devotional and spiritual platform that helps millions of devotees connect with their faith through technology.

Our ecosystem brings together three businesses:

* **Sri Mandir:**
  An app and website offering Puja, Chadhava, Seva, devotional content, music and temple information.
* **Sri Mandir Store:**
  An online store offering spiritual products such as Rudraksha, gemstones, bracelets, idols and more.
* **Kundli Guide by Sri Mandir:**
  A platform offering personalised astrology reports and expert consultations.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a
**Head of Marketing / Head of Growth**
who can build and lead the overall growth strategy across these businesses.

**The Role**

We are looking for a business-focused marketing leader who knows how to acquire customers, drive revenue and build long-term customer engagement.

This is not just a traditional marketing or brand-building role. You will be responsible for driving business growth by bringing together performance marketing, product, customer acquisition, content and retention.

You will work closely with the Product and Business teams to make Sri Mandir an app first platform, acquire more users, improve their experience and encourage them to engage with and purchase multiple services across our ecosystem.

**What You Will Do**

**1. Own Overall Marketing and Business Growth**

* Build and lead the overall marketing and growth strategy across Sri Mandir, Sri Mandir Store and Kundli Guide.
* Drive growth in new users, customer acquisition, transactions and overall revenue.
* Identify new opportunities to expand our user base and reach new customer segments.
* Take ownership of key business metrics such as customer acquisition cost, marketing returns, revenue and customer lifetime value.

**2. Build an App-First Growth Strategy**

* Make mobile apps a primary channel for customer acquisition, engagement and transactions across business categories.
* Develop strategies to increase app downloads, registrations, active users and purchases.
* Work closely with Product teams to improve app onboarding, user journeys and purchase experience.
* Identify opportunities to introduce users to multiple services within the Sri Mandir ecosystem.

**3. Drive Performance Marketing and Customer Acquisition**

* Lead performance marketing across platforms such as Google, Meta and other relevant digital channels.
* Build scalable customer acquisition strategies while maintaining efficient marketing spends.
* Continuously experiment with campaigns, audiences, creatives and channels to improve results.
* Build a strong understanding of what drives conversions and revenue, beyond just app installs or website traffic.

**4. Drive Customer Retention and Repeat Purchases**

* Develop strategies to bring existing users back to the platform and encourage repeat transactions.
* Build strong CRM and lifecycle marketing capabilities through push notifications, WhatsApp, email and other channels.
* Use customer insights and behaviour to create relevant and personalised communication.

jobs.title: Associate Director - Credit Card Sales
jobs.description:
**About WeRize**

Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India’s largest full stack fintech platform for 500 million underserved middle-class customers who live in 5000+ small towns of India. WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd).

This customer segment is not served by private sector banks, Insurers and Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks. PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property , health/life insurance and investment products. WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans, savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit.

While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need proper guidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves. So, a pure digital model doesn’t work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its ‘Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)’, a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support. These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions.

Our social distribution platform supported by financially literate freelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on the-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when compared to upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn’t work for this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on-field teams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That results in very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousands of freelancers in 5000+ cities only through its tech platform and without any feet-on-street team of its own. This results in highly profitable business model for Werize.

To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.com/

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a high-impact, business-driven
**Chief Manager / Associate Director – Credit Card Sales**
to lead and scale our Credit Card vertical. In this role, you will be responsible for building end-to-end sales strategies, managing banking and co-branded card partnerships, and scaling credit card distribution across our social freelance partner network in 5,000+ small towns.

You will act as the single point of contact between bank partners, internal product/tech teams, and our freelancer channel to drive high-volume, cost-effective, and compliant credit card issuance tailored to India’s middle-income segment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership & Sales Execution**

* Own the P&L, sales targets, and portfolio growth for the Credit Cards vertical across 5,000+ towns.
* Formulate and execute scalable sales strategies to drive credit card adoption through our unique tech-enabled freelancer distribution platform (
  **‘Finance ki Online Dukaan’**
  ).
* Analyze regional performance, conversion funnels, and customer approval rates to continuously optimize sales pipelines.

**Partnership & Ecosystem Management**

* Onboard, manage, and scale partnerships with leading banks, card issuers, and fintech partners.
* Collaborate with partner institutions to design customer journeys, credit policies, and product variants tailored to Tier 2/3/4 customer profiles.
* Serve as the key liaison for day-to-day operations, SLA management, and approval rate optimizations with partner banks.

**Partner Enablement & Channel Engagement**

* Work alongside channel and marketing teams to design training modules, sales enablement toolkits, and commission/incentive structures for local freelancers.
* Drive engagement, active sourcing, and product cross-selling across the freelancer network to maximize card issuance.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with internal Product, Tech, and Analytics teams to enhance digital application flows, minimize friction, and automate approval pipelines.
* Ensure strict adherence to RBI guidelines, partner bank compliance, data privacy, and ethical selling practices across the freelance network.

**Qualifications & Skill Set**

* **Experience:**
  8 to 15 years of core experience in Credit Card sales, partner management, or unsecured lending within Banks, NBFCs, or Fintechs.
* **Distribution Expertise:**
  Proven track record in scaling financial products through indirect channels, agency networks, DSAs, or tech-enabled social/freelancer distribution.
* **Banking Partnerships:**
  Prior experience managing relationships, integrations, and SLAs with major credit card issuing banks.
* **Data-Driven Approach:**
  Deep understanding of approval funnels, customer acquisition metrics (CAC, LTV), and credit underwriting basics for middle-income segments.
* **Entrepreneurial Mindset:**
  Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, solve unstructured problems, and take complete ownership of product-line growth.

jobs.title: Area Sales Head
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
Urban Money is India’s first unbiased loan advisory services firm, offering end-to-end guidance on a wide range of loans and mortgage solutions. The company brings together experienced professionals from leading banking and financial institutions such as HSBC, Citibank, Standard Chartered Bank, ICICI, and others to provide clients with expert support on interest rates, lender options, comparisons, and documentation. Urban Money serves as a distributor for several reputed financial institutions, including HDFC, Axis, Kotak Mahindra, PNB, Tata Capital, and more, enabling access to diverse borrowing options. Its private banking-style business model assigns dedicated loan portfolio counselors to each client, managing the entire borrowing journey from product selection to disbursal. Urban Money currently operates in 100+ locations across India, facilitating home loans for a broad spectrum of customers.
  
**Role Description**
The Area Sales Manager role at Urban Money is a full-time, on-site position based in Hyderabad. The Area Sales Manager is responsible for driving sales of loan and mortgage products by managing and expanding a network of partners, channels, and client relationships within the assigned territory. Day-to-day activities include meeting prospective and existing clients, identifying their borrowing needs, recommending suitable loan products, and coordinating with internal teams and financial institutions to ensure timely processing and disbursal. The role involves setting and achieving sales targets, monitoring performance metrics, and implementing local market strategies to increase business volume. The Area Sales Manager also oversees a sales team, provides guidance and training, and ensures adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong sales, business development, and relationship management skills in financial services or related sectors.
* Ability to analyze customer needs, recommend appropriate loan or mortgage solutions, and negotiate effectively with stakeholders.
* Experience in territory management, channel development, and team leadership, preferably in banking, NBFCs, or loan distribution.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills to engage with clients, partners, and internal teams.
* Comfort with using CRM tools, basic MS Office applications, and digital platforms to track sales activities and performance.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Knowledge of home loan and mortgage products, credit processes, and local Hyderabad market dynamics is highly beneficial.
* Proven ability to work towards ambitious targets, maintain ethical standards, and deliver high-quality client service.

As an Engineering Director at Backbase, you will lead a multi-project engineering organization delivering complex digital banking solutions for leading financial institutions in the Middle East region. You are accountable for building a high-performing engineering organization that consistently delivers predictable, high-quality software while developing future engineering leaders.
  
  
This is not only a delivery leadership role. You are expected to continuously improve how engineering operates by introducing modern engineering practices, scaling engineering excellence across teams and driving AI-assisted software development.
  
  
You will lead Engineering Managers and Technical Leaders across multiple customer engagements, engineering quality and organizational growth.
  
  

* Lead and grow an engineering organization of 100+ engineers across multiple customer programs.
* Coach, develop and raise the bar for Engineering Managers through regular mentoring, feedback and performance management.
* Drive engineering excellence by improving delivery predictability, quality, developer experience, operational readiness and engineering metrics.
* Establish consistent engineering governance, release readiness, architecture and quality practices across multiple teams.
* Partner with customers, Delivery Managers, Technical Leaders, Architects and Product leadership to build trusted engineering relationships and resolve complex delivery challenges.
* Build a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement and technical excellence.
* Lead engineering transformation through adoption of AI-native development practices, Agentic SDLC, automation and modern platform capabilities.
* Develop engineering capability for the region through hiring, succession planning, technical communities and career development.

What success looks like
  
  

* You build an organization where:
* Engineering Managers grow into exceptional leaders.
* Teams deliver predictably with a balance of quality.
* Engineering decisions are driven by data.
* Customers trust engineering commitments.
* AI measurably improves engineering productivity and quality.
* Engineering standards scale consistently across projects and teams.
* Difficult organizational changes are implemented when required to improve long-term outcomes.
* Proven experience leading multiple engineering teams (50+ engineers) through Engineering Managers.
* Experience operating large-scale software delivery organizations across multiple concurrent projects.
* Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices including architecture governance, CI/CD, testing strategies, observability, operational excellence and engineering metrics.
* Demonstrated success building and coaching engineering leaders

Experience leading organizational transformation and driving measurable engineering improvements.
  
  

* Strong customer-facing leadership with the ability to build trust while navigating difficult delivery situations.
* Hands-on understanding of AI-assisted software engineering, developer tooling and Agentic SDLC with the ability to pragmatically introduce these practices across engineering organizations.
* Excellent communication skills with both executive stakeholders and engineering teams.
* Bias for ownership, continuous improvement and data-driven decision making.

Leadership principles
  
  

* Engineering Directors at Backbase:
* Build leaders.
* Measure outcomes, not activity.
* Solve systemic problems rather than local optimizations.
* Raise engineering quality without slowing delivery.
* Challenge the status quo and continuously improve how engineering works.
* Embrace AI as an engineering multiplier while maintaining strong engineering fundamentals.

jobs.title: Head Forging
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and dynamic **Head Forging** to lead and manage forging operations within our Steel Division at Hyderabad. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in forging operations, production planning, process optimization, quality management, and team leadership within a steel or heavy manufacturing environment.

The incumbent will be responsible for overseeing end-to-end forging operations, ensuring production efficiency, product quality, workplace safety, cost optimization, and on-time delivery while driving continuous improvement initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Forging Operations & Production Management**

* Lead and manage end-to-end forging operations, ensuring efficient utilization of manpower, machinery, and resources.
* Develop and execute production plans to meet business targets, quality standards, and delivery schedules.
* Oversee forging processes, including heating, billet preparation, hot forging, trimming, heat treatment coordination, and associated operations, as applicable.
* Monitor production output, cycle time, rejection rates, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).
* Ensure optimum utilization of forging presses, hammers, furnaces, and related equipment.

**2. Process Optimization & Operational Excellence**

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, reduce cycle time, and minimize material wastage.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, energy conservation, and cost reduction.
* Implement Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, TPM, and other operational excellence practices.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for forging operations.

**3. Quality Management**

* Ensure compliance with established quality standards, customer specifications, and applicable industry requirements.
* Reduce rejection, rework, and scrap through root cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions.
* Work closely with Quality and Engineering teams to resolve process-related quality issues.
* Ensure proper process control, traceability, and documentation throughout production.

**4. Maintenance & Equipment Management**

* Coordinate with the Maintenance team to ensure equipment reliability and minimum downtime.
* Drive preventive and predictive maintenance practices for forging equipment and furnaces.
* Support equipment upgrades, capacity expansion, tooling improvements, and new process implementation.

**5. Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure strict adherence to industrial safety standards, particularly for hot forging, furnace operations, material handling, and heavy equipment.
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with applicable statutory and environmental requirements.
* Conduct regular safety reviews, risk assessments, and corrective action follow-ups.

**6. Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop production managers, engineers, supervisors, and shop-floor teams.
* Establish clear performance objectives and accountability across the department.
* Identify training needs and improve technical competencies and workforce productivity.
* Foster collaboration across Production, Quality, Maintenance, Planning, and Supply Chain functions.

**7. Cost Control & Business Performance**

* Prepare and monitor departmental budgets, production costs, and resource utilization.
* Drive initiatives to reduce conversion costs, consumable costs, energy consumption, and manufacturing losses.

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is responsible for establishing, implementing, operating, monitoring, and continuously enhancing OneFin’s Information Security Management System (ISMS) across all product lines and enterprise infrastructure.

This leader will own end-to-end information security strategy, cloud security governance (AWS), regulatory compliance (RBI guidelines for digital lending and IT governance), ISO/IEC 27001:2022 standards, and client-facing security assessments for institutional banking partners. Implement zero trust security architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Information Security Governance & Strategy**

* Define, maintain, and enforce OneFin's Level-1 ISMS policies, standards, and guidelines in alignment with business goals.
* Report security posture, risk profiles, and incident metrics directly to the CEO, C-suite, and Board of Directors.
* Lead the annual risk assessment framework across all business units, maintaining the enterprise Risk Register and tracking remediation strategies.
* Establish annual security objectives, measurable parameters, and operational security targets.

**2. Regulatory, Compliance & Client Audit Management**

* Direct compliance for ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certifications, surveillance audits, and internal security audits.
* Ensure strict adherence to Reserve Bank of India (RBI) guidelines regarding digital lending, data localization, outsourcing, and cloud management.
* Act as the executive point of contact for financial institution (FI) client audits, managing Information Security Group (ISG) checklists, VAPT review points, and security questionnaires.
* Oversee Data Protection and Privacy compliance, protecting Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and Sensitive Personal Data or Information (SPDI).
* Oversee source code audits, and conduct internal security audits of codebase.

**3. Cloud Infrastructure & Product Security**

* Oversee security configuration across AWS environments, ensuring AES-256 encryption at rest (S3, RDS, ECR) and enforced TLS/HTTPS in transit.
* Enforce secure architecture models for single-tenant / dedicated client deployments on Financial Institution AWS infrastructure.
* Direct Web Application Firewall (WAF) policies, IP/URL whitelisting, geo-blocking, and network perimeter controls.
* Maintain DevSecOps rigor within CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), ensuring automated peer reviews, static analysis, code coverage thresholds, and container image vulnerability management.

**4. Threat Management & Security Operations (SecOps)**

* Lead the Incident Response Team; ensure end-to-end management, SLA tracking, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for all P1/Critical incidents.
* Oversee centralized logging, Database Activity Monitoring (DAM), and integration capabilities with Bank SIEM systems.
* Mandate periodic Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT) across applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
* Enforce robust Access Control & Identity Management (IAM), including mandatory multi-factor authentication (MFA) across email, code repositories, and cloud portals.

**5. Third-Party Risk & Business Continuity**

* Enforce Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) guidelines, ensuring mandatory MSAs and NDAs across all vendors.
* Manage annual Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) drills, validating Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
* Conduct annual enterprise-wide security awareness training programs and specialized DevSecOps workshops.

**Candidate Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related engineering fields.
* **Experience:** 12+ years in Information Security and Technology Risk, with at least 4+ years in a leadership role (CISO, Head of Security, or Director of InfoSec).
* **Domain Background:** Prior experience in Fintech, B2B SaaS, Banking, or Financial Services ecosystems is strictly required.

**Technical & Professional Competencies**

**Cloud Security**- Deep expertise in AWS Security Hub, WAF, KMS, CloudTrail, IAM, RDS/S3 encryption, and containerized deployments (ECS/ECR).

**Frameworks**- Hands-on mastery of ISO/IEC 27001:2022, NIST CSF, OWASP Top 10, and SOC 2 Type II compliance.

**Regulatory Knowledge**- In depth knowledge of RBI Cybersecurity Framework, RBI Digital Lending Directions, and Indian Data Protection laws.

**Application Security**- Expertise in DevSecOps, API security, automated code scanners, tesseract/OCR pipeline security, and LLM/AI model deployment governance.

**Leadership**- Exceptional stakeholder management, board-level reporting, and experience negotiating security requirements with Tier-1 Bank CISOs.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
* ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor / Lead Implementer

jobs.title: Customer Service Executive – Customer Support & Loan Servicing
jobs.description:
**Company:** Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited  
**Department:** Customer Service & Operations  
**Designation:** Customer Service Executive  
**Location:** Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, Office-based  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Reporting To:** Customer Service Manager / Head of Operations  
**Salary:** As per experience and suitability (Fixed + Performance Incentive)

1. About Loan2grow Fincap

Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited is a growing lending and financial services company focused on providing responsible, accessible and technology-enabled credit solutions to underserved customer segments.

The company offers financing solutions across multiple customer categories and is expanding its digital lending and financial services operations.

At Loan2grow, we believe that a good customer experience is central to responsible lending. We aim to make financial services accessible, transparent and convenient through technology-enabled platforms and responsive customer support.

2. About the Role

We are looking for customer-oriented and proactive professionals to join our Customer Service & Operations team as Customer Service Executives.

The selected candidates will be responsible for handling customer queries, providing assistance throughout the loan application and servicing journey, resolving customer complaints and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer issues.

The role will involve handling inbound and outbound customer calls, responding to service requests, guiding customers through digital processes and maintaining accurate records of customer interactions.

The Customer Service Executive will serve as an important point of contact between the company and its customers, ensuring that customer concerns are addressed professionally, efficiently and within defined timelines.

This is a full-time, office-based role involving regular telephone-based customer interaction and coordination with internal departments.

3. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Customer Support & Query Management

* Handle inbound and outbound customer calls relating to loan products and financial services.
* Respond to customer queries regarding loan features, eligibility, application procedures and documentation requirements.
* Provide information on loan application status, approval, disbursement and repayment schedules.
* Assist customers in understanding their loan accounts, outstanding balances, EMI obligations and payment timelines.
* Provide accurate information regarding applicable interest rates, processing fees, charges and other loan-related terms.
* Ensure that customer queries are addressed in a professional, courteous and timely manner.
* Escalate complex queries to the appropriate internal teams.

B. Loan Application & Customer Onboarding Support

* Assist prospective customers with the digital loan application process.
* Guide customers through KYC verification, documentation and other onboarding requirements.
* Help customers resolve issues related to application submission, document uploads and verification.
* Follow up on incomplete applications and pending documentation.
* Coordinate with Credit and Operations teams to track application progress.
* Keep customers informed about application status and pending requirements.
* Assist customers in navigating the company's digital platforms and applications.

C. Loan Servicing & Repayment Support

* Handle customer queries relating to loan disbursement, repayment schedules and EMI deductions.
* Assist customers with repayment-related issues, including failed transactions, incorrect deductions and payment confirmation.
* Guide customers on approved repayment channels and payment procedures.
* Coordinate with Finance and Collections teams to resolve payment reconciliation issues.
* Support customers in obtaining loan statements, repayment schedules and other account-related information.
* Track and follow up on unresolved loan servicing requests.
* Ensure that customer concerns relating to loan servicing are addressed within defined timelines.

D. Customer Complaint & Grievance Resolution

* Receive, register and track customer complaints and service requests.
* Understand the nature of customer grievances and identify the appropriate resolution mechanism.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to resolve complaints.
* Follow up on pending complaints until closure.
* Maintain accurate records of complaints, actions taken and resolution timelines.
* Escalate unresolved or sensitive customer grievances to the reporting manager.
* Ensure that customer complaints are handled in accordance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

E. Customer Relationship & Communication

* Maintain professional and positive relationships with customers.
* Communicate loan-related information in simple, clear and understandable language.
* Proactively contact customers regarding pending documentation, application updates and service requests.
* Provide appropriate guidance to customers throughout their loan journey.
* Handle dissatisfied customers and difficult conversations with patience and professionalism.
* Ensure transparency in all customer communications.
* Never make unauthorised commitments regarding loan approvals, interest waivers, settlements or changes in repayment terms.

F. Coordination with Internal Teams

* Coordinate with Sales and Business Development teams for customer acquisition and onboarding-related queries.
* Work with Credit teams to obtain updates on loan applications and pending verifications.
* Coordinate with Operations for documentation, disbursement and loan servicing issues.
* Work with Collections teams on repayment-related customer queries and payment confirmation.
* Coordinate with Finance for payment reconciliation and account-related discrepancies.
* Ensure timely communication and closure of customer requests across departments.

G. Customer Service MIS & Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of customer calls, queries, complaints and service requests.
* Update customer interactions and service request status in the CRM or designated systems.
* Maintain daily customer service reports covering:
* Total inbound and outbound calls.
* Customer queries received.
* Customer requests registered.
* Complaints received and resolved.
* Pending service requests.
* Average query resolution time.
* Escalated complaints.
* Customer follow-up status.
* Share daily and weekly performance updates with the reporting manager.
* Identify recurring customer issues and highlight opportunities to improve service delivery.

4. Qualifications & Experience

**Essential Qualifications:**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* 1–3 years of experience in customer service, customer support, telecalling, contact centres or customer relationship management.
* Good verbal communication skills in Hindi and basic English.
* Comfortable handling inbound and outbound customer calls.
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets and customer management systems.
* Ability to handle multiple customer queries and service requests simultaneously.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Prior experience in banking, NBFCs, fintech, digital lending, microfinance or other financial services organisations.
* Experience handling loan-related customer queries and servicing requests.
* Familiarity with loan application processes, KYC documentation and digital onboarding.
* Experience resolving EMI, repayment and payment-related queries.
* Experience working with CRM, LOS or LMS platforms.
* Exposure to complaint management and customer grievance resolution.

5. Key Skills & Competencies

* Excellent verbal communication and listening skills.
* Customer relationship management.
* Problem-solving and query resolution.
* Professional telephone etiquette.
* Patience and empathy in customer interactions.
* Ability to handle difficult customer conversations.
* Follow-up and service

jobs.description:
**About the Company:**

DigieSign is a Bengaluru-based legal-tech and fintech company building a connected suite of products that help lenders digitise the full lifecycle of a loan — from signing the agreement to recovering dues and resolving disputes. Our customers are NBFCs, banks and financial institutions across India.

Our product suite:

* DigieSign – Aadhaar and DSC-based eSignatures and digital document execution for loan agreements, sanction letters and other lending documents.
* Serve – End-to-end legal notice dispatch: multilingual notice generation, digital delivery (email, SMS, WhatsApp) and physical dispatch via India Post, with tracking and court-ready delivery reports.
* Collect – Collections automation that helps lenders reach delinquent borrowers at scale and improve recovery rates.
* Resolve – Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) for faster, cheaper resolution of lending disputes through arbitration, conciliation and mediation. We already work with leading NBFCs, and we are now building city-level teams to grow faster. Bengaluru is our home city and the first of these hubs.

**Role Overview**

As City Manager – Sales & Operations, Bengaluru, you will own our business in the city end to end. You will bring in new NBFC and bank customers, and you will make sure that every customer we sign is onboarded smoothly, served well and keeps growing with us. You will run the city like a business unit: pipeline, revenue, delivery quality and client satisfaction are all yours.

This role suits someone who enjoys being in front of credit, legal and collections leaders at lending institutions, and who also likes making operations run cleanly behind the scenes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Sales & Business Development (approx. 60%)**

•Find, prospect and acquire new NBFCs, banks (private, small finance, cooperative), HFCs and MFIs headquartered or with major operations in Bengaluru and Karnataka.

•Build and manage a healthy pipeline: research target accounts, map decision-makers (Heads of Collections, Legal, Credit Operations, Risk, IT/Digital) and run multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

* Run product demos and discovery meetings, and position the full suite: DigieSign, Serve, Collect and Resolve.

* Build proposals, commercial quotes and pricing in line with company guidelines; negotiate and close agreements.

* Handle procurement processes, vendor empanelment, RFPs, information security questionnaires and legal/compliance reviews at client institutions.

* Cross-sell and upsell across the suite to existing accounts (for example, moving a Serve customer onto Collect or Resolve).

* Meet monthly and quarterly targets for new logos, revenue and pipeline.

* Keep the CRM up to date and share accurate forecasts with leadership.

* Represent DigieSign at BFSI industry events, NBFC forums and legal-tech meetups in the city.

**B. City Operations & Client Delivery (approx. 40%)**

* Own client onboarding for the city: account setup, user training, template configuration, data upload formats and go-live.

* Oversee day-to-day delivery for Bengaluru clients, including legal notice dispatch batches, India Post coordination, eSign volumes and ODR case flows, so that SLAs and turnaround times are met.

* Coordinate with internal product, tech, legal and support teams to resolve client issues and escalations quickly.

* Make sure clients receive timely MIS and delivery reports, and review account health with them regularly (monthly reviews and QBRs).

* Track usage, wallet/billing status and collections on invoices for city accounts, and follow up on receivables.

* Manage local vendors and partners (printing, dispatch, courier and field partners) where needed.

* Capture client feedback and feature requests and pass them to the product team in a structured way.

* As the city grows, hire, train and lead a small team of sales and operations executives.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* New NBFC and bank customers signed per quarter

* Revenue and pipeline value against target

* Time from signature to go-live for new clients

* SLA adherence for notice dispatch, eSign and ODR delivery

* Client retention, expansion revenue and cross-sell across products

* Receivables collected on time

**Requirements Must have**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA preferred.

* 3–6 years of experience in B2B / enterprise sales, account management or operations in BFSI, fintech, legal-tech or SaaS.

* A proven record of selling to NBFCs and/or banks, with an existing network among collections, legal, credit or operations leaders.

* Understanding of the lending lifecycle in India — loan origination, documentation, collections, NPA recovery and legal/recovery processes (SARFAESI, Section 138 NI Act, arbitration).

* Comfort managing operational processes, SLAs and client escalations.

* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills in English; Kannada and/or Hindi strongly preferred.

* Comfortable with CRM tools, Excel/Google Sheets and preparing MIS reports.

* Willing to travel within Bengaluru and Karnataka for client meetings. Good to have

* Experience selling eSign, eStamp, legal notice, collections or ODR solutions.

* Exposure to RBI digital lending guidelines and outsourcing norms for regulated entities.

* Experience setting up or scaling a city or regional business from an early stage.

* Experience hiring and leading a small team.

**What We Offer**

* A chance to build and own a city business at an early-stage, fast-growing legal-tech company.

* Direct work with the founding team and real influence on product and go-to-market.

* Competitive fixed pay plus a performance-linked incentive plan.

* A clear growth path to Regional / Zonal Head as we expand to more cities.

Pay: ₹70,000.00 - ₹110,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**Organization:**
At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Executive Manager – Technology Modernisation
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Business & Team:**
ASB is one of New Zealand’s leading banks and a wholly owned subsidiary of the Commonwealth Bank of Australia. This role sits within CBA India and is dedicated to ASB — you will build and lead ASB’s India-based engineering capability, working shoulder to shoulder with ASB Technology leaders in NZ. ASB is mid-flight in a generational modernisation of its technology, data and digital estate. The agenda is set and owned by ASB’s leadership in New Zealand; India’s job is to bring the engineering depth that accelerates it. The portfolio spans migrating the core to SAP TRBK and simplifying the legacy HOST estate, modernising cards across issuing and acquiring, the full payments technology agenda, scaling Pega across decisioning, workflow, lending and financial crime, modernising the data estate onto a cloud data platform, and re-platforming integration.
  
  
Underpinning all of it are CBA Group engineering foundations — cloud-first architecture, Golden Pathways and DevSecOps, automation-first testing, and AI-powered engineering at scale. This is not a support function. It is real engineering accountability, delivered from India.
  
  
You will lead ASB’s India-based engineering capability — engineers, platform and architecture specialists, testing, data and delivery talent — organised into squads that sit inside ASB’s tribes and into chapters that hold the engineering craft. The teams operate as a genuine extension of ASB, not a resource pool: named outcomes, shared tribe governance and cadence, common engineering standards, and direct partnership with ASB tribe leads, product owners, architecture, risk and operations across both geographies.
  
  
**Impact & Contribution:**
As Executive Manager – Technology Modernisation, you lead the India engineering capability that delivers across ASB’s modernisation portfolio — SAP TRBK core migration and legacy simplification, Cards Modernisation, the payments technology agenda, and the Pega estate — together with the cloud, integration, data and quality engineering that make them land. You will work in genuine partnership with the ASB New Zealand leaders who own the modernisation agenda, translating their roadmaps into executable engineering plans, mobilising squads inside ASB tribes, setting and holding the engineering bar, and carrying delivery, operational and regulatory risk for what India commits to.
  
  
Success is a world-class engineering capability across these domains — one that measurably accelerates ASB’s modernisation journey, delivers to committed timelines, holds the compliance and regulatory bar without exception, takes risk out of complex migrations, and does it at materially better cost. Alongside the immediate commitments, you will build the longer-term edge: automation-first quality engineering, AI-powered engineering, and the engineering depth that lets ASB retire legacy with confidence.

* Build outcome-led engineering squads and chapters integrated with ASB tribes, with clear accountability across software, platform, cloud, data and quality engineering.
* Set and uphold engineering excellence, embedding cloud-first architecture, API-led and event-driven integration, Golden Pathways, DevSecOps, CI/CD automation, security controls and measurable engineering standards.
* Make automation and quality engineering a core strength, establishing reusable test frameworks and large-scale migration testing to reduce manual regression, accelerate delivery and protect customer outcomes.
* Drive major modernisation programmes, including SAP TRBK core migration, legacy HOST transformation, Cards Modernisation and enterprise Pega, while managing complex migration, cutover and cross-platform dependencies.
* Build a resilient, always-on payments capability spanning domestic and cross-border payments, real-time processing, switching, settlement, reconciliation, observability and incident readiness.
* Lead AI-powered engineering adoption, using generative and agentic AI for software development, testing, legacy comprehension, migration, knowledge discovery and operational support, with strong governance, responsible-use guardrails and measurable benefits.
* Own the India engineering operating model, including resilience, security, regulatory readiness, cost, risk, talent and capability building, while creating a high-performance culture and strong partnership across India and New Zealand.

**Essential Skills:**

* 15–18+ years of hands-on technology and engineering experience, built on a genuine engineering foundation rather than a purely programme or delivery-management career path. Credible working knowledge across at least two of these domains is required: depth in one is the gate, breadth is what makes this role work.
* Automation-first quality engineering: Proven experience building automated testing at scale across major migrations, including reusable frameworks, integration, performance, resilience and production validation, replacing manual regression with pipeline-driven automation.
* Core banking & legacy modernisation: Deep experience modernising complex banking platforms, including SAP HANA/core banking, large-scale data migration, reconciliation, dual-run, cutover, legacy decommissioning and AI-enabled legacy code discovery.
* Cards, payments & Pega expertise: Strong engineering depth across cards issuing/acquiring, payment rails and switching, settlement and reconciliation, alongside enterprise Pega platforms, workflow, decisioning and platform governance.
* Modern architecture & platform engineering: Strong command of cloud-native, domain-driven and event-driven architectures, microservices, APIs, distributed systems, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and scalable platform engineering.
* DevSecOps, reliability & security: Advanced CI/CD, Golden Pathways, automated security controls, observability, SLOs, resilience, disaster recovery, threat modelling, vulnerability management and audit-ready technology controls.
* AI-powered engineering: Hands-on experience embedding agentic and generative AI across coding, code review, testing, legacy comprehension, migration and operations, with measurable outcomes, robust evaluation and responsible AI guardrails.
* Engineering leadership & capability building: Proven leadership of engineering leaders and multidisciplinary teams across squads, tribes and partners, with experience building senior engineering capability, insourcing critical skills and developing succession.

* Deposit forecast governance: Lead the deposit forecast and challenger process with Treasury Finance, GLS and LOB CFOs – framing assumptions, sensitivities, beta/pricing expectations and decision asks.
* NII & balance sheet narrative: Own the NII and balance sheet story for senior management, explaining drivers of variance versus plan, forecast and prior periods (rate, volume and mix) along with forward-looking risks and opportunities.

* Stakeholder partnership: Serve as trusted advisor and senior point of contact for Corporate Treasury, CIO, Treasury Finance, LOB CFOs, GLS, Interest Rate Risk, International Treasury, Controllers and Technology; represent India in senior forums and build durable partnerships through clear service models, SLAs and governance cadences.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:
  
  

* Education: Master’s degree in a financial discipline such as accounting, finance, economics or statistics, or local country equivalent, is required; MBA preferred. Professional qualifications such as CA, CFA, FRM or CPA are a strong advantage.
* Experience: 15+ years of progressive experience in finance, FP&A, treasury finance or balance sheet management within banking or financial services.
* Domain expertise: Strong knowledge of Asset and Liability Management (ALM), deposits, NII, FTP, liquidity (LCR/LST), interest rate risk and the bank balance sheet, with a sound understanding of financial controls and governance.
* Global operating model: Proven track record of building and scaling India-based Centers of Excellence that partner with US/EMEA senior leadership; ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate complex technical-financial topics into clear business narratives.
* Communication & tools: Excellent written, verbal and executive presentation skills; advanced MS Office; proficiency with enterprise planning, reporting and ERP tools (e.g., Planning Analytics/TM1, Cognos, HFM, Oracle) and Power BI – exposure to Python/SQL, automation and AI tools is a plus.
* People leadership: 7+ years leading multi-layered teams (VPs, AVPs, Specialists and Analysts), with demonstrated strength in organization design, workforce and succession planning, coaching and performance management, and in building an inclusive, high-performance culture.

**Engineering Leadership & Strategy**

**Delivery & Transformation**

* Drive predictable execution of the Revenue Accounting engineering roadmap, aligning engineering capacity to the highest-value business, regulatory and strategic outcomes.

* Build a strong succession pipeline across Director, VP, technical leadership and senior engineering roles.
* Strengthen institutional knowledge and reduce key-person or third-party dependencies through targeted insourcing, mobility, cross-training and capability development.

**Innovation & AI**

* Champion the responsible adoption of AI-enabled software engineering, intelligent automation and modern developer tooling across the engineering lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, test automation, software quality and speed to market through AI and automation.
* Create an environment that encourages experimentation while ensuring innovation is governed appropriately for a regulated technology environment.

**Partnership & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Act as a senior member of the global Revenue Accounting technology leadership team, ensuring India is fully integrated into global strategy and decision-making.
* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Finance, Product, Architecture, Operations, Risk, Controls and Technology.
* Influence enterprise technology and engineering decisions beyond the immediate Revenue Accounting organization.
* Represent Revenue Accounting within the broader India technology leadership community and strengthen India's position as a strategic engineering hub.

****Desirable Skills****
The following would be advantageous:
  
  
  

* Experience within financial accounting technology, including subledger, general ledger, financial control or regulatory reporting platforms.
* Understanding of front-to-back accounting flows, including transaction capture, accounting event generation, subledger processing, reconciliation, financial controls and general-ledger integration.
* Experience delivering large-scale Finance or enterprise transformation within a global financial institution.
* Experience with large-scale platform or cloud modernization.
* Knowledge of modern technologies and patterns including Java, APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, AWS/cloud technologies, DevSecOps and modern data platforms.
* Experience implementing AI-assisted software engineering, developer productivity tooling or intelligent test automation at enterprise scale.
* Experience developing product-oriented and Agile engineering organizations.
* Experience implementing insourcing strategies and transferring critical technology or domain capability from third-party providers into permanent engineering teams.
* Experience leading globally distributed engineering organizations, particularly across India, the UK and US.
* Understanding of technology economics and experience optimizing engineering investment, infrastructure costs and third-party expenditure.

****Accountabilities****
The Head of Engineering will have clear accountability across the following areas:
  
  
**Technology & Architecture**

* Technical health and strategic evolution of the Revenue Accounting technology estate within the role's remit.
* Alignment to enterprise architecture, engineering and technology standards.
* Reduction of legacy complexity and technical debt.

**Engineering & Delivery**

**Service, Resilience & Controls**

* Compliance with applicable technology, cyber, data, resilience and regulatory requirements.
* Timely identification, escalation and remediation of material technology risks and control weaknesses.

**People & Organization**

* Attraction, retention, development and succession of engineering talent.
* Development of strong engineering and technology leadership capability.
