jobs.title: Senior Financial Controller
jobs.description:
**Senior Financial Controller**  
Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Department: Finance | Reports to: CEO / CFO

**About the Company**

Our client is one of India's fastest-growing workspace and business infrastructure companies, offering Managed Offices, Coworking Spaces, Enterprise Workspace Solutions, Build-to-Suit Offices, Design & Build Services, and Business Infrastructure Solutions.

Founded with the vision of transforming how businesses experience workspaces, the company partners with startups, SMEs, large enterprises, GCCs, and multinational corporations by providing scalable, technology-enabled workplace solutions across India.

Today, it operates across multiple cities with a rapidly expanding footprint and manages millions of square feet of commercial real estate through long-term strategic partnerships. As it scales nationally through organic growth, strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and new business ventures, the company is looking for a strong, hands-on finance leader to own the controllership backbone of the organization while partnering closely with the CFO on strategic finance initiatives.

**Business Ecosystem**

The Senior Financial Controller will drive financial control and reporting discipline across the group's ecosystem, which includes multiple business verticals and associated entities involved in workspace development, operations, technology, and business services. The role operates in a multi-entity, high-growth environment and requires strong governance, process ownership, and financial discipline across:

* Managed Office Solutions
* Coworking Spaces
* Enterprise Workspace Solutions
* Commercial Real Estate
* Design & Build
* Infrastructure Development
* Facility & Workplace Operations
* Technology-enabled Workplace Solutions
* Business Support Services

**Role Purpose**

The Senior Financial Controller will own end-to-end Finance & Accounts, Compliance, Taxation, and MIS Reporting across the organization, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and control at every stage of the financial close and reporting cycle. As a senior member of the Finance leadership team, the role will work closely with the CFO and business heads to translate financial strategy into disciplined execution, and will step in on select strategic finance, treasury, and fundraising-support responsibilities that a growing multi-entity business demands.

This is a controllership-first role with meaningful exposure to strategic finance, ideal for a finance leader who wants to build and run the core finance engine of a fast-scaling company while growing into broader CFO-level responsibilities over time.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Finance & Accounting Operations (Core Ownership)**

* Own end-to-end Finance & Accounts, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Recognition, Fixed Assets, and Payroll Accounting.
* Lead timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing across all entities.
* Prepare and review Consolidated Financial Statements for the group.
* Own MIS Reporting and ensure accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of management reports.
* Build and maintain scalable accounting processes and standard operating procedures across a multi-entity structure.

**Taxation & Regulatory Compliance (Core Ownership)**

* Ensure full compliance across GST, Income Tax, TDS, and Companies Act requirements.
* Oversee Secretarial Compliance and ROC filings in coordination with company secretarial support.
* Lead Statutory Audits and Internal Audits, and act as the primary point of contact for auditors.
* Strengthen Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and overall financial governance.

**Treasury & Working Capital**

* Manage day-to-day cash flow planning and working capital optimization.
* Maintain and strengthen banking relationships across the group.
* Support debt servicing, liquidity management, and treasury operations.

**FP&A and Business Finance**

* Support the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), budgeting, forecasting, and rolling forecasts.
* Track financial KPIs and business intelligence reporting for leadership review.
* Partner with business leaders to evaluate profitability, support pricing decisions, and improve operational efficiency.
* Recommend and drive cost optimization initiatives across business units.

**Strategic Finance Support (Partnering with CFO)**

* Support financial due diligence for M&A, investments, and joint ventures as needed.
* Assist in preparing financial models, investor presentations, and materials for lender / PE / VC interactions.
* Contribute financial insights to Board-level and leadership reporting.
* Support post-merger financial integration for acquired businesses.

**Risk Management & Governance**

* Strengthen internal controls and enterprise risk management practices.
* Ensure compliance with corporate policies across all entities.
* Identify and mitigate financial and compliance risks proactively.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor the accounting, taxation, and compliance teams.
* Build a high-performing, process-driven finance function capable of supporting rapid national growth.
* Act as a key escalation point for finance operations, deputizing for the CFO on controllership matters when required.

**Requirements**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) or MBA Finance is mandatory.
* Minimum 10+ years of progressive experience in Finance & Accounts, with strong hands-on controllership exposure.
* Proven experience owning the complete accounting close, MIS, and compliance function.
* Strong exposure to Accounting, Taxation, Compliance, Audit, and Financial Governance; working exposure to FP&A and Treasury preferred.
* Experience managing finance teams in a multi-location / multi-entity organization.
* Exposure to fundraising, due diligence, or investor reporting is an added advantage but not mandatory.
* Strong process orientation with the ability to build scalable financial systems and controls.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Pay: Up to ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

We aim to be where the growth is—enabling businesses to thrive, economies to prosper and people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We’re seeking an experienced professional to join our Securities Services team as **NFR Senior Manager.**

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Report to the FMI NFR Head, the Senior Manager will act as a key partner in shaping and delivering the FMI non-financial risk agenda. The role holder will recommend priorities, take ownership of agreed deliverables and lead implementation across in-scope FMI activities and NTTPs, ensuring alignment with Group mandatory procedures, the Risk Management Framework (RMF) and Third-Party Risk Policy requirements.
* This newly created position will lead the design, implementation and ongoing enhancement of the FMI NTTP risk management operating model. The Senior Manager will translate policy requirements into effective governance, controls and management information (MI), challenge existing practices and drive consistent adoption. Success will be measured through demonstrable improvements in risk management and sustainable control outcomes, rather than completion of activities alone.
* Working across Network Management and Market Intelligence (N2MI), Trading Facilities and CCP Management (TFCM), CSD Management and PS Management, the role holder will influence senior stakeholders and lead resolution of complex risk and control matters. The role will operate autonomously within an agreed mandate, escalating material exposures, unresolved disagreements and decisions requiring the FMI NFR Head’s authority. The FMI NFR Head retains overall functional accountability, while business and control owners retain responsibility for their risks, controls and remediation.
* Partner with the FMI NFR Head to establish a prioritised programme of activity that strengthens the control environment for in-scope FMI NTTPs. Lead delivery of agreed outcomes, ensuring risk management practices are consistent, evidence-based and aligned with Third-Party Risk Policy requirements, FMI-specific expectations and applicable risk appetite.
* Lead the development of clear, forward-looking risk insight and recommendations to inform governance and senior decision-making. Challenge control weaknesses, emerging exposures and the adequacy of proposed responses, holding accountable owners to agreed remediation outcomes and escalating material concerns or delivery risks.
* Drive change across FMI by leading implementation of CIB-led Third-Party Risk Management initiatives and improvements to mandatory procedures, operating instructions, reporting and tooling. Assess market infrastructure and regulatory developments, recommend proportionate responses and secure stakeholder commitment to changes that are practical, consistently embedded and sustainable.
* Partner with the FMI NFR Head to shape priorities and lead implementation and enhancement of mandatory FMI procedures and associated controls across in-scope NTTPs. Lead annual reviews and updates across N2MI and TFCM, challenge gaps and drive consistent application as business and regulatory requirements evolve.
* Lead oversight of FMI third-party controls and monitoring, critically assess results and challenge the adequacy of control design, operation and supporting evidence against Third-Party Risk Policy requirements and FMI-specific expectations. Drive resolution of weaknesses with accountable owners and maintain audit-ready documentation standards.
* Lead development and quality assurance of monthly governance packs and MI for the FMI Business Control Committee and N2MI Governance Committee. Translate complex matters into clear risk assessments, recommendations and decisions required; present and defend key messages, challenge senior stakeholders and escalate material concerns through the appropriate governance channels.
* Lead end-to-end oversight of NFR actions, issues and remediation, including Management Self-Identified Issues (MSIIs) and Audit Identified Issues (AIIs). Challenge root-cause analysis, action plans, milestones and closure evidence; hold accountable owners to agreed outcomes and escalate delays, unresolved exposures or remediation that does not deliver sustainable risk reduction.
* Lead FMI’s coordination of internal and external audits and assurance reviews. Establish coherent responses across the FMI team, challenge evidence quality and consistency, identify cross-cutting themes and drive delivery of agreed remediation with accountable owners, escalating significant matters to the FMI NFR Head.
* Lead FMI’s implementation and embedding of CIB-led Third-Party Risk Management initiatives. Assess business impacts, establish clear delivery plans and accountabilities, influence stakeholders across business, operations and Risk and Control functions, and resolve implementation challenges to secure effective adoption.
* Drive continuous improvement and simplification of FMI NFR processes, reporting and tooling. Challenge inefficient practices, prioritise changes that strengthen control effectiveness, data quality and management insight, and lead delivery from design through implementation and embedding within an agreed mandate.
* Lead analysis and preparation of responses to regulatory requests and senior management queries. Proactively assess emerging market infrastructure and regulatory developments, determine implications for FMI NTTP operational performance and the control environment, and recommend prioritised, proportionate responses to the FMI NFR Head and relevant stakeholders.
  

**To be successful you will:**

* Substantial experience in non-financial risk, operational risk, third-party risk or governance and controls within financial services or a similarly regulated environment, with a demonstrated record of leading complex risk and control initiatives.
* A self-starting, solution-oriented approach, independently setting priorities aligned with the FMI NFR agenda and driving delivery without close supervision. Takes proactive initiative and end-to-end ownership, remaining accountable for outcomes and exercising sound judgement on when to engage or escalate.
* Strong practical expertise in risk and control frameworks, including the ability to challenge risk assessments, control design and effectiveness, root-cause analysis, remediation plans and closure evidence, and maintain audit-quality documentation.
* Strong analytical capability and sound judgement to interpret complex information, identify emerging risks and cross-cutting themes, and recommend priorities based on materiality.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with senior leaders, influence and constructively challenge stakeholders, resolve competing priorities and secure delivery across business, operations and Risk and Control functions without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Strong executive communication skills, including producing concise MI, dashboards and governance papers, presenting complex matters clearly, making evidence-based recommendations and articulating the decisions and actions required from senior stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional change from design through implementation and embedding, establish clear accountability and manage multiple priorities with disciplined delivery and attention to detail. Evidence of sustainable improvements in risk management or control effectiveness, supported by proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
* Knowledge of FM

jobs.title: Senior Director, Enterprise Technology Build & Operations
jobs.description:
Portage Point is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States and an office in Gurugram.

The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transaction, transitions and transformations.

Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm's platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.

The Technology function serves as the strategic and operational core of the firm's AI platform – building the enterprise-grade infrastructure, AI product platform and data foundation that power Portage Point's AI-enabled advisory model. The team architects and operates the multi-tenant Portage Point Platform, the Enterprise Data Vault and a portfolio of 15 AI products spanning all practice lines. Working directly with US leadership and practice line leaders, the team translates the firm's ambition – a digital AI version of every advisory capability – into a governed, scalable and commercially deployable technology platform.

The Senior Director, Enterprise Technology Build & Operations will report directly into the CTO, and holds unified accountability for Portage Point corporate technology environment and security posture. As firm scales, there is a need for robust IT operations, security and infrastructure planning and management. This role ensures the firm's IT foundation is reliable, secure and audit-ready, integrating network and endpoint operations, Microsoft 365 governance, ITSM delivery, Zero Trust security architecture, SOC 2 Type II compliance and AI-specific security controls under a single point of ownership. The role approves IT operations and service management designs, security architecture decisions, vendor engagements and infrastructure implementation decisions within CTO-approved standards.

### **Responsibilities**

* Design and operate enterprise network infrastructure (for e.g. Cisco Meraki, SD-WAN, dual-ISP failover, next-gen firewall) and Microsoft 365 environment (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Microsoft Purview) — covering tenant governance, licensing optimisation, DLP, retention and compliance features; manage the endpoint platform (Intune / Autopilot) including device enrolment, configuration, patch management and Conditional Access compliance enforcement
* Partner with the Head of Innovation and Product Manager on the platform roadmap, product intake from practice lines and release readiness
* Own the ITSM framework (ServiceNow or Jira Service Management) across incident, change, problem, service request and asset management; operate the IT service desk with P1–P4 SLA tiers, CSAT measurement and self-service knowledge base; personally own IT onboarding (Day 1 device, accounts and access) and offboarding (account revocation and access audit) within defined SLAs
* Design and enforce end-to-end security architecture with Zero Trust Network Access, micro-segmentation, Azure AD / Entra ID PIM, Conditional Access, application-layer security (OWASP Top 10 controls for all AI products), encryption, key management (Azure Key Vault) and AI-specific controls covering prompt injection defences, model access controls and audit trails for all LLM interactions
* Own the SOC 2 Type II programme – map platform and corporate IT controls to AICPA Trust Services Criteria, manage gap remediation, coordinate the external audit and produce the SOC 2 report for client and PE sponsor review; maintain TPI's information security policy suite; ensure compliance (personal data mapping, legal basis documentation, breach notification); manage the third-party and vendor risk assessment programme
* Design and operate the vulnerability management programme (Tenable.io or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management) with automated scanning and enforced remediation SLAs; deploy and operate SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel) for identity, data exfiltration and AI-specific threat detection; own the Incident Response Plan and personally lead all P1 and P2 security incidents
* Lead and develop the combined IT and security team of engineers and analysts; own IT procurement (TCO analysis, with CTO) and the full vendor portfolio; design and test IT BCP and DR procedures; produce monthly ITSM performance review and quarterly security dashboard for the CTO and COO
* Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts
* Lead technical trainings on architecture, data engineering and AI infrastructure
* Contribute to a high-performing and inclusive engineering culture

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree from a top undergraduate program required
* 15 plus years in IT leadership with demonstrated ownership of both corporate IT operations (infrastructure, service management) and cybersecurity (architecture, compliance)
* Experience as the senior IT and security lead in a professional services, advisory or GCC environment; Big Four or comparable advisory GCC experience a strong differentiator
* Located in or willing to relocate to Gurugram, India
* ITIL 4 Managing Professional (or above) and CISSP, CISM or equivalent cybersecurity certification required; must have designed and operated a live ITSM framework and personally owned a SOC 2 Type II programme
* Production experience with the Microsoft security stack at scale (500+ users): Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, Intune, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Purview; enterprise network infrastructure (Cisco Meraki, SD-WAN, NGFW); ZTNA implementation experiences a differentiator
* ServiceNow or Jira Service Management administration — must have built incident, change and asset management workflows from scratch; hands-on PAM (HashiCorp Vault or CyberArk) and secrets management programme ownership; vulnerability scanning and CI / CD security integration (SAST / DAST) experience
* Prior exposure to private equity, M&A, or restructuring transaction environments preferred; ability to collaborate across US and India time zones and willingness to flex working hours for cross-border stakeholder engagement
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high-pressure, client-facing environments

JOB DESCRIPTION Zoho Books Accountant K. Subraya Anantha Kamath & Sons Kasaragod, Kerala Position: Zoho Books Accountant Department: Accounts & Finance Location: Kasaragod, Kerala Employment Type: Full-time Reporting To: Management / Accounts Head 1. About the Company K. Subraya Anantha Kamath & Sons is an established cashew processing and trading company with a legacy dating back to 1945. The company is engaged in cashew kernel processing, domestic and international trading, procurement of raw cashew nuts and sale of cashew by-products. We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible accountant with practical experience in Zoho Books and GST compliance to manage our accounting operations. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Zoho Books Management - Maintain complete and accurate accounting records in Zoho Books. - Record daily sales, purchases, receipts, payments and journal entries. - Maintain customer and supplier ledgers. - Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable. - Ensure timely and accurate accounting entries. - Maintain proper documentation of all financial transactions. B. GST & Statutory Compliance - Prepare and verify GST sales and purchase data. - Coordinate preparation and filing of GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B. - Reconcile GSTR-2B with purchase records. - Verify GST input tax credit eligibility. - Coordinate with external auditors and tax consultants. - Maintain TDS records and assist with statutory compliance. C. Banking & Financial Transactions - Perform bank reconciliations regularly. - Monitor customer collections and supplier payments. - Maintain cash and bank books. - Prepare payment schedules. - Track outstanding receivables and payables. D. Inventory & Stock Accounting - Maintain inventory records in Zoho. - Monitor raw cashew nut purchases and stock. - Track cashew kernel grades and quantities. - Maintain stock records of finished goods, packing materials and by-products. - Reconcile physical stock with accounting records. - Coordinate with factory and stores personnel for stock verification. E. Sales & Purchase Accounting - Verify purchase invoices, sales invoices and debit/credit notes. - Ensure correct GST rates, HSN codes and tax classifications. - Track customer outstanding balances. - Monitor supplier balances and payment due dates. - Maintain proper records of domestic and export transactions. F. MIS & Management Reporting Prepare periodic reports for management, including: - Daily sales and purchase reports. - Customer outstanding and ageing reports. - Supplier outstanding reports. - Stock and inventory reports. - Monthly Profit & Loss statement. - Cash flow and fund position. - Expense analysis. - Product-wise and business-wise profitability reports, wherever data is available. 3. Required Qualifications & Experience - B.Com / M.Com or equivalent qualification. - 2–5 years of accounting experience. - Hands-on experience in Zoho Books is essential. - Good knowledge of GST and Indian accounting practices. - Experience with inventory accounting. - Knowledge of Excel and spreadsheets. - Experience in manufacturing, processing or trading businesses will be an advantage. 4. Skills & Competencies - Strong accounting fundamentals. - High accuracy and attention to detail. - Good analytical and reconciliation skills. - Ability to independently manage daily accounting operations. - Good communication and coordination skills. - Integrity, confidentiality and accountability. - Ability to meet deadlines. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The performance of the accountant will be evaluated on: 1. Accuracy and completeness of accounting entries. 2. Timely completion of bank reconciliations. 3. Timely GST preparation and compliance. 4. Accuracy of customer and supplier balances. 5. Timely submission of monthly MIS reports. 6. Accuracy of inventory and stock reconciliation. 7. Timely identification and reporting of accounting discrepancies. 6. What We Expect We expect the accountant to take ownership of the company's accounting system, ensure that all transactions are properly recorded and reconciled, and provide reliable financial information to management for decision-making. The objective is to maintain a transparent, accurate and well-organised accounting system through Zoho Books.

Pay: ₹8,500.00 - ₹42,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Manager, BG&C
jobs.description:
**Senior Manager, BG&C**
========================

Req ID: 124671

Department: GO - GCC Bengaluru

Division: Group Operations

Location: Bengaluru

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Senior Manager, Business Governance & Controls (BG&C), leads the first-line operational risk and control agenda for the Bengaluru GCC. The role establishes a consistent and effective risk and control environment aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite and enterprise risk framework, while ensuring business and functional leaders retain clear ownership of their risks and controls.

  

As the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, the role provides independent-minded advice and constructive challenge, strengthens risk culture and operational resilience, and enables well-informed business decisions. The role also leads the continuous improvement of control testing, assurance insights and governance reporting across the GCC.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type: Full Time, Permanent**  
**Role Location: Bengaluru**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As a Senior Manager, BG&C, you will:

  

* Develop and execute the GCC first-line risk and control strategy, aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite, enterprise risk framework and relevant regulatory obligations.
* Establish and maintain a consistent GCC-wide approach to identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring and reporting operational and compliance risks, with clear business ownership of risks and controls.
* Act as the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, providing timely advice, evidence-based insights and constructive challenge to support informed decision-making.
* Lead GCC-wide risk assessments across operational, technology, cyber, data, third-party, people, conduct, regulatory and change risks, ensuring material exposures and emerging themes are identified and addressed.
* Oversee the GCC operational resilience agenda, including first-line oversight of critical operations, material service providers, intra group arrangements, business continuity and key dependency or concentration risks.
* Coordinate GCC implementation of relevant enterprise and regulatory risk requirements, including PACT, NFR framework changes and CPS 230-related obligations, in partnership with Group Risk and specialist teams.
* Lead the design, uplift and consistent application of control testing methodologies, quality benchmarks, documentation standards and review practices across GCC teams and portfolios.
* Champion data-led and automated testing approaches where appropriate, ensuring enhancements are well governed, scalable and improve the quality and efficiency of assurance outcomes.
* Synthesise risk assessments and control testing outcomes into clear, prioritised insights for the GCC Leadership Team and relevant governance forums, including transparent escalation of material weaknesses, systemic issues and non-compliance risks.

* Oversee the quality and progress of remediation, challenging whether actions address root causes and provide sufficient evidence of sustainable closure, while retaining accountability with the relevant business owner.
* Lead first-line coordination of internal, external and in-country audits for the GCC, ensuring effective business engagement, timely responses and disciplined tracking of agreed actions.
* Build a strong risk and compliance culture by coaching leaders, strengthening accountability and promoting open, transparent engagement across businesses, functions, second line, Audit and other key stakeholders.
* Lead and develop the BG&C team, ensuring effective resourcing, clear priorities and the skills and capability required to meet current and future GCC needs.
* Drive continuous improvement of the GCC risk and control environment, supporting business, process, systems and automation changes while ensuring associated risks are understood and appropriately managed.

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

**‘Must have’ knowledge, skills and experiences**

  

* Strong degree of know-how and ability to drive strategic initiatives
* Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks, including control taxonomies and enterprise risk standards.
* Knowledge of regulatory obligations relevant to conduct, compliance, and operational risk.
* Awareness of business processes, control design principles, and first‑line risk responsibilities.
* Analytical capability to interpret data, identify patterns, and translate findings into actionable insights.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey risk messages clearly and influence stakeholders.
* Ability to assess control adequacy and effectiveness, including root‑cause analysis and evidence evaluation.
* Stakeholder engagement and relationship‑building skills, with confidence to challenge constructively.
* Planning and prioritisation skills to manage testing cycles, competing workloads, and quality standards.
* Experience delivering control testing, quality assurance, or risk assessment activities in a regulated environment.
* Demonstrated involvement in analysing business processes and identifying control gaps or compliance issues.
* Strong understanding of risk management and operational risk
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to lead discussions and partner effectively with stakeholders across geographies
* Knowledge of banking processes and/or products
* Extensive experience in enterprise risk management and/or leadership roles within the banking, financial services or KPO sectors
* Knowledge of retail banking products and processes
* Demonstrated experience in risk and compliance management
* Strong stakeholder management
* Demonstrated experience in people leadership and capability development

**‘****Good to have’ knowledge, skills and experiences**

  

* ERP systems and Risk toolkits
* PACT
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Programs
* Business and Executive Report Writing

  

**Qualifications**

  

* Relevant tertiary qualifications
* Overall 15+ years of experience in banking, including a minimum of five years in risk, compliance or audit

  

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.

**So why join us?**
-------------------

From the moment you join ANZ, you'll be doing meaningful work that will shape a world where people and communities thrive.

  

But it's not just our customers who'll feel your impact. you'll feel it too. Because at ANZ, you'll have the resources, opportunities, and support you need to take the next big step in your career.

  

We're a diverse bunch at ANZ in different roles, different locations, doing different things. That's why we have a range of flexible working arrangements, so our people can 'make work, work for them'. We also provide a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services and discounts on selected products and services from ANZ and more.

  

At ANZ, you'll be part of an organisation where the different backgrounds, perspectives and life experiences of our people are celebrated. That's because we're committed to building a workplace that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. We welcome applications from everyone and encourage you to talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you ar

**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Director, Payment Acceptance
  
  
**Job Location: Pune**
**5 Days Work from Office**
**Shift Timing : 6:30PM to 3:30AM**
**What does a great Director of Business Analysis I do?**
The
**Director, Payment Acceptance**
provides strategic and operational leadership for Payment Acceptance operations functions within Merchant Solutions. This leader is accountable for delivering consistent, controlled, and efficient operations across least cost routing, interchange reconciliation, network reporting and fee oversight, merchant data integrity and PCI compliance support, and Payment Acceptance inquiries while ensuring the organization meets client commitments, network requirements, financial controls, service levels, quality standards, and productivity expectations.
  
  
The Director leads through other leaders and is responsible for translating business strategy into operational execution across a complex Payment Acceptance environment. The role provides oversight across credit deibt and dispute operation routing and configuration, interchange and settlement reconciliation, network fees and reporting, merchant compliance requirements, inquiry management and escalation, production workflow, reporting and analytics, and continuous improvement.
  
  
This leader is expected to think beyond daily operations. They anticipate operational, financial, network, and compliance risk; identify opportunities to simplify and modernize processes; develop scalable operating models; and establish the controls, metrics, talent, and governance necessary to support Payment Acceptance.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Provide strategic leadership for Payment Acceptance operations, establishing priorities, operating standards, performance expectations, and long-term direction across supported functions.
* Lead through managers, supervisors, and professional staff, creating clear accountability for operational execution, service delivery, quality, productivity, associate development, and results.
* Oversee Least Cost Routing support, ensuring debit network routing requirements, eligibility indicators, configuration values, and related data are accurate and support appropriate transaction routing.
* Provide leadership for interchange reconciliation activities across payment, interchange, settlement, and billing processes, ensuring variances, exceptions, and out-of-balance conditions are identified and resolved in a timely manner.
* Oversee network reporting and fee governance activities, ensuring reporting accuracy, data integrity, merchant compliance support, fee validation, and timely resolution of discrepancies.
* Provide leadership for Payment Acceptance inquiry support, ensuring Account Management and lines of business receive timely research, clear answers, appropriate issue tracking, and escalation to Technology when technical investigation or system changes are required.
* Provide oversight of payment and debit network requirements that affect routing, interchange, reporting, fees, merchant compliance, and Payment Acceptance operations.
* Lead production workflow and capacity management, ensuring inventory, staffing, skills, and resources are aligned to volumes, service-level requirements, and business priorities.
* Maintain strong financial and operational controls across interchange reconciliation, network fees, routing, reporting, exceptions, adjustments, and other activities affecting merchant or corporate financial positions.

jobs.title: Director-Technology Controls Testing Team Lead
jobs.description:
**Why Mizuho**

At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone

It’s the local expertise of our employees that makes our global network so powerful. By collaborating with colleagues and clients who have the same ambition and drive, you can amplify your sphere of influence and base of knowledge as part of one of the largest and growing banks in the world.

**Profile Summary:**

The Technology Controls Team Lead leads the India-based Chief Technology Controls Team and the EMEA Technology Internal Control Testing Programme.

The role is responsible for the risk-based assessment of technology controls, including control design and operating effectiveness testing, evidence quality, issue identification, remediation monitoring and management reporting. The role also develops data-led, automated and continuous control-assurance capabilities.

Working across EMEA Technology, the role partners with control owners, Technology leadership and relevant oversight and assurance functions to strengthen the technology control environment while maintaining clear accountability across the three lines of defense.

**Technology Controls Framework and Testing:**

* Own and maintain the EMEA Technology Controls Testing Framework.
* Lead the Technology Internal Control Testing Programme, including methodology, planning, scope, approval, execution, quality assurance and reporting.
* Develop a risk-based testing plan using RCSA results, process mapping, risk appetite measures, incidents, control failures, audit findings, regulatory priorities and material technology changes.
* Prioritize controls associated with Critical and High inherent risks, while including Moderate-rated controls where justified by risk concentration, limited assurance coverage, control failures or emerging risk.
* Maintain a technology testing inventory covering control ownership, risk linkage, testing frequency, previous results, existing assurance coverage and open issues.
* Lead control walkthroughs and assessments of control design and operating effectiveness.
* Define testing methods, evidence requirements, sampling approaches and quality standards.
* Ensure conclusions are supported by complete, reliable and traceable evidence.
* Coordinate with IT Risk Assurance lead on SOX, Compliance, Head Office and other assurance programmes to minimize unnecessary duplication.
* Continuously improve testing methodology, guidance, templates and supporting tools.

**Issues and Remediation:**

* Ensure control deficiencies, self-identified issues, risk acceptances and treatment plans are consistently identified, recorded and escalated.
* Challenge control ownership, testing conclusions, remediation plans and proposed issue closure.
* Ensure remediation actions have clear owners and target dates.
* Monitor remediation through to closure and arrange validation or retesting where required.
* Identify recurring or systemic control weaknesses requiring coordinated remediation.
* Escalate material control failures, overdue actions and risk appetite breaches through the appropriate governance channels.

**Audit and Regulatory Readiness:**

* Coordinate Technology responses to internal audit, external audit, SOX and regulatory assurance activity.
* Maintain a coordinated view of assurance activity, findings, evidence requests, management responses and remediation commitments.
* Improve the quality and timeliness of evidence, walkthroughs and management responses.
* Maintain a reusable regional evidence base to support assurance activity.
* Ensure recurring audit and regulatory themes inform the control framework, testing plan and remediation priorities.
* Support senior-management and regulatory briefings on material technology control matters.

**Reporting and Governance:**

* Own management information covering technology control testing delivery, control effectiveness, issues, remediation, risk acceptances and recurring themes.
* Provide concise, accurate and decision-oriented reporting to Technology leadership and relevant governance forums.
* Act as the central escalation and prioritisation point for Technology control-testing matters.
* Represent the Chief Technology Controls Team at relevant committees and working groups.
* Ensure material control weaknesses and risks are escalated promptly and transparently.

**Data, Tools and Continuous Assurance:**

* Own the Technology Controls testing toolset, workflows, dashboards and analytics capability.
* Ensure testing plans, evidence, samples, conclusions, issues and remediation records are accurately maintained in approved repositories.
* Establish standards for evidence quality, naming, ownership, version control, retention, permissions and audit traceability.
* Lead evidence coordination and quality review with process and control owners.
* Develop automated monitoring and continuous control-testing capabilities where supported by reliable data and repeatable testing logic.
* Define appropriate governance for automated testing, including data quality, access, change control, exception handling and periodic validation.
* Explore the responsible use of AI to support evidence review, control mapping, testing preparation, exception identification, thematic analysis and reporting.
* Ensure that automation and AI retain appropriate governance, validation and human oversight.

**Leadership and People Management:**

* Lead and develop the India-based Chief Technology Controls Team, initially comprising three VP-level control resources.
* Set team priorities and allocate coverage according to risk, assurance requirements and business demand.
* Lead implementation of the target operating model.
* Establish clear objectives, accountabilities and quality expectations.
* Build team capability through training, coaching and knowledge management.
* Promote a constructive, evidence-led risk and control culture.
* Provide broader local Technology Management or Operations oversight only where formally assigned.

**Decision Authority (Within delegated authority, the role may):**

* Approve the proposed testing plan and material scope changes before governance submission.
* Determine testing methods, evidence requirements, sampling approaches and quality standards.
* Require additional evidence, expanded testing or retesting.
* Escalate material control failures, overdue remediation and inadequate risk acceptance.
* Prioritise team activity and allocate testing resources.
* Recommend control improvements and automation opportunities.
  ***Control owners remain accountable for operating their controls and remediating identified weaknesses. Risk acceptance remains subject to approval under the applicable risk-management framework.***

**Experience and Skills:**

* Significant experience in technology risk, technology controls, IT audit, cyber risk or a related discipline within regulated financial services.
* Experience leading a technology control-testing or management-assurance programme.
* Strong knowledge of control design and operating effectiveness testing, including walkthroughs, evidence assessment, sampling, reperformance and issue validation.
* Experience of RCSA, risk appetite, issue management, risk acceptance and governance reporting.
* Broad understanding of material technology risks and controls.
* Experience supporting audits, regulatory reviews or SOX activity.
* Proven leadership of senior risk or control professionals.
* Strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to challenge constructively and explain complex control matters to senior management.
* Ability to work effectively across jurisdictions and multicultural teams.

jobs.title: Associate Director/Director - GenAI Business Strategy & Transformation

jobs.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a GenAI Business Strategy & Transformation Lead to anchor the DESIS GenAI-for-Business ("GAIBiz") effort. Depending on the candidate’s location preference, the position is open for either of our Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram offices in India. This person will be responsible for translating the firm's GenAI strategy into tangible adoption and measurable outcomes across the DESIS environment, working in close partnership with the strategy and transformation core based in the firm's global offices. This is a role largely built around execution and adoption. The strategy setting and transformation agenda is driven centrally; the mandate here is to land that agenda well within DESIS, shaping it for the local context, driving uptake, and delivering results on the ground. There will be real opportunities to influence direction and expand scope over time, but a candidate who thrives will be one who is energized by making things happen, not solely by setting up the agenda. This role will offer a good mix of strategy formulation and hands on delivery experience, tilting more towards later.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will drive GenAI adoption across DESIS by moving initiatives from pilot to production use; conceptualizing and executing novel ways to increase adoption; and owning the associated logistics and change-management scaffolding (enablement, incentives, communications, feedback loops) needed to turn well-designed programs into genuine, sustained uptake. You will partner with the global strategy and transformation core, acting as the DESIS anchor for firmwide GenAI strategy, ensuring initiatives are contextualized, sequenced, and executed effectively in and for the DESIS environment. You will engage credibly with technical teams, working shoulder to shoulder with engineering and data teams, understanding architecture, model capabilities, and tradeoffs well enough to challenge, prioritize, and unblock. You will embed risk, compliance, and data governance, ensuring GenAI initiatives meet the firm's standards for data protection, model risk, regulatory expectations, and responsible-AI practice from the outset, not as an afterthought. Finally, you will measure and communicate impact by defining the metrics that matter, tracking adoption and value realization, and reporting progress clearly to senior stakeholders across DESIS and the global firm.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* 15 or more years of experience in leading GenAI and tech transformation, including recent hands-on leadership of Generative AI initiatives
* Sound instincts on when to buy, when to build, and when a middle path serves best, with the commercial sense to weigh cost, speed, and control (Strategic and commercial judgment)
* A demonstrated track record of driving uptake, not just designing programs. Evidence of moving organizations from intent to embedded behavior (Change management and adoption)
* Deep enough understanding of GenAI and modern data/ML systems to engage engineers credibly and make informed trade-offs. You need not be a builder, but you must be conversant (Technical literacy)
* Experience in or adjacent to market finance, hedge funds, or investment management, with enough fluency to earn the trust of demanding stakeholders (Domain credibility)
* Practical familiarity with the risk, regulatory, and data-governance considerations that shape how AI can responsibly be deployed in a financial-services setting (Risk, compliance and data governance)
* Pragmatic and outcome-obsessed approach, with a high tolerance for ambiguity and rapid change. Ability to influence without authority across a distributed, matrixed organization, and comfort in operating primarily in a delivery-focused capacity within a globally driven agenda (Temperament and influencing skills)
* Creativity, critical thinking with excellent written and verbal communication skills and an entrepreneurial mindset to take on challenging, high-impact projects

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/ADGenAIOct26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers

**Company Profile**

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries.

As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence, and strong team ethics. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career, a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.

**Department Profile**

Client Onboarding and Regulatory Services (CORDS) is a global group with offices in New York, Baltimore, London, Glasgow, Tokyo, Hong Kong, Mumbai and Bengaluru. The group partners closely with Business, Legal and Compliance Division, Risk Management and Technology to assist the Firm in complying with regulatory obligations that involve client data, documentation and reporting requirements.
  
  
The Quality Control (QC) function sits within the Client Onboarding & Reference Data Services (CORDS) department of the Firmwide Operations division. QC provides independent, risk-based quality assurance over the end-to-end client lifecycle, covering client onboarding, Know Your Customer (KYC), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), sanctions screening, periodic review and account maintenance. As part of the first line of defense, the function gives senior management and the business assurance that client records meet the Firm's policy and regulatory requirements, and it uses data-led quality intelligence to find and fix systemic issues before they become risk events.

**Role Overview**

The Executive Director, Quality Control is a strategic and visionary leader accountable for the design, delivery and continuous transformation of the global QC framework across CORDS. The role leads a team of high-performing individuals, sets quality thresholds and tolerances, owns the risk-based QA/QC methodology and drives AI-led transformation of how quality is measured and assured. The successful candidate will be a trusted partner to Operations, Risk, Compliance, Technology and Audit leadership, able to influence without direct authority and to make strong, commercially aware decisions in a highly regulated environment.

**Primary Responsibilities**

Strategy, Governance and Operating Model
  
Set the strategic vision and multi-year roadmap for Quality Control across the end-to-end client lifecycle, aligned to the Firm's risk appetite and regulatory expectations

* Design and own the QC governance, control and operating model, including roles, coverage, escalation routes and management information
* Establish quality thresholds, tolerances and service level agreements, and hold production teams to account against them
* Represent QC at senior governance forums and risk committees, presenting concise, decision-ready insight to executive leadership

* Design and continuously refine a risk-based QA/QC methodology, including sampling approaches, testing scripts, rating criteria and calibration standards

* Plan and perform thematic reviews to identify systemic weaknesses, emerging risks and policy or procedural gaps
* Lead root cause analysis of quality findings and drive sustainable remediation and continuous improvement with production and policy owners
  

  

**Regulatory, Audit and Risk Management**

* Act as the senior point of contact for regulatory examinations and internal and external audits relating to client lifecycle quality
* Stay current with global AML, KYC, sanctions and client due diligenceundefined
  

  

**Experience Required**

* 18+ years of relevant experience in financial services across client lifecycle management, AML/KYC, quality assurance, risk or compliance, including significant time in senior leadership roles
* End-to-end client lifecycle management expertise covering onboarding, KYC, AML, EDD, sanctions screening, periodic review and account maintenance
* Proven track record of designing and running risk-based QA/QC programmes, thematic reviews and independent quality assurance at scale
* Demonstrated exposure to regulatory examinations and internal and external audits
* Track record of leading large-scale transformation and process re-engineering, including AI-led or automation-enabled change
* Experience leading global or cross-regional teams of high-performing individuals
Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of training and experience; a postgraduate qualification is an advantage

Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. jobs.description:
**About Data Axle**

Data Axle Inc. has been an industry leader in data, marketing solutions, sales, and research for over 50 years in the USA. Data Axle now has an established strategic global centre of excellence in Pune. This centre delivers mission-critical data services to its global customers, powered by its proprietary cloud-based technology platform and by leveraging proprietary business and consumer databases.  
  
**Role Summary:**

We are looking for an experienced and strategic Senior Director - Finance to lead the finance function, oversee financial operations, and drive financial governance across the organization.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in managing financial reporting, accounting, controllership, taxation, audit, and regulatory compliance, with strong expertise in both Indian Accounting Standards (IGAAP / Ind AS) and US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP).

This role will serve as a strategic finance partner to senior leadership and global stakeholders, ensuring financial accuracy, operational efficiency, compliance, and alignment with global finance policies and business objectives.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Financial Reporting & Controllership**

* Lead end-to-end financial reporting, accounting, and controllership functions.
* Ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial statements under both IGAAP / Ind AS and US GAAP.
* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing processes.
* Manage financial consolidation, reconciliations, intercompany accounting, and reporting.
* Ensure consistency between local statutory reporting and US GAAP reporting requirements.
* Establish robust internal financial controls, accounting policies, and governance frameworks.

* **US GAAP & IGAAP Compliance**

* Provide technical accounting guidance on complex accounting matters under US GAAP and IGAAP / Ind AS.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, statutory requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
* Manage accounting differences between Indian and US reporting frameworks, including revenue recognition, leases, fixed assets, provisions, and foreign currency transactions.
* Coordinate with global finance teams to ensure alignment of accounting practices and reporting standards.
* Drive implementation of changes in accounting standards and assess their business impact.

* **Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)**

* Lead budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and performance management.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to support strategic business decisions.
* Monitor revenue, operating expenses, profitability, cash flow, and financial performance.
* Develop financial models, business forecasts, and scenario analyses.
* Partner with business leaders to identify cost optimization and profitability improvement opportunities.

* **Audit, Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Lead statutory, internal, and external audit processes.
* Manage coordination with external auditors, tax consultants, and regulatory authorities.
* Oversee direct and indirect taxation, including corporate tax, GST, transfer pricing, and other applicable compliance requirements.
* Ensure adherence to Indian statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Support US audit and tax reporting requirements in coordination with global finance teams.

* **Treasury & Cash Flow Management**

* Oversee treasury operations, working capital, liquidity, and cash flow management.
* Develop strategies for efficient cash utilization and financial risk management.
* Monitor foreign exchange exposure and implement appropriate risk mitigation measures.
* Manage banking relationships and financing arrangements.

* **Global Finance Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a key finance business partner to US-based leadership and global finance teams.
* Drive standardization of financial processes, reporting frameworks, and controls across geographies.
* Present financial performance, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
* Ensure effective coordination between India finance operations and US corporate finance.

* **Leadership & Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing finance and accounting team.
* Build a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Drive automation, process optimization, and digital transformation across finance operations.
* Establish KPIs and performance metrics for the finance function.

Requirements:

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) with 15+ years of post-qualification experience (PQE) in Finance and Accounting, including significant experience in senior finance leadership roles.
* Strong hands-on expertise in both **IGAAP / Ind AS and US GAAP**.
* Proven experience managing financial reporting and controllership for multinational organizations or US-headquartered companies.
* Strong understanding of US GAAP technical accounting, financial consolidation, and statutory reporting.
* Experience managing global finance stakeholders and cross-border financial operations.
* Strong exposure to financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, taxation, treasury, and audit management.
* Experience leading large finance teams and managing complex financial operations.

**Description**

At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd  
  
Treasury is the Vice Presidency, reporting to the Managing Director and World Bank Group Chief Financial Officer, performing treasury functions for the IBRD and IDA and, to varying degrees, for other members of the World Bank Group and other public sector investors. Its activities are organized and grouped into the following departments: Capital Markets & Investment Management, Client Asset Management and Advisory, and Treasury Operations.  
  
Treasury (TRE) has been a large and significant player in the international financial markets for over seventy years and has achieved a global reputation as a prudent and innovative borrower, investor and risk manager. Treasury is responsible for: (i) managing approximately $195 billion in assets for the World Bank and other official sector investors; (ii) leading IBRD’s and IDA’s triple-A rated financing programs in international and domestic bond and derivative markets; (iii) conducting asset and liability management for IBRD’s and IDA’s balance sheets; (iv) overseeing the development and outreach related to the financing and hedging products the Bank provides for its developing-country clients; and (v) collaborating with the World Bank member countries to help build their capacity. Staff in Treasury regularly interact and collaborate with other departments across the Bank and Finance Partners’ teams.  
  
The Treasury Operations Department (TREOP) provides a full range of operational support for Treasury’s asset management, capital markets and banking businesses. The Department is presently organized in 7 operational units: Asset and Liability Operations (TREAL), Quantitative Solutions and Analytics (TREQA), and Cash and Banking Operations (TREBK), Treasury Quantitative Modelling (TREQM), Treasury ALM & Collateral (TREAC), Treasury Market Data and Valuation (TREMV) and a Financial Technology coordination unit (TREFT).  
  
Treasury Asset and Liability Operations (TREAL) is the unit responsible for delivering on a range of operations functions supporting the funding, investment, and asset and liability management portfolios for internal World Bank Group (IBRD, IDA, MIGA, and Trust Funds) entities. In addition, the team supports investment portfolios for a growing roster of more than 60 client entities in domestic and international markets. The team provides integrated and end-to-end support for all trade execution and portfolio servicing activities including trade review, settlement and documentation, options monitoring, debt service and cash and collateral management across the full range of products including bonds, swaps, repos, deposits, and exchange-traded derivatives.  
  
In performing these functions, the team works closely with internal partners and market counterparts as well as external service providers such as technology vendors, custodians, and paying agents. In addition to managing the day-to-day operations, TREAL staff lead the research, coordination, and implementation of new products and markets across Treasury. The team has a heavy focus on, and takes a leadership role in, evaluating and deploying the latest products and technologies (core trading platforms and new initiatives and technologies like CBDC, blockchain, AI, robotics, etc.) to create efficiencies, reduce risk, and advance thought leadership amongst WB’s peers and clients. TREAL staff participate in capacity-building programs for clients in these areas of expertise. TREAL staff recently co-led projects where the World Bank issued innovative digital bonds using blockchain technology and CBDC. In recognition of their efforts to advance capital markets and asset management, the TREAL team received several industry awards including for “Innovation in Reserves Management” (2021) and “Asset Servicing Initiative of the year” (2023). The team has twice been shortlisted for “Operations Team of the Year” award (2023 and 2024).  
  
Treasury ALM & Collateral Operations (TREAC) delivers operations support for asset and liability management, client risk management and collateral activities across IBRD, IDA and IFC. It is the operational engine of Treasury Client Solutions (TCS) and the central collateral management provider for WBG entities and RAMP clients. Team covers the full transaction lifecycle for funding and client hedging transactions, from trade setup and confirmation through settlement, rate fixings, payment events, exception handling, reconciliations and reporting. On the collateral side, it manages margining for OTC derivatives, MBS and futures, including daily margin calls, dispute resolution, CSA agreement administration, and monitoring of valuation.  
  
The team also supports long-term local currency investment transactions through IFC in countries where market solutions are not sufficiently available under the IDA–IFC Private Sector Window. The team works closely with front office, risk, finance, legal and technology teams, and with external counterparties, custodians, brokers and clearing organizations. Operating from Washington, D.C., Chennai and Sofia give the unit time-zone coverage and continuity. Beyond daily operations, TREAC leads systems implementation, convergence and digital transformation, with a strong focus on operational risk, controls and governance. The team operates on a common WBG operating model that aligns with IBRD, IDA and IFC practices, reduces duplication and manual handoffs, and delivers scalable, traceable, automation-ready processes.  
  
**Duties and Accountabilities:**  
The TRE Operations Chennai (TRECH) is an integral part of TREOP and is responsible for a variety of duties providing vital support across its operational divisions. It works closely with the Headquarters in Washington D.C and another shared services center in Sofia, Bulgaria. Under the guidance and supervision of a Team Lead and/or Functional Lead, the incumbent will have responsibilities for specific individual tasks/projects as well as for working as an integral part of the team in executing the Treasury Operation’s work program, while maintaining close relationships with the other Treasury departments.  
  
The incumbent’s primary responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, some combination of the following activities:  
  

* Work closely with the team to understand various facets of post-execution activities for fixed income, derivatives, and cash products to identify, analyze and prioritize process reengineering, automation and streamlining opportunities focusing on enhancing efficiency and accuracy.
* Support data collection, analysis, visualization, and report writing, including by innovatively using data, stories, and analytics to build powerful narratives.
* Support automation initiatives and projects relating to various sub-operational areas including maintenance of databases, dashboards, and reports using

**Job Summary**
---------------

Treasury works closely with senior management, the businesses, Country CEOs / CFOs, and Finance to manage and promote the bank’s liquidity, capital, and balance sheet position. Treasury is laser-focussed on its vision to be “Open, progressive and trusted, working commercially with our partners” to create sustainable value by balancing the supply and demand of liquidity and capital.

Within Treasury (which comprises Capital, Liquidity & Markets), the Treasury Liquidity function is responsible for driving the strategic liquidity agenda and Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Booking (‘IRRBB’).

The Associate Director – IRRBB, India hub will support the Head of IRRBB, India Hub in advancing IRRBB Analytics for overseeing and executing comprehensive internal analyses. The role holder will help in migrating and centralising global IRRBB processes from Group and Clusters, performing detailed stress tests and scenario analyses, leveraging IRRBB data to provide insightful risk assessments and mitigation strategies. This position requires a deep understanding of IRRBB, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**  
• Keep up to date with the Group’s business strategy (incl. SC Ventures) and ensure the IRRBB frameworks are aligned to that.
  
• Partner with Global Head of IRRBB in developing and recommending risk mitigation strategies based on the findings from stress tests and scenario analyses. Ensure that these strategies are effectively communicated and implemented across relevant business units.

**Business**  
• Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates, with a focus on the Group’s participation in the Digital Assets and platforms space.
  
• Provide insights on current and forward looking IRRBB exposures, impact assessments on interest income and actions available for balance sheet optimisation.
  
• Lead the engagement with businesses on balance sheet optimisation strategies including but not limited to asset & liability mix to manage IRRBB while optimising returns.

**Processes**  
• **Analytics:** Support the newly developed IRRBB analytics capabilities on a regular basis, including operating the RCO IRRBB calculation engine to run bespoke scenarios and extracting and analysing the results, covering key metric including, but not limited to, Weekly NIIS Flash, Hedging Strategy Assessments, Corporate Plan NII impact simulations and PV01 analysis. This will also involve working with CPM and Finance closely to prepare MI slides for relevant committees like GALCO, ALCO and IRRBB Steering Forums.

* **Strategy:** Support IRRBB strategy by engaging Treasury Markets on NII sensitivities, hedging performance and P&L forecasting. Support investor relations for quarterly results, including GALCO/ALCO hedging updates, and contribute to annual disclosures through slide preparation, briefing notes, Q&A drafting and investor query responses.

* **Framework & Governance:** Support IRRBB governance through preparation of monthly GALCO/ALCO packs with commentary, review of risk metrics and monitoring of group, solo and local limits.
