**The team**

Businesses are continuously exploring opportunities to grow / rationalize costs and mergers and acquisitions, or carve-outs through separations and divestitures, are among the most complex business activities an organization will undertake. Deloitte’s global network of consulting

practitioner’s help clients identify and solve their most critical information and transformational challenges. With market-leading expertise in 17 industry segments, superior business transformation capabilities, and deep technical expertise, our global network of more than 33,000 consulting practitioners create unmatched market offerings to solve our clients’ toughest business issues.

Mergers & Acquisitions team helps strategize, design, and implement end-to-end solutions for successful transactions, from advance-planning to post-transaction restructuring. The team helps drive performance for businesses in every key M&A-related function: project management, commercial activity optimization, operations and supply chain, IT systems, human capital management, and finance activities. Learn more about our Strategy & Transactions Practice

  

**Your work profile**

Professionals in M&A group offer both advisory and deployment services that provide clients with comprehensive solutions to help them better manage the critical business functions.

We accomplish this mission through continued development of people in our Strategy, Risk and Transactions - M&A: Deal Transformation and Post Merger Integration

The primary role is to make direct contributions to the engagement team by assisting healthcare sector clients on Organization Readiness and integration or carve-outs in a deal / M&A scenario.

  

**Delivery of specific capability in Pharma M&A: DT & PMI**

**Organization readiness in a post deal integration:**

* Understand the integration vision and strategy set out in the deal objective
* Work with C-suite executives, business and internal firm stakeholders to identify integration guiding principles
* Identify the target operating model, organization construct and governance model for the consolidated entity
* Evaluate the considerations for organization readiness for interim (Day 1 /100), desired end state
* Establish Day 1 / Day 100 checklists and workplans
* Contribute in Integration Management office (IMO) for end-to-end program management of workstreams involved in the Integration process
  

**Integration support for post-deal activities:**

* Program / Integration/ Transformation management office planning and readiness
* Day 1 / 100 Readiness planning
* Assess the IT landscape and identify the areas of synergies / dis-synergies
* Vendor evaluation and selection
* IT spend analysis (including vendor contract reviews for any hidden transactional costs), provide recommendations on the cost efficiencies
* Bid formulation and vendor management
* Facilitate execution of the post deal integration of IT operations and organization
  

**Carve-out and separation:**

* Develop the separation strategy and assess the separation readiness
* Evaluate financial and operational entanglements / interdependencies
* Identify the operating model, organization construct and governance model for the re-structured entity
* Evaluate the considerations for organization readiness for interim (Day 1 /100) and desired end state
* Establish Day 1 / Day 100 checklists and workplans
* Contribute in managing the Separation Management Office (SMO) across the workstreams
* Assess the TSA requirements, prepare TSA schedules and TSA exit strategies
* Cost modelling for one-time and recurring costs due to separation (stranded cost, standalone costs etc.)
* Define step- wise separation road map
  

**Commercial and Operational Diligence and Transformation:**

* Evaluate the strategic and commercial feasibility of a deal / transaction
* Evaluate the current business capabilities and identify red flags on operational issues/risks
* Assess the Post deal consolidation and transformation opportunities
* Leverage industry best practices and Deloitte accelerators to define methodological approach to consolidation / separation
* Undertake detailed functional integration planning (e.g. Sales and Marketing, operations, Finance, IT, HR etc.) for Day 1 /100 and End state
* Support delivery of functional plans
  

**Synergy / dis-synergy assessment & delivery:**

* Identify areas of potential synergies / dis-synergies and establish the degree of integration required
* Define road map for delivery of synergies and advise on synergy benefits tracking
* Work with functional leads on Synergy realization
  

**Key skills required:**

* Candidate should be able to demonstrate experience of working on large transformations including pre-deal or post-deal M&A transactions in healthcare/pharma/hospitals space
* Candidate should possess good knowledge of healthcare chain from a business standpoint
* A strong and demonstrated interest in consulting with 8+ years of relevant experience in financial services industry preferably banking
* Relevant understanding of technology landscape of a Healthcare organization would be a key differentiator
* Excellent academic credentials for both undergraduate and graduate coursework. MBA preferred
* Strong advanced MS Excel and MS PowerPoint skills
* Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal
* Leadership qualities and the ability to mentor junior consultants and analysts
* Willingness and ability to take initiative and learn independently
* This role involves travelling.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer - India
jobs.description:
**Location & work modality: India , Mumbai**

**About Submer**  
  
**At Submer, we are redefining how data centers are built, integrated, and operated, with sustainability, efficiency, and innovation at the core. Our technology is designed to reduce environmental impact while improving performance and efficiency. We are a purpose-driven company with a passion for innovation and a growing global presence.**

**Your impact**

Submer India is seeking an experienced, commercially minded and strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead and build the Finance function in India. This is a growth- and investment-oriented role with particular responsibility for capital strategy, fundraising and the financial architecture supporting enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion.

The CFO will own the India capital agenda within approved mandates, working with India and Group leadership to secure financing and lead transactions through financial closure. The role requires an accomplished senior finance leader with demonstrated CFO-level responsibility and a proven record of personally leading and closing capital-raising transactions, preferably within technology, infrastructure, digital infrastructure, datacentres, engineering, energy or other high-growth and capital-intensive businesses.

The successful candidate will combine capital-raising capability with strong financial stewardship, governance and compliance. The CFO must understand the complete business lifecycle, from establishment and capitalisation through growth, scaling, restructuring and potential strategic transactions and/or potential exit, and be able to operate in an entrepreneurial technology and infrastructure environment.

**What you'll do**

**1. Strategic Financial Leadership**
=====================================

* Act as a key member of the India leadership team and provide strategic financial leadership to support Submer's growth and long-term enterprise value.
* Develop and execute the financial and capital strategy for the India business, linking enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion to appropriate sources of funding.
* Partner with business and operational leadership on investments, expansion plans and commercial opportunities, providing financial insight, strategic decisions and constructive challenge.
* Build scalable financial structures, processes, controls and planning capabilities suitable for a high growth organisation
* Build long term business planning and value creation.

**2. Investment, Fundraising and Capital Raising**
==================================================

* Lead the development and execution of capital-raising strategies for Submer's India business and strategic initiatives, aligned with approved plans and funding mandates.
* Build and maintain relationships with institutional, private equity, venture capital, infrastructure and strategic investors/partners, banks, financial institutions and structured-finance providers, as relevant.
* Lead India investor and lender engagement, financial presentations and, 'fund-sourcing to fund-raising to investment' plans and subsequent discussions; *(coordinate with Group finance and support Group-led transactions under the agreed mandate.)*
* Distinguish corporate capital for enterprise growth, including growth equity, strategic investment and corporate debt, from project or asset capital, including JV/SPV equity, infrastructure debt, construction finance and project finance.
* Develop financial models, investment cases and business plans; evaluate funding structures, financing costs, dilution, security requirements and investment returns.
* Lead financial due diligence readiness, strategic investment, financial structuring and financing negotiations through financial closure, coordinating legal, tax, business and technical inputs and obtaining required approvals.
* Agree capital-raising milestones with leadership and report on funding secured, transaction progress, financing terms and deployment of proceeds; maintain appropriate investor and lender reporting.

**3. Business Lifecycle and Growth Strategy**
=============================================

Guide the business through its financial lifecycle and ensure that funding structures and financial capabilities evolve with its stage of development. This includes:

* Business establishment, entity structuring, financial planning and initial capitalisation.
* Early-stage growth, scaling, fundraising and infrastructure or project expansion.
* Financial governance, commercial growth, profitability and long-term value creation.
* Mergers, acquisitions, strategic partnerships, restructuring and business transformation.
* Transaction readiness and potential exit planning.

Align corporate growth capital, project or asset financing and subsequent refinancing or strategic transactions with business needs, risk appetite and approved return objectives.

**4. Financial Planning, Analysis and Performance Management**
==============================================================

* Lead annual budgeting, long-term financial planning, forecasts and scenario modelling.
* Monitor financial and operational performance against approved plans
* Analyze profitability, cash flow, capital requirements and investment returns.
* Track business and project performance against approved investment cases, identify variances and recommend corrective action.
* Develop management reports and financial dashboards for senior leadership, identifying risks and opportunities and enabling informed decisions.

**5. Corporate Finance and Strategic Transactions**
===================================================

* Evaluate investment and strategic opportunities through valuation, financial analysis and assessment of returns and risks.
* Lead financial due diligence and financial transaction structuring for India-led transactions; *(support Group-led transactions within the agreed mandate.)*
* Structure and financially govern joint ventures and special purpose vehicles (JVs/SPVs), including shareholder funding, debt/equity arrangements, inter-company transactions and project returns.
* Develop and oversee cash waterfalls, distributions, dividend or repatriation arrangements and investor reporting in accordance with approved agreements and applicable requirements.
* Contribute to mergers, acquisitions and strategic partnerships, working with legal, tax, banking and external advisory partners
* Support exit readiness and strategic transaction planning.

**6. Finance Operations, Governance and Compliance**
====================================================

* Establish and maintain robust financial controls, policies and governance, including oversight of capital deployment and entity-level reporting.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian accounting, taxation, corporate and regulatory requirements
* Oversee financial, accounting and statutory compliance reporting.
* Ensure timely and accurate financial management and statutory filings.
* Manage relationships with auditors, tax advisors and external consultants; *(coordinating with Group finance as appropriate.)*
* Identify and mitigate financial and business risks, including financing covenant compliance and related-party exposures.

**7. Cash Flow and Working Capital Management**
===============================================

* Lead cash flow, liquidity and working capital planning and management.
* Align liquidity and financing requirements with business growth, capital expenditure and project or JV/SPV funding commitments.
* Manage banking relationships and financing facilities
* Monitor funding availability, drawdown conditions and covenant headroom.
* Monitor capital expenditure and investment commitments and optimise the use of capital across approved business, for infrastructure- and project-based requirements.

**8. Technology and Infrastructure Business Understanding**
=======================================================

jobs.title: Implementation Director
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa is transforming the future of banking and payments through Pismo, Visa's cloud-native core banking and issuer processing platform. Built to help financial institutions modernize legacy infrastructure, launch innovative products faster, and scale securely in real time, Pismo is enabling the next generation of digital banking experiences across the globe.

As an Implementation Director, you will lead the successful delivery of some of Visa and Pismo's most strategic client transformation programs. Working with leading banks, fintechs, and financial institutions, you will be responsible for orchestrating large-scale platform implementations that redefine how clients issue cards, process transactions, manage accounts, and deliver modern payment experiences to their customers.

This is a highly visible leadership role that sits at the intersection of technology, payments, and transformation. You will act as the executive sponsor for complex implementation programs, partnering with senior client stakeholders and cross-functional Visa and Pismo teams to drive delivery excellence, mitigate risk, and accelerate value realization.

The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, executive stakeholder management, and deep program leadership capabilities to guide clients through critical modernization journeys, helping them move from legacy platforms to cloud-native infrastructure that supports future growth and innovation.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

* Lead end-to-end implementation and transformation programs for strategic Pismo clients, from contract signature and mobilization through go-live and post-launch stabilization.
* Serve as the primary executive point of contact for client leadership teams, building trusted relationships with C-suite, business, operations, technology, and transformation stakeholders.
* Drive governance, delivery strategy, program execution, dependency management, and risk mitigation across complex multi-workstream initiatives.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Client Success, Information Security, Risk, and Commercial teams to ensure successful delivery against client commitments.
* Establish executive steering committees and governance forums, providing clear visibility into program progress, milestones, risks, decisions, and business outcomes.
* Navigate complex organizational environments to align stakeholders, resolve delivery challenges, and maintain momentum across large-scale transformation programs.
* Champion implementation excellence while ensuring clients achieve measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, and accelerated time-to-value.
* Support clients through change management, platform adoption, and operational readiness as they transition onto Pismo's cloud-native infrastructure.
* Capture lessons learned and implementation best practices to continuously strengthen Visa and Pismo's delivery frameworks.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 10 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 8 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA/JD/MD) or at least 3 years of work experience with a PhD

  

* Over 15 years of experience in technology-driven financial services, with a strong focus on leading large-scale implementation and transformation projects for global fintech's and banks.
* Detailed technical knowledge of payments ecosystem in GCC countries, more specifically implementation and certification of Jaywan and AEP Switch in UAE
* Technical knowledge of payments and banking platforms operating in the cloud in a microservice architecture, with REST/JSON API’s and data streaming.
* Educational background in solutions architecture and software engineering. Cloud certifications are a plus.
* Having completed a core banking, payments transformation implementation from contract signature to production live.
* Expertise in building and scaling high-performing teams, with a hands-on leadership style that emphasizes mentorship, empowerment, and a culture of accountability.
* Proven ability to deliver complex, multi-market projects on time and within scope, leveraging advanced project management methodologies (Agile, Lean, and hybrid models) and a pragmatic, results-oriented approach.
* Recognized for forging strong, trust-based relationships with C-level executives, clients, and cross-functional partners, ensuring alignment and transparency throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Adept at translating business strategy into actionable plans, optimizing processes, and driving continuous improvement through data-driven decision-making and KPI management.
* Russian speaker is highly desirable

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

* Understanding of AI-driven QA solutions.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
Synechron is seeking a market-facing Solution Architect with strong Payments and Banking expertise to drive new business, account growth, strategic consulting, and solution-led engagements. The role combines domain knowledge, enterprise architecture, client advisory, executive engagement, and business development.
  
  
**Software Requirements**
**Required:**

* Enterprise and solution architecture tools
* API, integration, and cloud platforms
* CRM and opportunity-management tools
* Proposal, estimation, presentation, and documentation tools
* Payment processing and banking technology platforms
* Architecture diagramming and business case tools

**Preferred:**

* Cloud platforms, API gateways, microservices, event streaming, containers, and observability tools
* Data analytics and reporting platforms
* Enterprise architecture frameworks

**Overall Responsibilities**

* Lead consulting and solution architecture engagements across Payments and Banking.
* Drive new-logo acquisition, account farming, opportunity identification, and revenue growth.

* Collaborate with sales, delivery, engineering, finance, legal, and domain teams.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Enterprise architecture, cloud, payments, banking, security, or project management certifications are preferred.
* Completion of Synechron security, compliance, conduct, and role-specific training is required.
* Ongoing learning in payments, banking regulations, cloud, security, and financial technology is expected.

**Professional Competencies**

* Structured problem-solving and sound commercial judgment.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and influence decisions.
* Adaptability to changing markets, regulations, and client priorities.
* Innovation focused on measurable business value.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Director (ID # 912)
jobs.description:
**About the Company**

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

**About the Role**

The role owns the commercial relationship and ensures each account is getting real value from Sarvam’s products, expanding into new use cases, and renewing with conviction. You are the single point of commercial accountability for your book of business. You will work at the intersection of the client, the delivery team (FDSEs, CSEs, CSMs), and Sarvam’s product and GTM leadership. What you learn in the field shapes how the company prioritises product improvements, structures pricing, and designs its post-sales playbooks. If you are someone who combines commercial sharpness with genuine curiosity about how AI products create value for enterprise clients, this role is for you.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the full commercial relationship across a portfolio of Sarvam’s enterprise accounts: renewals, expansion, cross-sell, and net revenue retention
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key stakeholders across your accounts, from operational teams running Sarvam products daily to CXO-level sponsors
* Drive account expansion by identifying new use cases, business units, and product lines where Sarvam can deliver incremental value
* Lead renewal negotiations end-to-end, including pricing, scope, and contract structuring, in close coordination with GTM leadership
* Run structured account reviews (QBRs, health checks, success plans) that demonstrate measurable business impact and align both sides on next steps
* Use product usage data, delivery metrics, and client feedback to proactively identify health signals, adoption gaps, and churn risk
* Work closely with FDSEs, CSEs, and CSMs to ensure delivery quality remains high and client expectations are met throughout the engagement lifecycle
* Translate client feedback, feature requests, and competitive intelligence back to product teams with enough context and specificity to be actionable
* Contribute to building Sarvam’s post-sales playbook: account segmentation frameworks, expansion motions, health scoring models, and renewal processes

**Qualifications**

* 8-20 years of experience in enterprise sales ales, account management, customer success, or post-sales roles within B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, or AI/ML products
* Proven track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets, specifically renewal rates and net revenue retention (NRR) metrics

**Required Skills**

* Commercial instinct: you segment your book by expansion potential, keep active expansion conversations going, and build business cases that land with economic buyers
* Ability to hold a technical conversation with an engineering or product team on the client side. You do not need to write code, but you need to understand how APIs, integrations, and AI workflows connect
* Strong communication skills: you can move fluidly between an operational lead, a technical counterpart, and a procurement team within the same account
* Comfort using product data and analytics to drive account decisions rather than relying on gut feel alone
* Experience working in a fast-moving environment where you build process as you go, not inherit it from a mature org

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior experience managing accounts in conversational AI, voice technology, language technology, or document intelligence
* Familiarity with the Indian enterprise buying landscape: procurement cycles, compliance requirements, multi-stakeholder decision-making, and government contracting norms
* Experience working alongside Forward Deployed Engineering, professional services, or delivery teams in a post-sales capacity
* Background in consulting, solutions engineering, or customer success before moving into account management
* Hands-on experience with CRM and customer health tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, or equivalent)

**Pay range and compensation package**

Note: We are looking for people who can own the outcomes described here, not people who match every line of this specification. If this problem excites you and you believe you can do this work, we want to hear from you.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact. Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar. High ownership and high impact, from day one. Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems. You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates. If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

jobs.title: Client Analytics Business Partner
jobs.description:
**Marcus Evans**
is a global leader in business intelligence and growth partner for leading businesses worldwide, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. Since 1983, we have brought decision-makers together through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms and performance programmes, working across all sectors and regions.

Our overriding approach is one of collaboration, and our belief that "We'll be our most successful when we work together." We recognise excellence and actively develop top performers into future leaders. Our culture promotes teamwork, continuous learning and global career growth.

**About Client Analytics**

Client Analytics is a new team in Hyderabad. It partners with the Managing Directors who lead our sales offices around the world, and helps them manage every client account to a consistent standard: before an event, on site and long after it. The team works on the data and discipline behind how we keep and grow clients, so our sales leaders can spend their time in front of them.

**Job Summary**

We're hiring Client Analytics Business Partner to work alongside the Managing Directors who run our sales offices in North America, APAC and Europe. You'll own the account management rhythm for those offices. That covers the rebook plan before every event, the results after it, the clients we're trying to win back, and the health of every active account. You'll turn client data into a clear view of where each account stands and what should happen next.

This is a partnering role, not a sales role and not an administrative one. You won't sell to clients. You will be the person an MD relies on to know whether the right work has been done on every account, to prompt it when it hasn't, and to report it clearly to our senior leadership.

This is an hybrid role in our Hyderabad office. Working hours overlap with the business day of the offices you support in North America and Europe.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan & Report: Build the pre-event rebook review four weeks out, covering what we plan to offer each client and how well we know them. Check that pricing has reached the sales team in time. Run a strategy update with the MD in the final one to two weeks. Four weeks after the event, report the outcome for every client.
* Win back lost clients: Own the lost opportunity list for your offices. Categorise each account, keep it current and review it with the MD every four weeks. Run the win-back programme, including the controlled use of complimentary video meetings. Track the results of reassigned accounts.
* Know the active portfolio: Keep a live view of each client showing what we know, what we plan to offer and when we next engage them. Use CRM data, AI tools and third-party sources to build the picture, and spot where the account can grow.
* Hold the standard: Monitor adherence to the account management workflow and alert the MD when a step is missed. Track KPIs and scoring, keep the dashboard current, and flag where retraining is needed. Work with Learning & Quality to train sales teams.
* Report to leadership: Present evidence-based reviews and clear recommendations to senior leadership, including the Chairman and CEO.
* Work across the business: Partner with Operations, Finance, Marketing and Technology. Direct the Account Management Coordinators who support your offices. Suggest improvements to our reports and tools, including where AI can save time.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in business, commerce, economics, statistics or a related field
* Minimum 5 years in sales operations, revenue operations, commercial analytics, account management analytics or a similar role supporting sales leaders
* Experience working directly with senior stakeholders in the US, UK or Europe, and the confidence to challenge them constructively
* Advanced Excel, plus hands-on experience with a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce
* Able to turn data into a short, clear recommendation that a busy senior leader can act on
* Excellent written and spoken English (C1 or above)
* Highly organised and comfortable managing several stakeholders, deadlines and reporting cycles at once
* Discretion with commercially sensitive information
* Willing to work hours that overlap with North American and European offices

**Preferred**

* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification
* Experience in B2B services, events, media, consulting or financial services
* Experience with dashboard tools such as Power BI or Tableau
* Experience using AI tools for research and analysis
* Familiarity with sales intelligence platforms such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo or Apollo
* Experience supporting account management, client retention or key account programmes

**Compensation & Benefits**

jobs.description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* Minimum 10 years’ enterprise sales or direct client coverage and relationship management of a broad spectrum of institutional clients: regional banks, central banks, sovereign wealth funds, insurance, asset managers
* Familiarity with Middle East, GCC and global markets, reflecting cross-border client engagement and product delivery
* Arabic language skills (spoken and written) are an advantage, supporting engagement with regional clients and senior stakeholders
* Strong knowledge of credit, risk, capital markets or regulatory workflows—and the ability to translate GCC regulatory requirements (such as those of the local Central Banks or Capital Monetary Authorities) into Moody’s solutions
* Working knowledge of Moody’s capabilities across KYC and customer onboarding, supplier and third-party risk, commercial and corporate lending, private credit and AI-enabled solutions, with the ability to position them to risk, compliance, credit and technology stakeholders
* Exceptional C-level relationship-building, consultative selling and contract negotiation skills, complemented by independent thought leadership and advisory sales expertise. Demonstrates the ability to generate impactful ideas for clients, influencing outcomes at the highest level
* Demonstrates a strong track record in building and leading high-performing sales teams, with a focus on cross-functional collaboration. Applies strategic planning, pipeline management and disciplined execution to consistently meet or exceed revenue targets
* Excellent communication—listening, presenting and writing—and the confidence to influence senior external and internal stakeholders
* High initiative, resilience and the ability to work independently while fostering teamwork in a matrix environment

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, applied finance, economics or a related field (post graduate finance or risk qualification advantageous)

**Responsibilities**

* Own and expand relationships with the GCC’s Tier 1 banks and a broad spectrum of institutional clients—including central banks, banks, sovereign wealth funds, insurance, asset managers —engaging board and C-suite stakeholders and setting multi-year account strategies aligned to client priorities
* Retain and grow revenue by cross-selling and up-selling the full Moody’s Analytics suite, leveraging advisory sales and innovative solutions across KYC and onboarding, supplier and third-party risk, lending and credit origination, private credit, AI-enabled solutions, credit, ESG, AML, regulatory reporting, data and analytics
* Partner with global product heads to position Moody’s insights in the context of local and regional regulatory and industry trends, including private credit, lending modernisation, AI adoption, automation, KYC and supplier risk management, climate risk and digitised credit workflows

You will sit within the Moody’s Analytics Middle East Sales team, a high energy group of enterprise sellers, with this role based in Dubai and focused on the GCC. The team partners with the region’s biggest banks and FIs to deliver Moody’s data, analytics and workflow solutions. Collaboration is core: Relationship Managers lead opportunities while working hand in hand with Product Specialists, Solutions Consultants, Finance and Legal colleagues to solve complex client challenges, accelerate revenue growth and share best practices across the wider regional and global sales organisation.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
**About Column**
For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.
  
  
At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!
  
  
**The opportunity**
Column's Growth team is focused on managing our highly strategic customer relationships. As a member of the Growth team, you’ll be responsible for building and overseeing all aspects of our customer management while acting as a trusted partner, advisor and advocate for a wide variety of customers. You will also be in charge of designing and implementing the strategy, processes, and content needed to help us scale this key function.
  
  
This role has a unique international focus, helping build one of Column's most strategic expansion initiatives from the ground up. At least have of your work will be dedicated to building and managing partnerships with banks across Africa. The rest of your time will go to working with Column's core fintech partners.
  
  
Column's Growth team is not your typical Customer Success or Account Management team in that Column is a critical, often existential, partner for our customers, our customer relationships are deeply collaborative and complex, and each customer contributes meaningfully to our revenue. We're therefore looking for team members who are analytical, demonstrate great critical thinking, and have experience managing very strategic relationships.
  
  
This role is highly cross-functional and collaborative, partnering closely with Column’s Executive, Solutions Engineering, Sales, Compliance, and Correspondent Banking teams to ensure customers are onboarded smoothly, that we can anticipate and address both issues and opportunities for growth, and that these relationships are healthy and mutually beneficial. You’ll also represent the voice of the customer to help inform Column's strategy, including the product roadmap, go-to-market motions and more.
  
  
Success in this role also means having a desire to become an expert on the Financial Technology space and on how companies partner with Column (our customers include many key industry players such as Brex and Carta).
  
  
**This role reports to the Head of Growth and is an in-person role based out of Dubai, UAE. We will help secure any required visas.**
**What You’ll Do**

* Help establish our customer-facing strategy, processes, playbooks, systems and best practices. Identify patterns and build repeatability at every step

jobs.title: Emerging Markets Lead – MENA (Arabic speaking)
jobs.description:
**About Column**
For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.
  
  
At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!
  
  
**The opportunity**
As Column’s Emerging Markets Lead, you will spearhead one of our most strategic international expansion initiatives. In this role, you will be responsible for driving 0-to-1 growth for a new banking product, with a particular focus on building and nurturing relationships with prospective partners and customers in select markets, with a specific focus on markets within MENA. This role combines global expansion strategy, business development with hands-on relationship management, requiring a general business athlete who thrives on networking and executing complex partnerships. This is a unique opportunity to be on the founding team for a new business line, with significant autonomy and direct impact on Column’s global expansion strategy.
  
  
This position will be based in Dubai with regular travel throughout the region and occasional travel to Column’s headquarters in San Francisco.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead regional market development: Own the end-to-end process of identifying, evaluating, and executing on high-value partnerships with banks across a number of international markets.
* Build and maintain key relationships: Serve as the primary relationship owner for prospective and existing customers, conducting regular in-person meetings, attending local industry events, and managing ongoing partnership development.
* Own partnership execution: Lead complex deal processes from initial outreach through contract signature, working collaboratively with Column’s Legal, Compliance, and Product teams.
* Develop market intelligence: Gather and synthesize insights on local market conditions, regulatory developments, competitive landscape, and customer needs to inform Column’s regional strategy.
* Market expertise and network: Become an expert on the correspondent banking space in our key emerging markets and build an extensive network within their banking and fintech ecosystems.
* Drive operational excellence: Build scalable processes for onboarding, relationship management, and ongoing support that can be replicated as we expand.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* 6+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, growth, operations or strategy in a high-caliber environment
* 4+ years of business experience specifically in MENA
* Native fluency in Arabic and experience managing business relationships with Arabic-speaking clients and stakeholders
* Track record of successfully managing complex partnerships and high-value deals with executive stakeholders
* Natural networker who thrives on building trust and long-term relationships with senior executives, market experts and decision-makers
* Strong strategic thinking - ability to assess market opportunities, evaluate potential partners, and provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership
* Hyper-organized approach to project management, including coordinating efforts across multiple teams; comfort juggling multiple projects and priorities is critical
* Scrappy, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude - we thrive because we work harder, are more creative, and have zero ego when it comes to getting our hands dirty to build a business

**We look forward to hearing from you**
Column is committed to working with the best and brightest people from the broadest talent pool possible. jobs.title: Director, Government Sales Executive, UAE
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Overview**
**Job Description**
Visa is seeking an experienced payments and public sector business development leader to join the CEMEA Visa Government Solutions team as Director, Government Solutions for UAE, reporting to the Head of Visa Government Solutions for GCC. The role will be responsible for driving Visa Government Solutions growth across the UAE market, building trusted relationships with government stakeholders and partners, and translating public sector priorities into scalable commercial opportunities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Expand and deepen the Visa Government Solutions public sector strategy and commercial pipeline across UAE, developing and maintaining a prioritized portfolio of clients, use cases and solution opportunities.
* Establish and strengthen strategic relationships with key public sector stakeholders across federal and local government entities in UAE, positioning Visa as a trusted partner in payments and digital transformation.
* Identify and engage relevant issuers, program managers, processors, fintechs and FI partners to enable the delivery of Visa Government Solutions to government clients.
* Develop and execute market strategies and account plans to grow revenue, payment volume and market share, while expanding the adoption and visibility of relevant Visa capabilities across government use cases.
* Identify market specific needs, emerging use cases and client requirements, and partner with regional and global solutions teams to help shape proposition and product roadmaps.
* Drive achievement of UAE Visa Government Solutions scorecard metrics and commercial objectives, with clear ownership of pipeline development, execution and business outcomes.
* Maintain close alignment with the UAE Country Manager to ensure Visa Government Solutions priorities and execution are fully aligned with country strategies and broader Visa objectives.
* Create and maintain clear business reporting, pipeline visibility and performance tracking against KPIs and commercial targets, ensuring accountability and timely management of risks and opportunities.
* collaborate with Product, Legal, Solutioning and Government Engagement to coordinate Visa’s approach to government clients and strengthen engagement with key decision makers and stakeholders.
* Partner with Marketing and Communications to strengthen Visa’s positioning as a leader in payments and a strategic resource for government entities across UAE.
* Lead and coordinate Visa Government Solutions input into RFPs, proposals and complex commercial opportunities, working across internal teams to ensure high quality responses and effective execution.
* Continuously assess the market and competitive landscape, identify new growth opportunities and recommend creative approaches to expand Visa Government Solutions business across UAE.
* Proactively identify and resolve complex commercial, delivery and stakeholder challenges that may impact government business growth, client relationships or execution.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in government, state owned enterprise or public sector sales and business development, ideally within payments or financial services, with a track record of managing complex opportunities and commercial engagements.
* Strong understanding of how government entities and public sector organizations operate across UAE, including stakeholder dynamics, procurement processes and decision making environments. A strong network across the public sector ecosystem in UAE is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated business development and consultative sales capability, with the ability to translate client needs into compelling propositions, build strong business cases and advance complex opportunities from origination through execution.
* Proven experience engaging senior public sector stakeholders and building trusted, long term relationships across complex stakeholder environments.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with a clear focus on measurable business outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to negotiate complex commercial agreements while strengthening existing relationships and building new partnerships.
* Proven ability to lead strategic initiatives across cross functional teams, solve complex problems and drive engagements through to completion.
* Knowledge of public sector payments infrastructure and government payment flows is an advantage. Strong collaboration and influencing skills are essential to successfully mobilize cross functional teams and deliver results.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Account Management Specialist
jobs.description:
**Department:**
Merchant Business
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full Time
  
  
**Location:**
UAE
  
  
**Description**
**About Tabby:**
Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 20 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money.
  
  
The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 40,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.
  
  
Tabby generates over $14 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region.
  
  
Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and now has an implied valuation of $4.5 billion.
  
  
**About the Role:**
The Account Management Specialist manages a portfolio of strategic and enterprise merchants, driving long-term growth, retention, and product adoption across accounts. Acting as a trusted advisor, the specialist is responsible for developing account strategies, identifying revenue opportunities, and delivering data-driven recommendations that maximize merchant performance and business outcomes.
  
  
This role requires strong commercial acumen, analytical capabilities, and stakeholder management skills. The Account Management Specialist is expected to operate independently, lead strategic merchant conversations, influence decision-making, and drive the adoption of Tabby's full product suite. The role also plays a key part in cross-functional initiatives, process improvements, and strategic projects that support broader business objectives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Strategic Account Management:**

* Own and manage a portfolio of strategic and enterprise merchants, driving retention, growth, and long-term partnership success.
* Build relationships with key decision-makers and act as a trusted advisor to merchants.
* Develop and execute account growth plans aligned with merchant objectives and Tabby's commercial strategy.

**Revenue Growth & Product Expansion:**

* Drive revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and expansion of Tabby's products and services.
* Identify opportunities to increase product penetration across the portfolio, including new and existing solutions.
* Lead commercial discussions and proactively position relevant products based on merchant needs and performance insights.
* Own pipeline generation within the portfolio and track expansion opportunities through to execution.

**Data Analytics & Portfolio Optimization:**

* Analyze merchant performance, transaction trends, conversion metrics, and product adoption to identify growth opportunities and risks.
* Translate complex datasets into actionable recommendations that improve merchant performance and revenue contribution.
* Conduct portfolio reviews, business reviews, and strategic performance discussions with merchants.
* Build dashboards, reports, and presentations to support data-driven decision-making.

**Strategic Projects & Business Initiatives:**

* Lead and contribute to strategic initiatives, product launches, operational improvements, and merchant experience enhancements.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and support automation and scalability initiatives across the business.
* Partner with leadership and cross-functional teams on high-impact commercial and operational projects.

**Merchant Success & Problem Resolution:**

* Proactively identify merchant challenges and business risks before they impact performance.
* Take ownership of complex merchant escalations and coordinate stakeholders to drive timely resolution.
* Ensure merchants receive strategic recommendations and solutions that support continued growth.

**Cross-Functional Leadership:**

* Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Risk, Finance, and Tech teams to deliver merchant solutions and achieve business objectives.
* Act as the primary point of coordination for strategic merchant initiatives requiring cross-functional involvement.
* Influence internal stakeholders and drive alignment to achieve successful merchant outcomes.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
* 3-5+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Partnerships, Business Development, or a similar client-facing role.
* Proven experience independently managing enterprise or strategic accounts.
* Strong commercial mindset with demonstrated success in driving revenue growth, upselling, and cross-selling.
* Advanced analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into business recommendations.
* Experience conducting portfolio reviews, business reviews, and presenting performance insights to senior stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives and priorities simultaneously.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Technical teams.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and experience with Tableau, Power BI, or similar analytics tools.
* Experience within fintech, payments, BNPL, e-commerce, or technology industries is preferred.

Job Benefits
  
  

* We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well at times that suit you and your team.
* A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one.
* You should be comfortable with the idea that the quality of your work will influence the shape of your career.
* Participation in the company’s employee stock options program.
* Health Insurance.
* Flexi Perks: a monetary benefit to spend on what matters most to you — health, well-being, education, or professional development.

* Proven, hands-on experience with the end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-tiered software systems.
* Strong foundation across multiple IT disciplines, with demonstrated understanding of core architectural concepts and patterns (e.g., SOA, event-driven, microservices, domain-driven design).
* Experience conducting system and process analysis to inform architectural decisions.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions with both technical and non-technical/business stakeholders.
* Solid experience working with data and database management systems, including both legacy and modern/emerging database technologies.
* Experience with RDBMS required; hands-on experience with NoSQL is required.
* Demonstrated experience designing and building highly available, customer-facing applications in a global delivery/shared-services (GCC) model.
* Experience designing and building cloud-native applications and RESTful/GraphQL APIs.
* Demonstrated experience designing highly available, resilient architectures, including automation and performance-optimization initiatives.
* Proven experience transforming monolithic architectures into modern, decoupled microservices-based systems.
* Working experience in at least two to three of the following domains: Infrastructure, Security, DevOps, Application Development, Database Technologies, or Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

**Job Purpose**

The **Associate – Cash Applications** is responsible for the accurate and timely application of customer payments within the Accounts Receivable process. The role involves matching remittance information, clearing open items, reconciling cash receipts, resolving unapplied or unidentified payments, and supporting day-to-day Cash Application activities.

The Associate works closely with customers and internal teams to ensure accurate processing, timely resolution of exceptions, strong controls, and high-quality service delivery.

**Key Tasks and Responsibilities**

* Process and apply incoming customer payments accurately and within agreed timelines, including bank transfers, lockbox receipts, cheques, cards, direct debits, and other payment methods.
* Match remittance advice with customer payments and correctly allocate receipts against invoices, customer accounts, deductions, credit notes, and other open items in the ERP system.
* Perform daily cash and bank reconciliation activities and ensure alignment between bank statements, cash receipt records, and the Accounts Receivable sub-ledger.
* Investigate unapplied, unidentified, misapplied, duplicate, short, or excess payments and coordinate with customers and relevant internal teams for resolution.
* Maintain customer accounts, clear open items, process approved adjustments, and follow up on workflow items and process exceptions.
* Handle customer and internal queries through email, calls, workflow tools, and other communication channels.
* Record and execute transactions in line with approved process documentation, accounting policies, service-level agreements, and quality standards.
* Complete required Internal Control System activities accurately and on time and maintain supporting documentation for audit purposes.
* Support month-end and period-end closing activities.
* Prepare and maintain operational reports related to cash posting, unapplied cash, unidentified cash, ageing, productivity, quality, and other relevant KPIs.
* Identify recurring process issues and escalate exceptions or process gaps to the Senior Associate or Team Lead.
* Support process improvement, automation, analytics, and AI initiatives within Cash Applications.
* Maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, and work instructions.
* Participate in knowledge-sharing, cross-training, and continuous-learning activities.
* Adapt to changes in processes, systems, regional requirements, and transformation initiatives while maintaining service quality.

**Who you are**

* University degree or equivalent qualification, preferably in **Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business Administration** , or a related discipline.
* Typically **1–3 years of relevant experience** in Cash Applications, Accounts Receivable, or another Order-to-Cash process.
* Good understanding of **Cash Applications, customer account reconciliation, open-item clearing, unapplied cash management, and basic accounting principles** .
* Experience working with ERP systems. Hands-on experience with **SAP or SAP S/4HANA** would be an advantage.
* Good working knowledge of **Microsoft Office, particularly Excel** .
* Experience working in a shared-services, global, or multi-regional environment would be an advantage.
Fresh graduates with relevant accounting/finance knowledge and strong aptitude may also be considered depending on the business requirement.  

**Core Competencies**

* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good analytical, reconciliation, and problem-solving skills.
* Customer-oriented mindset with clear written and verbal communication.
* Ability to manage daily volumes, prioritise activities, and meet agreed timelines.
* Good collaboration skills and ability to work with teams across functions and regions.
* Willingness to learn and contribute to process improvements, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions.
Can-do attitude, adaptability, learning agility, and commitment to quality and compliance.  

Key Working Relationships

* Customers and business partners across the assigned region/country.
* Senior Process Associates, Operational Managers, and Team Leads.
* Collections, Credit, Billing, Customer Service, Banking, Treasury, and Master Data teams.
* Internal Controls and Audit teams.
Process Experts and other cross-functional teams.  

Key Performance Indicators

* Cash application timeliness and accuracy.
* Unapplied and unidentified cash ageing.
* AMR processing rate.
* Query resolution time and SLA adherence.
* Productivity and quality.
* Control and audit compliance.
Accuracy and completeness of assigned activities.

* **Catalyst:** Collaborates with colleagues, shares knowledge, and contributes ideas for continuous improvement.

**Description**

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. The collaborative environment and engaging work - guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.

**The Team**

Our Performance Improvement team provides Business Transformation and Performance Improvement Services to Corporates, Investors, and their portfolio companies, delivering –

* Performance improvement via cost reduction and revenue growth programmes

We are seeking an experienced Senior Associate – ERP Implementation / Transformation Readiness to lead finance preparedness activities ahead of an ERP transformation. The role will work closely with Finance leadership, business process owners, ERP implementation teams, IT, data teams, and other functional workstreams to identify readiness gaps, define remediation actions, and establish the foundation required for a successful implementation.

The ideal candidate will have strong FICO functional knowledge, finance transformation experience, business process understanding, and program management capabilities.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

Expertise across one or more of the following areas

  
  

1. FI/CO Implementation Readiness Assessment

* Lead a comprehensive assessment of the organization's readiness for ERP implementation.
* Assess current-state FI/CO processes, organizational structures, master data, transactional data, reporting, controls, integrations, and technology landscape.
* Identify key gaps, dependencies, risks, and prerequisites that need to be addressed before implementation.

* Assess readiness against SAP/Oracle/MS Dynamics 365 capabilities and recommended leading practices.
  

  

2. Finance Process Readiness

* Assess current finance processes across: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis, Period-end and year-end close and Management reporting

* Assess alignment of the existing Chart of Accounts with the future ERP design.

* Define data cleansing and remediation requirements before migration.
  

  

4. Functional Readiness

* Assess existing customizations and determine which should be retired, redesigned, replaced with standard ERP functionality, or retained.
* Support clean-core readiness assessments.
  

  

5. Data Migration Readiness

* Lead assessment of finance data migration preparedness.
* Define requirements for historical and open-item data migration.
* Assess data quality and reconciliation requirements.
* Establish data ownership and accountability across Finance and IT.
* Define cleansing, transformation, mapping, and validation requirements.
* Establish reconciliation principles between legacy systems and new ERP systems.
* Identify data migration risks and dependencies early in the program.
  

  

6. Integration & Technology Readiness

* Assess FI/CO dependencies and integration points with:
* MM, SD, PP, Asset Management, Treasury, Procurement, Sales, Payroll, Banking platforms, Tax systems and Data warehouses and reporting platforms
* Identify upstream and downstream systems that require remediation or redesign.
* Assess interfaces, data flows, integration dependencies, and reconciliation requirements.

9. Stakeholder & Program Leadership

10. Team Leadership

You will be joining a high performing team of technocrats and customer focussed professionals handling some of the most complex IT setups in the country. The CX Team is dedicated to accelerating our customers’ digital transformation journeys by bridging vision and execution. As the trusted delivery and lifecycle engine across India’s most critical sectors—including Banking, Financial Services& Insurance (BFSI), Public Sector& Defence, Telecom/Service Providers, and Commercial Enterprises—we ensure our customers realize the full business value of their technology investments with speed, agility, and principled resilience.
  
  
**Key Strategic Focus Areas of the CX Team:**  

* Critical Transformation: Architecting, securing, and operating next-generation, AI-ready Data Center, Zero Trust Security, Converged SASE, and Campus architectures.
* Proactive Lifecycle& Outcome Delivery: Transitioning from reactive support to continuous value realization through Lifecycle Services, Cisco IQ telemetry-driven validation, and contextual risk scoring.
* Domain& Regulatory Excellence: Deep alignment with India-specific regulatory frameworks (RBI Master Directions on Cyber Resilience, CERT-In SBOM/compliance mandates) and air-gapped sovereign cloud requirements.

Your Impact
  
The Customer Success Manager is responsible for driving the successful adoption and utilization of Cisco technologies to ensure customer value realization and growth, proactively leading and mitigating renewal risks in alignment with the renewals team by leveraging risk insights and adoption action plans to increase retention rates and supporting customer expansion through identifying opportunities for deeper product utilization and aligning technology to evolving business needs.
  
This role will focus on the Top Banking accounts and will be based in Mumbai.
  
  
This position develops and maintains strong technical influence with customer consultative sessions to address business challenges and objectives, acts as a technology evangelist by providing feedback from customers to Cisco's product teams to inform product development and enhancements.
  
  
The role also includes creating and implementing technical adoption plans (TAPs) that align with customer goals to improve technology investments, directing customer requests to appropriate teams for resolution of adoption barriers, and collaborating with sales, customer success, delivery, renewals, and business entities to identify use cases that drive value and business outcomes.
  
Additionally, the role requires staying current with the latest Cisco technologies, including AI, ML, automation, and cloud technologies, as well as maintaining awareness of the competitive landscape and industry trends to provide guide guidance to customers.

* Leverages deep technical knowledge across multiple products and solutions, acting as a technology evangelist to customers

* Lead alignment workshops; steers outcome roadmaps and executive updates; brings up adoption risks with clear owners •Partners with customers to co-create proactive and predictive, personalized adoption journeys •Influences cross-functional internal teams (Product, Engineering, Sales) based on customer priorities
* Acts as a liaison across accounts, regions, or functional initiatives, ensuring a “one-team” customer experience

Key Success Metrics (KPIs)
  
  

* Net Retention Rate (NRR)& Gross Retention Rate (GRR) across the assigned BFSI portfolio.
* Adoption& Feature Utilization Velocity (Percentage of licensed software capabilities active in production).
* Time-to-Value (TTV / TTFV) for new software suites and EA onboarding.
* Customer Health Score& CSAT / Net Promoter Score (NPS).
* Success Plan Execution& Executive QBR Rhythm (100% compliance across Tier-1 accounts).

**Minimum Qualifications:**  

* Exposure to BFSI customers, proven skills in DC operations and infrastructure play including security platforms is essential for the candidate. Demonstrated experience in navigating C-level relationships (CIO/CTO/CISO/EVP Infrastructure) in the Indian banking ecosystem.
* Strong foundational understanding of modern enterprise architectures (ability to speak confidently on Cloud Networking, SD-WAN, Zero Trust, DC Infrastructure, SASE, and AIOps).
* Familiarity with software subscription models, Enterprise Agreements (EA), SaaS adoption lifecycle, and consumption metrics.

jobs.title: AVP - Control Finance
jobs.description:
Date live: 11/19/2026

Business Area: Finance

Area of Expertise: Controls

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000138160

  

Join Barclays as AVP - Control Finance, where core responsibility is to execute design assessment and operating effectiveness testing of controls in accordance with testing plans and aligned to relevant policies, procedures and quality standards providing assurance to Management that the processes and controls within the reviewed Business Unit are effectively designed and operating to mitigating the identified risks. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it.

  

To be successful in this role, you should have below skills:

  
  

* Experience in risk management or controls assurance or internal audit.
* Understanding of SOx and Risk Management practices including but not limited to Internal Audit.
* Ability to communicate internal control concepts clearly, in a business context.
* Verbal and written communication skills to deal with internal and external stakeholders. Keeps stakeholders up to date with the progress of the audit work, observation status, etc.
* Understand on Investment banking products and had exposure to Banking & Markets division.
* Understanding of Markets finance functions.
  

  

Some other highly valued skills may include below:

  
  

* Knowledge of internal control and regulatory requirements & practice e.g. Sarbanes-Oxley, COSO, Basel IV regulations.
* Proficient in use of MS Office packages (Outlook, Word, Excel, Power-point).
* Understanding on data analytics skills used in control testing.
  

  

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

  
  

The role is based out of Gurugram.

**Purpose of the role**

To partner with the bank, to provide independent insurance on control processes and advise on improvements to ensure the efficiency and effectiveness of the bank’s internal controls framework.

**Accountabilities**

* Collaboration across the bank to maintain a satisfactory, robust, and efficient control environment through the execution of ad-hoc assessments and testing on the design and operational effectiveness of the internal controls, aligned to control policies and standards.
* Development of detailed test plans and procedures to identify weaknesses in internal controls and other initiatives aligned to the bank’s control framework to mitigate any potential risks and issues, prioritised by its severity to disrupt bank operations, potential losses, and reputational impact.
* Communication of key findings and observations to the relevant stakeholders and business units to improve overall control efficiency and provide corrective actions to senior managers. Collaboration with other control professionals to resolve complex issues and ensure consistent testing methodologies across the bank.
* Development of a knowledge centre containing detailed documentation of control assessments, testing on design and operational effectiveness of procedures, findings, and the distribution of material on internal controls to train and upskill colleagues within the bank.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
